name: "[07 研究] 晚間 6/7/10 籌碼 Facts 準備"

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '30 13 * * 1-5'
    - cron: '0 14 * * 1-5'
    - cron: '30 14 * * 1-5'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      date:
        description: '分析日期 YYYYMMDD；留空時使用最新已有 5% 清單日期'
        required: false
        default: ''
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'data_twse_margin_balance/*_twse_margin_balance.csv'
      - 'data_fubon_broker_details/fubon_*_券商分點進出明細.json'
      - 'data_twse_mi_index/*_twse_mi_index.json'
      - 'data_twse_foreign_investors/*_twse_foreign_investors.json'
      - 'data_twse_investment_trust/*_twse_investment_trust.json'
      - 'data_twse_dealers/*_twse_dealers.json'
      - '.github/workflows/analyze-daily-gainers-margin-flow-2200.yml'
      - 'config/daily-gainers-ai-contract.json'
      - 'scripts/lib/daily_gainers_ai_contract.js'
      - 'scripts/daily_gainers_ai_contract_cli.js'
      - 'scripts/build_daily_gainers_ai_facts.js'
      - 'scripts/annotate_daily_gainers_facts_completeness.js'

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: daily-gainers-margin-flow-2200
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  prepare-ai-facts:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'

      - name: Resolve target date from schedule, dispatch, or late source push
        id: input
        shell: bash
        env:
          INPUT_DATE: ${{ github.event.inputs.date }}
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d="${INPUT_DATE:-}"
          mode="manual"

          if [ -z "$d" ] && [ "$EVENT_NAME" = "push" ]; then
            d="$(node - "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH" <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const event = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[2], 'utf8'));
          const paths = (event.commits || []).flatMap((c) => [...(c.added || []), ...(c.modified || [])]);
          const patterns = [
            /^data_twse_margin_balance\/(20\d{6})_twse_margin_balance\.csv$/,
            /^data_fubon_broker_details\/fubon_(20\d{6})_券商分點進出明細\.json$/,
            /^data_twse_mi_index\/(20\d{6})_twse_mi_index\.json$/,
            /^data_twse_foreign_investors\/(20\d{6})_twse_foreign_investors\.json$/,
            /^data_twse_investment_trust\/(20\d{6})_twse_investment_trust\.json$/,
            /^data_twse_dealers\/(20\d{6})_twse_dealers\.json$/,
          ];
          const dates = [];
          for (const p of paths) for (const re of patterns) {
            const m = p.match(re); if (m) dates.push(m[1]);
          }
          process.stdout.write(dates.sort().at(-1) || '');
          NODE
            )"
            mode="late_source_push"
          fi

          if [ -z "$d" ]; then
            d="$(find data_daily_gain_over_5 -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '20??????.json' -printf '%f\n' 2>/dev/null | sed 's/\.json$//' | sort | tail -1)"
            mode="latest_available_raw"
          fi

          if [ -z "$d" ]; then
            echo "No daily 5% raw list is available yet; nothing to build."
            echo "date=" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "mode=no_raw" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0
          fi

          [[ "$d" =~ ^20[0-9]{6}$ ]] || { echo "Invalid date: $d" >&2; exit 1; }
          echo "date=$d" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "mode=$mode" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Verify base deterministic inputs
        if: steps.input.outputs.date != ''
        id: readiness
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d="${{ steps.input.outputs.date }}"
          list="data_daily_gain_over_5/${d}.json"
          margin="data_twse_margin_balance/${d}_twse_margin_balance.csv"
          broker="data_fubon_broker_details/fubon_${d}_券商分點進出明細.json"
          mi="data_twse_mi_index/${d}_twse_mi_index.json"
          ready=true
          reasons=()

          [ -s "$list" ] || { ready=false; reasons+=("daily_gainers"); }
          [ -s "$margin" ] || { ready=false; reasons+=("margin"); }

          node - "$broker" <<'NODE' || { ready=false; reasons+=("broker_details"); }
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const f = process.argv[2];
          if (!fs.existsSync(f) || fs.statSync(f).size <= 0) process.exit(1);
          try {
            const p = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8'));
            process.exit(p?.complete === true && p?.stocks && typeof p.stocks === 'object' ? 0 : 1);
          } catch { process.exit(1); }
          NODE

          node - "$mi" <<'NODE' || { ready=false; reasons+=("mi_index"); }
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const f = process.argv[2];
          if (!fs.existsSync(f) || fs.statSync(f).size <= 0) process.exit(1);
          try {
            const p = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8'));
            process.exit(Array.isArray(p?.tables) && p.tables.length ? 0 : 1);
          } catch { process.exit(1); }
          NODE

          echo "ready=$ready" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "## 晚間 6/7/10 Facts readiness" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- 日期：$d" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- 觸發模式：${{ steps.input.outputs.mode }}" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- Base ready：$ready" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if [ "$ready" != true ]; then
            echo "- 缺少：${reasons[*]}" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            echo "Base inputs are not ready yet; keep existing Facts unchanged."
          fi

      - name: Build and annotate latest facts
        if: steps.readiness.outputs.ready == 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d="${{ steps.input.outputs.date }}"
          facts="data_daily_gain_over_5/analysis-facts/${d}.json"
          node --check scripts/build_daily_gainers_ai_facts.js
          node --check scripts/annotate_daily_gainers_facts_completeness.js
          node scripts/build_daily_gainers_ai_facts.js "$d"
          node scripts/annotate_daily_gainers_facts_completeness.js "$facts"
          node scripts/daily_gainers_ai_contract_cli.js assert-facts "$facts"
          node - "$facts" <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const p = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[2], 'utf8'));
          if (p.stock_count && p.stocks.every((x) => !x?.flow?.broker || x.flow.broker.status !== 'available')) throw new Error('broker facts missing for all stocks');
          if (p.stock_count && p.stocks.every((x) => !x?.flow?.margin || x.flow.margin.margin_now == null)) throw new Error('margin facts missing for all stocks');
          console.log(JSON.stringify({ stocks: p.stock_count, source_status: p.source_status, source_completeness: p.source_completeness }, null, 2));
          NODE
          status="$(node -e 'const p=require("./'"$facts"'"); process.stdout.write(p.source_completeness?.status || "partial")')"
          missing="$(node -e 'const p=require("./'"$facts"'"); process.stdout.write((p.source_completeness?.missing_sources || []).join(", ") || "none")')"
          echo "- Facts completeness：$status" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- Missing semantic sources：$missing" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Commit refreshed facts
        if: steps.readiness.outputs.ready == 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d="${{ steps.input.outputs.date }}"
          f="data_daily_gain_over_5/analysis-facts/${d}.json"
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            git add -- "$f"
            if git diff --cached --quiet; then
              echo "Facts already current"
              exit 0
            fi
            git commit -m "analysis: refresh 5% AI facts ${d}"
            if git push origin HEAD:main; then exit 0; fi

            echo "Push conflict; rebuild from latest main before retry ${attempt}/5."
            git fetch origin main
            git reset --hard origin/main
            node scripts/build_daily_gainers_ai_facts.js "$d"
            node scripts/annotate_daily_gainers_facts_completeness.js "$f"
            node scripts/daily_gainers_ai_contract_cli.js assert-facts "$f"
            sleep 5
          done
          exit 1

  schedule-timing-summary:
    # schedule-timing-summary:v1
    name: 排程時間摘要
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Write schedule timing summary
        shell: bash
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EasonLiu0913/stock_data/main/scripts/write_workflow_schedule_summary.js | node

name: '[07 研究] MOPS－月營收事件與大盤超額報酬'

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      revenue_month:
        description: '營收月份 YYYYMM（例如 202607）'
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: analyze-mops-revenue-event-returns
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  analyze:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Checkout main
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - name: Sync latest main
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git fetch origin main
          git reset --hard origin/main

      - name: Validate input and source data
        shell: bash
        env:
          REVENUE_MONTH: ${{ inputs.revenue_month }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$REVENUE_MONTH" =~ ^20[0-9]{4}$ ]] || { echo '::error::revenue_month must be YYYYMM'; exit 1; }
          test -s "data_mops_monthly_revenue/$REVENUE_MONTH/monthly_revenue.json"
          test -s data_twse_market_chart/market_chart.json

      - name: Run event-study regression tests
        run: |
          node --check scripts/generate_mops_revenue_event_returns.js
          node --test tests/mops_revenue_event_returns.test.js

      - name: Generate revenue event returns
        run: node scripts/generate_mops_revenue_event_returns.js --month "${{ inputs.revenue_month }}"

      - name: Validate generated research payload
        shell: bash
        env:
          REVENUE_MONTH: ${{ inputs.revenue_month }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node - <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const month = process.env.REVENUE_MONTH;
          const file = `data_prediction_analysis/monthly-revenue/events/${month}.json`;
          const payload = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'));
          if (payload.revenue_month !== month) throw new Error('revenue_month mismatch');
          if (payload.benchmark?.code !== 'TAIEX') throw new Error('TAIEX benchmark missing');
          if (!Array.isArray(payload.events) || payload.events.length === 0) throw new Error('No revenue events generated');
          if (payload.counts.total !== payload.events.length) throw new Error('Event count mismatch');
          console.log(JSON.stringify({ month, benchmark: payload.benchmark.code, counts: payload.counts }, null, 2));
          NODE

      - name: Commit verified research data
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add data_prediction_analysis/monthly-revenue/events
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo 'No MOPS revenue event research changes'
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m "analysis: update MOPS revenue event returns ${{ inputs.revenue_month }}"
          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            if git pull --rebase origin main && git push origin HEAD:main; then exit 0; fi
            git rebase --abort 2>/dev/null || true
            sleep $((attempt * 5))
          done
          exit 1

  schedule-timing-summary:
    # schedule-timing-summary:v1
    name: 排程時間摘要
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Write schedule timing summary
        shell: bash
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EasonLiu0913/stock_data/main/scripts/write_workflow_schedule_summary.js | node

          node-version: '24'

      - name: Analyze common prediction-time rules

          args=(--max-dates "${{ inputs.max_dates || '30' }}")
          if [ -n "${{ inputs.date }}" ]; then args+=(--date "${{ inputs.date }}"); fi

      - name: Analyze fixed rules by actual market environment
        shell: bash
        run: |
          args=(--max-dates "${{ inputs.max_dates || '30' }}")
          if [ -n "${{ inputs.date }}" ]; then args+=(--date "${{ inputs.date }}"); fi
          node scripts/analyze_relative_leadership_by_environment.js "${args[@]}"

      - name: Install market environment banner

      - name: Upload analysis artifact

          path: data_prediction_analysis/relative-leadership/
          if-no-files-found: error

      - name: Commit and push analysis
        shell: bash

          set -euo pipefail

          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

          if git diff --staged --quiet; then echo "No analysis changes"; exit 0; fi
          analysis_date=$(node -e "const fs=require('fs');const f='data_prediction_analysis/relative-leadership/manifest.json';if(fs.existsSync(f)){const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f));process.stdout.write(m.latest_date||'latest')}else process.stdout.write('latest')")
          git commit -m "analysis: relative leadership rules by environment ${analysis_date}"
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" || { git status --short; exit 1; }
          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            if git pull --rebase origin main && git push origin HEAD:main; then exit 0; fi
            git rebase --abort 2>/dev/null || true
            sleep 5
          done
          echo "Push failed; artifact remains available"

    name: 排程時間摘要

name: "[05 研究分析] Analyze Replay Volume Filter"

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      date:
        description: Replay date in YYYYMMDD; leave blank for newest date with non-empty V1 and V2 replay files
        required: false
        default: ''
      low_volume_threshold:
        description: Low-volume threshold for actual volume / previous 20-day average volume
        required: false
        default: '0.75'
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - scripts/analyze_replay_volume_filter.js

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: prediction-analysis-writer
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  analyze:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - name: Analyze low-volume exclusion impact
        shell: bash
        run: |
          args=(--low-volume-threshold "${{ inputs.low_volume_threshold || '0.75' }}")
          if [ -n "${{ inputs.date }}" ]; then
            args+=(--date "${{ inputs.date }}")
          fi
          node scripts/analyze_replay_volume_filter.js "${args[@]}"

      - name: Resolve analyzed date
        id: result
        shell: bash
        run: |
          date=$(node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("data_prediction_analysis/manifest.json","utf8"));process.stdout.write(m.latest_volume_filter_date||"");')
          if ! [[ "$date" =~ ^20[0-9]{6}$ ]]; then
            echo "Unable to resolve analyzed volume-filter date: $date"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "date=$date" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Upload analysis artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: replay-volume-filter-${{ steps.result.outputs.date }}
          path: |
            data_prediction_analysis/${{ steps.result.outputs.date }}/volume-filter-impact.json
            data_prediction_analysis/${{ steps.result.outputs.date }}/volume-filter-impact.md
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Commit and push analysis
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add data_prediction_analysis/

          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
              echo "Unexpected uncommitted changes remain even though there are no volume-analysis changes:"
              git status --short
              exit 1
            fi
            echo "No replay volume-filter changes"
            exit 0
          fi

          git commit -m "analysis: update replay volume filter ${{ steps.result.outputs.date }}"

          if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
            echo "Unexpected uncommitted changes remain before rebase:"
            git status --short
            exit 1
          fi

          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            if git pull --rebase origin main && git push origin HEAD:main; then
              exit 0
            fi
            git rebase --abort 2>/dev/null || true
            echo "Volume analysis push failed; retry ${attempt}/5"
            sleep 5
          done

          echo "Volume analysis push failed after 5 attempts"
          exit 1

  schedule-timing-summary:
    # schedule-timing-summary:v1
    name: 排程時間摘要

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

      - name: Fast validation for direct daily prediction call

          node --check scripts/historical_factor_research_round_3.js
          node --check scripts/apply_strategy_tag_registry.js
          node --check scripts/summarize_strategy_snapshot_manifest.js

      - name: Rebuild rebound readiness with official constraints

      - name: Report official constraint integration status

        run: |
          node - <<'NODE'

          const date = process.env.TARGET_DATE;
          const manifestFile = 'data_prediction_analysis/strategy-snapshots/manifest.json';
          if (!fs.existsSync(manifestFile)) throw new Error('Strategy snapshot manifest missing');
          const manifest = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(manifestFile, 'utf8'));
          const row = manifest.dates?.[date];
          if (!row) throw new Error(`Strategy snapshot date missing: ${date}`);
          const entries = [
            row.live_snapshot,
            ...(row.live_snapshot_history || []),
            ...(row.historical_recalculations || []),
          ].filter(Boolean);
          if (!entries.length) throw new Error(`No strategy snapshot generated for ${date}`);
          for (const entry of entries) {
            if (!fs.existsSync(entry.file)) throw new Error(`Snapshot file missing: ${entry.file}`);
            const snapshot = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(entry.file, 'utf8'));
            if (!snapshot.tag_classifications || !snapshot.strategy_classifications) throw new Error(`Invalid snapshot: ${entry.file}`);
            for (const item of Object.values(snapshot.tag_classifications)) if (item.count === undefined) throw new Error('Tag count missing');
            for (const item of Object.values(snapshot.strategy_classifications)) if (item.count === undefined) throw new Error('Strategy count missing');
            if (!entry.classification_summary) throw new Error(`Manifest summary missing: ${entry.file}`);
          }

          const summaryFile = `data_predictions/${date}/summary.json`;
          const groupFile = `data_predictions/${date}/group-summary.json`;
          const summary = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(summaryFile, 'utf8'));
          const groups = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(groupFile, 'utf8')).groups || [];
          for (const [strategyId, classification] of Object.entries(summary.strategy_classifications_v2 || {})) {

            if (Number(group.count) !== Number(classification.count)) {
              throw new Error(`Versioned strategy count mismatch: ${strategyId} ${group.count} != ${classification.count}`);
            }
            const expectedMembers = [...new Set((classification.members || []).map(String))].sort();

            if (JSON.stringify(actualMembers) !== JSON.stringify(expectedMembers)) {

          const directId = 'two_stage_fundamental_quality_direct_entry_v1';
          for (const stock of summary.stocks || []) {

          END_DATE: ${{ inputs.end_date }}
          BATCH_SIZE: ${{ inputs.batch_size }}

        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

            --plan-only
            --start "$START_DATE"
            --batch-size "$BATCH_SIZE"

          node scripts/reconstruct_cnn_fear_and_greed_history.js "${args[@]}" > /tmp/plan.json

          source_mode=$(node -e "const p=require('/tmp/plan.json');process.stdout.write(String(p.source_access?.mode || 'unknown'))")

          echo "pending=$pending" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "source_mode=$source_mode" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "source_last_date=$source_last_date" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "has_work=$([ "$pending" -gt 0 ] && echo true || echo false)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

    steps:

        run: bash scripts/run_cnn_fear_greed_range_batch.sh

      - if: always()
        run: echo "batch ${{ matrix.batch_index }}/${{ matrix.batch_count }}：${{ matrix.first_date }} ～ ${{ matrix.last_date }}" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

  complete:
    needs: [plan, backfill]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - shell: bash
        run: |
          echo "待補日期：${{ needs.plan.outputs.pending }}"
          echo "來源模式：${{ needs.plan.outputs.source_mode }}"
          echo "historical 最後日期：${{ needs.plan.outputs.source_last_date }}"
          if [ "${{ needs.plan.result }}" != success ]; then exit 1; fi
          if [ "${{ needs.plan.outputs.has_work }}" = true ] && [ "${{ needs.backfill.result }}" != success ]; then exit 1; fi

    name: 排程時間摘要

        run: |

          if [ "$EVENT_NAME" = "push" ]; then

            start="$(jq -r '.start_date // empty' "$request")"
            end="$(jq -r '.end_date // empty' "$request")"

            current_contract="$(node -e "const p=require('./config/daily-gainers-ai-contract.json');process.stdout.write(String(p.contract_version))")"
            [ -z "$requested_contract" ] || [ "$requested_contract" = "$current_contract" ] || { echo "Request contract_version=$requested_contract does not match current=$current_contract" >&2; exit 1; }
          else
            start="${INPUT_START_DATE:-20260501}"
            end="${INPUT_END_DATE:-20260826}"
          fi

          [[ "$start" =~ ^20[0-9]{6}$ && "$end" =~ ^20[0-9]{6}$ ]] || { echo "Invalid range: $start..$end" >&2; exit 1; }
          [ "$start" -le "$end" ] || { echo "start_date > end_date" >&2; exit 1; }

          mapfile -t dates < <(find data_daily_gain_over_5 -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '20??????.json' -printf '%f\n' | sed 's/\.json$//' | awk -v s="$start" -v e="$end" '$0 >= s && $0 <= e' | sort)

          patterns=(

          echo "end_date=${dates[-1]}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "count=${#dates[@]}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

          echo "- 實際清單交易日：${dates[0]} ～ ${dates[-1]}" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- 交易日數：${#dates[@]}" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Rebuild facts, unified files and market summaries
        shell: bash
        env:
          DATES: ${{ steps.range.outputs.dates }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node --check scripts/build_daily_gainers_ai_facts.js
          node --check scripts/publish_daily_gainers_unified_analysis.js
          node --check scripts/build_daily_gainers_market_summary.js
          node --check scripts/validate_daily_gainers_market_summary.js

          node scripts/validate_daily_gainers_market_summary.js --self-test
          IFS=',' read -ra dates <<< "$DATES"
          ai_days=0
          fallback_days=0

          preliminary_summary_days=0

              ai_days=$((ai_days + 1))

              fallback_days=$((fallback_days + 1))

            node scripts/daily_gainers_ai_contract_cli.js assert-published "data_daily_gain_over_5/analysis/${d}.json"

          echo "- 交易日：${#dates[@]}" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

            echo "No changes"

          fi

          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            if git push origin HEAD:main; then
              echo "Published rebuilt history; reusable Pages deploy runs next."
              exit 0
            fi
            git fetch origin main
            git rebase origin/main
            sleep 5

          HOURLY_REQUEST_CAP: ${{ inputs.hourly_request_cap }}
          QUOTA_RESERVE_REQUESTS: ${{ inputs.quota_reserve_requests }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${FINMIND_API_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
            echo 'FINMIND_API_TOKEN is missing. Add the token from a registered and email-verified FinMind account to repository Actions secrets.' >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          node scripts/check_finmind_api_quota.js \
            --configured-cap "$HOURLY_REQUEST_CAP" \
            --reserve-requests "$QUOTA_RESERVE_REQUESTS" \
            --required-requests 0

      - name: Backfill batches with checkpoint commits and quota guard
        env:
          CORE_SCORE_THRESHOLD: ${{ inputs.core_score_threshold }}
          CORE_MIN_HITS: ${{ inputs.core_min_hits }}
          PERSISTENT_SCORE_THRESHOLD: ${{ inputs.persistent_score_threshold }}
          PERSISTENT_MIN_HITS: ${{ inputs.persistent_min_hits }}
          START_BATCH: ${{ inputs.start_batch }}
          END_BATCH: ${{ inputs.end_batch }}
          BATCH_SIZE: ${{ inputs.batch_size }}
          DELAY_MS: ${{ inputs.delay_ms }}
          JITTER_MS: ${{ inputs.jitter_ms }}
          BATCH_PAUSE_SECONDS: ${{ inputs.batch_pause_seconds }}
          HOURLY_REQUEST_CAP: ${{ inputs.hourly_request_cap }}
          QUOTA_RESERVE_REQUESTS: ${{ inputs.quota_reserve_requests }}
          QUOTA_POLL_SECONDS: ${{ inputs.quota_poll_seconds }}
          QUOTA_MAX_WAIT_MINUTES: ${{ inputs.quota_max_wait_minutes }}
          START_QUARTER: ${{ inputs.start_quarter }}
          END_QUARTER: ${{ inputs.end_quarter }}
          FORCE: ${{ inputs.force }}
          FINMIND_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.FINMIND_API_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          if [ "$START_BATCH" -gt "$END_BATCH" ]; then
            echo "start_batch must be <= end_batch: $START_BATCH > $END_BATCH" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

          checkpoint_commit() {
            local batch="$1"
            git add data_finmind_quarterly_financial_quality data_prediction_analysis/quarterly-financial-quality/batch-status
            if git diff --cached --quiet; then
              echo "[checkpoint] batch $batch has no changes"
              return 0
            fi

            git commit -m "data: backfill FinMind financial quality batch $batch"
            for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
              if git pull --rebase origin main && git push origin HEAD:main; then
                echo "[checkpoint] batch $batch committed and pushed"
                return 0
              fi
              git rebase --abort 2>/dev/null || true
              sleep $((attempt * 5))
            done
            echo "[checkpoint] unable to push batch $batch" >&2
            return 1
          }

          for batch in $(seq "$START_BATCH" "$END_BATCH"); do
            echo "========================================"
            echo "[batch] quota check before $batch / $END_BATCH"
            echo "========================================"

            node scripts/check_finmind_api_quota.js \
              --configured-cap "$HOURLY_REQUEST_CAP" \
              --reserve-requests "$QUOTA_RESERVE_REQUESTS" \
              --required-requests "$BATCH_SIZE" \
              --poll-seconds "$QUOTA_POLL_SECONDS" \
              --max-wait-minutes "$QUOTA_MAX_WAIT_MINUTES" \
              --wait true

            echo "========================================"
            echo "[batch] start $batch / $END_BATCH"
            echo "========================================"

            set +e
            node scripts/backfill_finmind_quarterly_financial_quality_batch.js \
              --core-score-threshold "$CORE_SCORE_THRESHOLD" \
              --core-min-hits "$CORE_MIN_HITS" \
              --persistent-score-threshold "$PERSISTENT_SCORE_THRESHOLD" \
              --persistent-min-hits "$PERSISTENT_MIN_HITS" \
              --batch-index "$batch" \
              --batch-size "$BATCH_SIZE" \
              --delay-ms "$DELAY_MS" \
              --jitter-ms "$JITTER_MS" \
              --start-quarter "$START_QUARTER" \
              --end-quarter "$END_QUARTER" \
              --force "$FORCE"
            batch_exit=$?
            set -e

            checkpoint_commit "$batch"

            status_file="data_prediction_analysis/quarterly-financial-quality/batch-status/dual-track-batch$(printf '%03d' "$batch").json"
            if [ ! -s "$status_file" ]; then
              echo "Missing batch status after checkpoint: $status_file" >&2
              exit 1
            fi

            read -r fatal_count quota_exhausted <<<"$(node - "$status_file" <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const file = process.argv[2];
          const data = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'));
          const counts = data.counts || {};
          const fatal = Number(counts.backfill_failed || 0) + Number(counts.timeline_failed || 0);
          const quota = Boolean(data.quota_exhausted || Number(counts.quota_exhausted || 0));
          process.stdout.write(`${fatal} ${quota ? 1 : 0}`);
          NODE
            )"

            if [ "$quota_exhausted" -gt 0 ]; then
              echo "[stop] FinMind quota exhausted during batch $batch despite preflight guard." >&2
              echo "[stop] checkpoint is preserved; resume from batch $batch after quota recovers." >&2
              exit 1
            fi

            if [ "$batch_exit" -ne 0 ] || [ "$fatal_count" -gt 0 ]; then
              echo "[stop] batch $batch has true backfill/timeline failures (exit=$batch_exit, fatal=$fatal_count)." >&2
              echo "[stop] progress through batch $batch is already checkpointed; inspect $status_file and resume from this batch after fixing." >&2
              exit 1
            fi

            if [ "$batch" -lt "$END_BATCH" ]; then
              echo "[batch pause] sleeping ${BATCH_PAUSE_SECONDS}s before batch $((batch + 1))"
              sleep "$BATCH_PAUSE_SECONDS"
            fi
          done

          echo "[complete] processed batches $START_BATCH through $END_BATCH"

      - name: Summarize continuous backfill
        if: always()
        env:
          CORE_SCORE_THRESHOLD: ${{ inputs.core_score_threshold }}
          CORE_MIN_HITS: ${{ inputs.core_min_hits }}
          PERSISTENT_SCORE_THRESHOLD: ${{ inputs.persistent_score_threshold }}
          PERSISTENT_MIN_HITS: ${{ inputs.persistent_min_hits }}
          START_BATCH: ${{ inputs.start_batch }}
          END_BATCH: ${{ inputs.end_batch }}
          BATCH_SIZE: ${{ inputs.batch_size }}
          DELAY_MS: ${{ inputs.delay_ms }}
          JITTER_MS: ${{ inputs.jitter_ms }}
          BATCH_PAUSE_SECONDS: ${{ inputs.batch_pause_seconds }}
          HOURLY_REQUEST_CAP: ${{ inputs.hourly_request_cap }}
          QUOTA_RESERVE_REQUESTS: ${{ inputs.quota_reserve_requests }}
        run: |
          echo "## FinMind 季財報品質候選池連續回填" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- 高強度軌：score >= $CORE_SCORE_THRESHOLD，至少 $CORE_MIN_HITS 個月" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- 持續強度軌：score >= $PERSISTENT_SCORE_THRESHOLD，至少 $PERSISTENT_MIN_HITS 個月" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- 批次範圍：$START_BATCH → $END_BATCH；每批 $BATCH_SIZE 檔" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- 註冊會員 token：必填；每批前使用 FinMind user_info 驗證實際用量" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- Workflow 安全上限：${HOURLY_REQUEST_CAP}/hour；另保留 ${QUOTA_RESERVE_REQUESTS} requests" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- 股票間節奏：至少 ${DELAY_MS}ms + 0~${JITTER_MS}ms jitter" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- 批次間休息：${BATCH_PAUSE_SECONDS}s" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- 429/5xx/timeout：2s → 5s → 10s 退避重試；402 quota exhaustion 立即 checkpoint + stop" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- 每批完成即 checkpoint commit；真正 backfill/timeline failure 會在保留進度後停止" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

  schedule-timing-summary:
    # schedule-timing-summary:v1
    name: 排程時間摘要
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Write schedule timing summary
        shell: bash
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EasonLiu0913/stock_data/main/scripts/write_workflow_schedule_summary.js | node

name: "[06 回填修復] 富邦價量／SMA－區間資料補齊"

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      start_date:
        description: '起始交易日 YYYYMMDD'
        required: true
        default: '20251103'
        type: string
      end_date:
        description: '結束交易日 YYYYMMDD；留空取市場交易日曆最後日期'
        required: false
        default: ''
        type: string
      stock_batch_size:
        description: '每批股票數（建議 100）'
        required: true
        default: '100'
        type: string
      minimum_records:
        description: '每日最少有效股票數'
        required: true
        default: '100'
        type: string

        description: '即使每日檔有效也重新規劃'
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: backfill-fubon-sma-range
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  plan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      matrix: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.matrix }}
      has_work: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.has_work }}
      has_crawl: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.has_crawl }}
      start_date: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.start_date }}
      end_date: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.end_date }}
      pending_dates: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.pending_dates }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 1
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - name: Test SMA range planner and merger
        run: node --test tests/plan_twse_range_backfill.test.js tests/merge_history_data.test.js tests/sma_history_range_seed.test.js
      - name: Plan missing or invalid SMA dates
        id: plan
        shell: bash
        env:
          INPUT_START: ${{ inputs.start_date }}
          INPUT_END: ${{ inputs.end_date }}
          STOCK_BATCH_SIZE: ${{ inputs.stock_batch_size }}
          MINIMUM_RECORDS: ${{ inputs.minimum_records }}
          FORCE: ${{ inputs.force }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          end_date="$INPUT_END"
          if [ -z "$end_date" ]; then
            end_date=$(node -e "process.stdout.write(require('./scripts/lib/range_backfill').loadTwseTradingCalendar().lastDate)")
          fi
          args=(--dataset sma --start "$INPUT_START" --end "$end_date" --stock-batch-size "$STOCK_BATCH_SIZE" --minimum-records "$MINIMUM_RECORDS")
          if [ "$FORCE" = 'true' ]; then args+=(--force); fi
          node scripts/plan_twse_range_backfill.js "${args[@]}" > /tmp/sma-plan.json
          cat /tmp/sma-plan.json
          matrix=$(node -e "const p=require('/tmp/sma-plan.json');process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(p.matrix))")
          pending=$(node -e "const p=require('/tmp/sma-plan.json');process.stdout.write(String(p.pending_date_count))")
          batches=$(node -e "const p=require('/tmp/sma-plan.json');process.stdout.write(String(p.stock_batch_count))")
          echo "matrix=$matrix" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "has_work=$([ "$pending" -gt 0 ] && echo true || echo false)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "has_crawl=$([ "$batches" -gt 0 ] && echo true || echo false)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "start_date=$INPUT_START" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "end_date=$end_date" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "pending_dates=$pending" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          {
            echo '## 富邦價量／SMA 區間規劃'
            echo "- 日期：$INPUT_START ～ $end_date"
            echo "- 待重建／補抓：$pending 日"
            echo "- 股票批次：$batches"
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

  crawl-history:
    needs: plan
    if: needs.plan.outputs.has_crawl == 'true'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      max-parallel: 1
      matrix: ${{ fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.matrix) }}
    name: 股票歷史批次回填
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 350
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - name: Crawl and safely persist one stock batch
        env:
          START_DATE: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.start_date }}
          END_DATE: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.end_date }}
          START_INDEX: ${{ matrix.start_index }}
          LIMIT: ${{ matrix.limit }}
        run: bash scripts/run_sma_history_stock_batch.sh
      - name: Batch summary
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "stocks: ${{ matrix.first_stock_code }} ~ ${{ matrix.last_stock_code }}" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "index: ${{ matrix.start_index }} + ${{ matrix.limit }}" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

  rebuild-daily:
    needs: [plan, crawl-history]
    if: always() && needs.plan.outputs.has_work == 'true' && (needs.crawl-history.result == 'success' || needs.crawl-history.result == 'skipped')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - name: Rebuild requested daily SMA files
        run: node scripts/merge_history_data.js --sma-only --start "${{ needs.plan.outputs.start_date }}" --end "${{ needs.plan.outputs.end_date }}"
      - name: Verify all requested trading dates
        env:
          START_DATE: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.start_date }}
          END_DATE: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.end_date }}
          MINIMUM_RECORDS: ${{ inputs.minimum_records }}
        run: |
          node scripts/plan_twse_range_backfill.js --dataset sma --start "$START_DATE" --end "$END_DATE" --minimum-records "$MINIMUM_RECORDS" > /tmp/final-plan.json
          cat /tmp/final-plan.json
          node -e "const p=require('/tmp/final-plan.json'); if(p.pending_date_count) { console.error('Still invalid dates:', p.pending_dates.join(',')); process.exit(1); }"
      - name: Safely commit rebuilt daily files
        shell: bash
        env:
          START_DATE: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.start_date }}
          END_DATE: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.end_date }}
          MINIMUM_RECORDS: ${{ inputs.minimum_records }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node - "$START_DATE" "$END_DATE" > /tmp/sma-files.txt <<'NODE'
          const {loadTwseTradingCalendar}=require('./scripts/lib/range_backfill');
          const [start,end]=process.argv.slice(2);
          for(const d of loadTwseTradingCalendar().dates.filter(x=>x>=start&&x<=end)) console.log(`data_fubon/fubon_${d}_sma.json`);
          NODE
          tar -czf "$RUNNER_TEMP/sma-daily.tgz" -T /tmp/sma-files.txt
          git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            git fetch origin main
            git reset --hard origin/main
            tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/sma-daily.tgz"
            node scripts/plan_twse_range_backfill.js --dataset sma --start "$START_DATE" --end "$END_DATE" --minimum-records "$MINIMUM_RECORDS" > /tmp/verify.json
            node -e "const p=require('/tmp/verify.json');if(p.pending_date_count)process.exit(1)"
            mapfile -t files < /tmp/sma-files.txt
            git add -- "${files[@]}"
            if git diff --staged --quiet; then exit 0; fi
            git commit -m "data: rebuild Fubon SMA range ${START_DATE}-${END_DATE}"
            if git push origin HEAD:main; then exit 0; fi
            sleep 5
          done
          exit 1

  complete:
    needs: [plan, crawl-history, rebuild-daily]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: |
          echo "plan=${{ needs.plan.result }}"
          echo "crawl=${{ needs.crawl-history.result }}"
          echo "rebuild=${{ needs.rebuild-daily.result }}"
          if [ "${{ needs.plan.result }}" != 'success' ]; then exit 1; fi
          if [ "${{ needs.plan.outputs.has_work }}" = 'true' ] && [ "${{ needs.rebuild-daily.result }}" != 'success' ]; then exit 1; fi

  schedule-timing-summary:
    # schedule-timing-summary:v1
    name: 排程時間摘要
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Write schedule timing summary
        shell: bash
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EasonLiu0913/stock_data/main/scripts/write_workflow_schedule_summary.js | node

          node --check scripts/backfill_histock_broker_history_research_v2.js
          node --check scripts/aggregate_histock_broker_history_research.js
      - name: Plan stock-date request batches
        id: plan
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node scripts/plan_histock_broker_history_backfill.js \
            --scope "${{ inputs.scope }}" \
            --stock "${{ inputs.stock }}" \
            --stocks "${{ inputs.stocks }}" \
            --start "${{ inputs.start_date }}" \
            --end "${{ inputs.end_date }}" \
            --batch-size-requests "${{ inputs.batch_size_requests }}" \
            --max-batches-per-run "${{ inputs.max_batches_per_run }}" \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/histock-backfill-plan.json" \
            --github-output "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Plan summary
        shell: bash
        run: |
          {
            echo "## HiStock stock-date backfill plan"
            echo "- Scope: \`${{ inputs.scope }}\`"
            echo "- Stocks: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.stock_count }}"
            echo "- Trading days: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.trading_day_count }}"
            echo "- Theoretical stock-date tasks: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.requested_count }}"
            echo "- Already valid after quality gate: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.existing_count }}"
            echo "- Existing tasks rejected by quality gate: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.quality_rejected_count }}"
            echo "- Missing total: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.missing_count }}"
            echo "- Scheduled this run: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.scheduled_count }}"
            echo "- Deferred to later runs: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.deferred_count }}"
            echo "- Request cap per batch: ${{ inputs.batch_size_requests }}"
            echo "- Max batches this run: ${{ inputs.max_batches_per_run }}"
            echo "- Absolute request ceiling this run: $(( ${{ inputs.batch_size_requests }} * ${{ inputs.max_batches_per_run }} ))"
            echo "- Planned batches: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.batch_count }}"
            echo "- Data-quality gate: buy/sell >= 0, net = buy - sell, avg_price > 0; any bad row invalidates that daily file."
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

  batch:
    needs: plan
    if: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.scheduled_count != '0' }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      max-parallel: 1
      matrix: ${{ fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.matrix) }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Sync latest checkpoint
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git fetch origin main
          git reset --hard origin/main
      - name: Fetch stock-date tasks in this batch
        id: fetch
        shell: bash
        env:
          TASKS: ${{ matrix.tasks }}
          BATCH_INDEX: ${{ matrix.batch }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          IFS=',' read -ra ITEMS <<< "$TASKS"
          echo "Batch $BATCH_INDEX contains ${#ITEMS[@]} request task(s); configured cap=${{ inputs.batch_size_requests }}"
          test "${#ITEMS[@]}" -le "${{ inputs.batch_size_requests }}"

          for ITEM in "${ITEMS[@]}"; do
            STOCK="${ITEM%@*}"
            DATE="${ITEM#*@}"
            TMP="$RUNNER_TEMP/histock-${STOCK}-${DATE//-/}"
            ROOT="data_research/institutional-flow/histock/$STOCK"
            mkdir -p "$TMP/daily" "$ROOT/daily" "$ROOT/batch-status"

            echo "[task] $STOCK / $DATE"
            set +e
            node scripts/backfill_histock_broker_history_research_v2.js \
              --stock "$STOCK" --start "$DATE" --end "$DATE" \
              --delay-ms "${{ inputs.delay_ms }}" --jitter-ms "${{ inputs.jitter_ms }}" \
              --max-consecutive-failures 20 --out "$TMP"
            FETCH_EXIT=$?
            set -e

            DAILY="$TMP/daily/${DATE//-/}.json"
            if [ -s "$DAILY" ]; then
              cp -f "$DAILY" "$ROOT/daily/"
              echo "[task] staged $STOCK / $DATE for quality validation"
            else
              echo "[task] unresolved $STOCK / $DATE"
            fi

            STATUS="$ROOT/batch-status/run-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-batch-$(printf '%03d' "$BATCH_INDEX")-${DATE//-/}.json"
            node - "$TMP/analysis.json" "$STATUS" "$STOCK" "$DATE" "$FETCH_EXIT" <<'NODE'
          const fs=require('fs');
          const [analysisFile,statusFile,stock,date,exitCode]=process.argv.slice(2);
          const a=fs.existsSync(analysisFile)?JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(analysisFile,'utf8')):{};
          const parsed=(a.rolling||[]).some(x=>x.date===date);
          const unresolved=(a.unresolved||[]).find(x=>x.date===date)||null;
          const out={schema_version:2,run_id:process.env.GITHUB_RUN_ID,batch:Number(process.env.BATCH_INDEX),stock,date,parsed,unresolved,fetch_exit_code:Number(exitCode),generated_at:new Date().toISOString()};
          fs.writeFileSync(statusFile,JSON.stringify(out,null,2)+'\n');
          NODE
          done
      - name: Apply batch data-quality gate
        id: quality
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        env:
          TASKS: ${{ matrix.tasks }}
          BATCH_INDEX: ${{ matrix.batch }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node scripts/checkpoint_histock_batch_quality.js \
            --tasks "$TASKS" \
            --batch "$BATCH_INDEX" \
            --run-id "$GITHUB_RUN_ID"
      - name: Checkpoint valid tasks
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        env:
          BATCH_INDEX: ${{ matrix.batch }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo "quality valid=${{ steps.quality.outputs.quality_valid }} rejected=${{ steps.quality.outputs.quality_rejected }} missing=${{ steps.quality.outputs.quality_missing }}"
          if [ "${{ inputs.commit_results }}" = "true" ]; then
            git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
            git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
            git add data_research/institutional-flow/histock
            if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
              git commit -m "research: HiStock stock-date batch $BATCH_INDEX checkpoint"
              for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
                if git pull --rebase origin main && git push origin HEAD:main; then break; fi
                git rebase --abort 2>/dev/null || true
                sleep $((attempt*5))
                if [ "$attempt" -eq 5 ]; then exit 1; fi
              done
            fi
          fi

          if [ "${{ inputs.batch_pause_seconds }}" -gt 0 ]; then
            sleep "${{ inputs.batch_pause_seconds }}"
          fi

  aggregate:
    needs: [plan, batch]
    if: ${{ always() && needs.plan.result == 'success' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Sync all checkpoints
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git fetch origin main
          git reset --hard origin/main
      - name: Aggregate affected stocks
        id: aggregate
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        env:
          AFFECTED_STOCKS: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.affected_stocks }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "$AFFECTED_STOCKS" ]; then
            echo "No affected stocks to aggregate."
            exit 0
          fi
          IFS=',' read -ra STOCKS <<< "$AFFECTED_STOCKS"
          HARD=0
          for STOCK in "${STOCKS[@]}"; do
            echo "[aggregate] $STOCK"
            set +e
            node scripts/aggregate_histock_broker_history_research.js \
              --stock "$STOCK" --start "${{ inputs.start_date }}" --end "${{ inputs.end_date }}"
            RC=$?
            set -e
            if [ "$RC" -ne 0 ]; then HARD=1; fi
          done
          echo "hard_failure=$HARD" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Commit aggregate states
        if: ${{ inputs.commit_results }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add data_research/institutional-flow/histock
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then exit 0; fi
          git commit -m "research: aggregate HiStock stock-date backfill"
          git pull --rebase origin main
          git push origin HEAD:main
      - name: Final summary
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          {
            echo "## HiStock stock-date plan & batch backfill"
            echo "- Scope: \`${{ inputs.scope }}\`"
            echo "- Stocks in universe: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.stock_count }}"
            echo "- Trading days: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.trading_day_count }}"
            echo "- Theoretical tasks: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.requested_count }}"
            echo "- Existing valid before run: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.existing_count }}"
            echo "- Existing quality-rejected before run: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.quality_rejected_count }}"
            echo "- Missing before run: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.missing_count }}"
            echo "- Scheduled this run: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.scheduled_count }}"
            echo "- Deferred: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.deferred_count }}"
            echo "- Batches: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.batch_count }}"
            echo "- Batch request cap: ${{ inputs.batch_size_requests }}"
            echo "- Max requests/run: $(( ${{ inputs.batch_size_requests }} * ${{ inputs.max_batches_per_run }} ))"
            echo "- Every committed daily file passed the shared hard data-quality gate."
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if [ "${{ inputs.scope }}" = "single" ] && [ -s "data_research/institutional-flow/histock/${{ inputs.stock }}/analysis.json" ]; then
            node scripts/render_histock_broker_history_summary.js "data_research/institutional-flow/histock/${{ inputs.stock }}/analysis.json" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY" || true
          fi
      - name: Report aggregate hard failures
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if [ "${{ steps.aggregate.outputs.hard_failure }}" = "1" ]; then
            echo "Some affected stocks still have hard unresolved or quality-rejected dates. Valid stock-date checkpoints were preserved; rerun to retry only remaining missing tasks."
          fi

  schedule-timing-summary:
    # schedule-timing-summary:v1
    name: 排程時間摘要
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Write schedule timing summary
        shell: bash
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EasonLiu0913/stock_data/main/scripts/write_workflow_schedule_summary.js | node

    steps:

        with:

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7

      - name: Resolve trading dates
        id: dates
        env:
          START_DATE: ${{ inputs.start_date }}
          END_DATE: ${{ inputs.end_date }}
        run: |
          node - <<'NODE' > /tmp/environment-dates.txt
          const {normalizeIsoDate,isTradingDate,loadHolidaySet,addDays}=require('./scripts/resolve_forecast_dates');
          const start=normalizeIsoDate(process.env.START_DATE),end=normalizeIsoDate(process.env.END_DATE),holidays=loadHolidaySet();
          if(!start||!end||start>end) throw new Error('Invalid date range');
          for(let date=start;date<=end;date=addDays(date,1)) if(isTradingDate(date,holidays)) console.log(date.replaceAll('-',''));
          NODE
          count=$(wc -l < /tmp/environment-dates.txt | tr -d ' ')
          echo "count=$count" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Selected $count Taiwan trading dates"

      - name: Run market environment and formal strategy tests
        run: |
          node --check scripts/backfill_prediction_dashboard_fields.js
          node --test \
            tests/market_environment.test.js \
            tests/formal_strategy_replay.test.js \
            tests/prediction_dashboard_backfill.test.js \
            tests/formal_market_strategy_tags.test.js \
            tests/prediction_dashboard_group_sync.test.js

      - name: Build historical snapshots and sync dashboards
        shell: bash
        env:
          DRY_RUN: ${{ inputs.dry_run }}
          FORCE: ${{ inputs.force }}
          GENERATE_ACTUAL: ${{ inputs.generate_actual }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          while read -r forecast_date; do
            [ -n "$forecast_date" ] || continue
            node scripts/resolve_forecast_dates.js --target-date "$forecast_date" --github-env > /tmp/one-date.env
            set -a
            source /tmp/one-date.env
            set +a
            args=(--forecast-date "$FORECAST_TARGET_DATE" --base-date "$FORECAST_BASE_DATE")
            if [ "$DRY_RUN" = "true" ]; then args+=(--dry-run); fi
            if [ "$FORCE" = "true" ]; then args+=(--force); fi
            node scripts/generate_market_environment.js "${args[@]}"

            if [ "$DRY_RUN" != "true" ]; then
              node scripts/reconstruct_historical_market_environment.js \
                --forecast-date "$FORECAST_TARGET_DATE" \
                --base-date "$FORECAST_BASE_DATE"

              # Readiness must exist before strategy tagging. Rebuild the selected

              && [ -s "data_predictions/$FORECAST_TARGET_DATE/replay-dashboard.json" ]; then
              node scripts/generate_actual_market_environment.js --date "$FORECAST_TARGET_DATE"

            fi
          done < /tmp/environment-dates.txt

        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add \
            data_market_environment \
            data_prediction_analysis/relative-leadership/environment \
            data_prediction_analysis/formal-strategy \
            data_prediction_analysis/oversold-beta-rebound \
            data_predictions/*/summary.json \
            data_predictions/*/industry-summary.json \
            data_predictions/*/group-summary.json \
            data_predictions/*/replay-summary.json \
            data_predictions/*/replay-dashboard.json \
            public/prediction-dashboard.html
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then echo "No backfill changes"; exit 0; fi
          git commit -m "analysis: backfill market environment ${{ inputs.start_date }}-${{ inputs.end_date }}"
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" || { git status --short; exit 1; }
          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            if git pull --rebase origin main && git push origin HEAD:main; then exit 0; fi
            git rebase --abort 2>/dev/null || true
            sleep 5
          done
          exit 1

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Write schedule timing summary

        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

        description: '結束營收月份 YYYYMM（例如 202606）'
        required: true
        type: string
      force_full_rebuild:
        description: '忽略既有可重用 monthly detail，強制整段重新計算（methodology/schema/價格規則變更時使用）'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      run_recovery_validation:
        description: '安全模擬 missing/corrupt monthly detail，驗證只重建指定月份並於測試後完整還原'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      recovery_month:
        description: 'Recovery 驗證月份 YYYYMM；啟用 recovery validation 時必填，且整段範圍需為成熟可重用月份'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: backfill-mops-revenue-monthly-signal-study
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  backfill:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - name: Checkout main
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - name: Validate scripts
        run: |
          node --check scripts/lib/stock_price_provider.js
          node --check scripts/generate_mops_revenue_monthly_signal_returns.js
          node --check scripts/generate_mops_revenue_stock_event_timeline.js
          node --check scripts/run_mops_revenue_monthly_signal_incremental.js
          node --check scripts/validate_mops_revenue_incremental_recovery.js
          node --check scripts/summarize_mops_revenue_monthly_signal_study.js
          node --check scripts/summarize_mops_revenue_factor_rankings.js
          node --check scripts/summarize_mops_revenue_yoy20_subfactors.js
          node --check scripts/summarize_mops_revenue_fundamental_acceleration_breakout.js
          node --check scripts/summarize_mops_revenue_fundamental_acceleration_score.js
          node --check scripts/summarize_mops_revenue_factor_stability.js
          node --check scripts/summarize_mops_revenue_industry_breakdown.js
          node --check scripts/summarize_mops_revenue_market_regime_breakdown.js
          node --check tests/mops_revenue_incremental_signal_runner.test.js
          node --test tests/stock_price_provider.test.js
          node --test tests/mops_revenue_monthly_signal_returns.test.js
          node --test tests/mops_revenue_incremental_signal_runner.test.js
          node --test tests/mops_revenue_factor_rankings.test.js
          node --test tests/mops_revenue_yoy20_subfactors.test.js
          node --test tests/mops_revenue_fundamental_acceleration_breakout.test.js
          node --test tests/mops_revenue_factor_stability.test.js
          node --test tests/mops_revenue_industry_breakdown.test.js
          node --test tests/mops_revenue_market_regime_breakdown.test.js

      - name: Validate range
        shell: bash
        env:
          START_MONTH: ${{ inputs.start_month }}
          END_MONTH: ${{ inputs.end_month }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$START_MONTH" =~ ^20[0-9]{4}$ ]] || { echo '::error::start_month must be YYYYMM'; exit 1; }
          [[ "$END_MONTH" =~ ^20[0-9]{4}$ ]] || { echo '::error::end_month must be YYYYMM'; exit 1; }
          node - <<'NODE'
          const s = process.env.START_MONTH;
          const e = process.env.END_MONTH;
          const toIndex = m => Number(m.slice(0,4))*12 + Number(m.slice(4,6));
          if (toIndex(s) > toIndex(e)) throw new Error('start_month must be <= end_month');
          if (toIndex(e) - toIndex(s) > 35) throw new Error('maximum range is 36 months');
          const now = new Date(new Date().toLocaleString('en-US', { timeZone: 'Asia/Taipei' }));
          const availabilityDate = month => {
            let y = Number(month.slice(0,4));
            let m = Number(month.slice(4,6)) + 1;
            if (m === 13) { y += 1; m = 1; }
            return new Date(y, m - 1, 15, 23, 59, 59);
          };
          if (availabilityDate(e) > now) throw new Error(`end_month ${e} is not conservatively available yet; its next-month day-15 boundary is still in the future`);
          NODE

      - name: Controlled missing/corrupt recovery validation
        if: ${{ inputs.run_recovery_validation }}
        shell: bash
        env:
          START_MONTH: ${{ inputs.start_month }}
          END_MONTH: ${{ inputs.end_month }}
          RECOVERY_MONTH: ${{ inputs.recovery_month }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$RECOVERY_MONTH" =~ ^20[0-9]{4}$ ]] || { echo '::error::recovery_month must be YYYYMM when recovery validation is enabled'; exit 1; }
          node scripts/validate_mops_revenue_incremental_recovery.js \
            --start-month "$START_MONTH" \
            --end-month "$END_MONTH" \
            --recovery-month "$RECOVERY_MONTH"
          git diff --exit-code -- data_prediction_analysis/monthly-revenue/monthly-signals || {
            echo '::error::controlled recovery validation left persistent monthly-detail changes';
            exit 1;
          }

      - name: Generate or reuse historical monthly signal details
        shell: bash
        env:
          START_MONTH: ${{ inputs.start_month }}
          END_MONTH: ${{ inputs.end_month }}
          FORCE_FULL_REBUILD: ${{ inputs.force_full_rebuild }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          args=(
            --start-month "$START_MONTH"
            --end-month "$END_MONTH"
          )
          if [ "$FORCE_FULL_REBUILD" = "true" ]; then
            args+=(--force-full-rebuild)
          fi
          node scripts/run_mops_revenue_monthly_signal_incremental.js "${args[@]}"

      - name: Validate monthly detail outputs
        shell: bash
        env:
          START_MONTH: ${{ inputs.start_month }}
          END_MONTH: ${{ inputs.end_month }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node - <<'NODE'
          const fs=require('node:fs');const start=process.env.START_MONTH,end=process.env.END_MONTH;
          const next=value=>{let y=Number(value.slice(0,4)),m=Number(value.slice(4,6))+1;if(m===13){y++;m=1;}return `${y}${String(m).padStart(2,'0')}`;};
          for(let month=start;;month=next(month)){
            const file=`data_prediction_analysis/monthly-revenue/monthly-signals/${month}.json`;
            const payload=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'));
            if(payload.dataset!=='mops_monthly_revenue_conservative_signal_returns')throw new Error(`dataset mismatch: ${month}`);
            if(payload.revenue_month!==month)throw new Error(`month mismatch: ${month}`);
            if(!Array.isArray(payload.events)||!payload.events.length)throw new Error(`no events: ${month}`);
            if(!payload.incremental?.input_fingerprint?.market_window_sha256)throw new Error(`missing TAIEX benchmark market window: ${month}; backfill data_twse_market_chart before running research`);
            if(!Number.isFinite(payload.counts?.with_effective_trading_date)||payload.counts.with_effective_trading_date<=0)throw new Error(`no effective trading dates: ${month}; benchmark history does not cover conservative availability date`);
            const d20=payload.events.map(event=>event.returns?.d20?.status||'missing_status');
            const pending=d20.filter(status=>status==='pending_market_data').length;
            const complete=d20.filter(status=>status==='complete').length;
            if(pending===0&&complete===0)throw new Error(`zero D20 stock-price coverage: ${month}; backfill data_twse_mi_index/data_history_sma/data_fubon before running mature historical research`);
            console.log(month,payload.counts,{d20_complete:complete,d20_pending:pending},payload.incremental?.input_fingerprint?.methodology_version||'legacy_detail');
            if(month===end)break;
          }
          NODE

      - name: Rebuild coverage summary from monthly details
        run: node scripts/summarize_mops_revenue_monthly_signal_study.js --start-month '${{ inputs.start_month }}' --end-month '${{ inputs.end_month }}'

      - name: Rebuild factor rankings from monthly details
        run: node scripts/summarize_mops_revenue_factor_rankings.js --start-month '${{ inputs.start_month }}' --end-month '${{ inputs.end_month }}'

      - name: Rebuild YoY 20 percent subfactor experiment
        run: node scripts/summarize_mops_revenue_yoy20_subfactors.js --start-month '${{ inputs.start_month }}' --end-month '${{ inputs.end_month }}'

      - name: Rebuild fundamental acceleration breakout experiment
        run: node scripts/summarize_mops_revenue_fundamental_acceleration_breakout.js --start-month '${{ inputs.start_month }}' --end-month '${{ inputs.end_month }}'

      - name: Rebuild fundamental acceleration score experiment
        run: node scripts/summarize_mops_revenue_fundamental_acceleration_score.js --start-month '${{ inputs.start_month }}' --end-month '${{ inputs.end_month }}'

      - name: Build 2059 monthly revenue event timeline
        run: node scripts/generate_mops_revenue_stock_event_timeline.js --stock 2059 --start-month '${{ inputs.start_month }}' --end-month '${{ inputs.end_month }}'

      - name: Rebuild factor stability summary
        run: node scripts/summarize_mops_revenue_factor_stability.js

      - name: Rebuild industry breakdown
        run: node scripts/summarize_mops_revenue_industry_breakdown.js --start-month '${{ inputs.start_month }}' --end-month '${{ inputs.end_month }}'

      - name: Rebuild market regime breakdown
        run: node scripts/summarize_mops_revenue_market_regime_breakdown.js --start-month '${{ inputs.start_month }}' --end-month '${{ inputs.end_month }}'

      - name: Commit verified study data
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add data_prediction_analysis/monthly-revenue/monthly-signals
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then echo 'No historical MOPS signal study changes'; exit 0; fi
          git commit -m "analysis: refresh MOPS monthly revenue signals ${{ inputs.start_month }}-${{ inputs.end_month }}"
          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            if git pull --rebase origin main && git push origin HEAD:main; then exit 0; fi
            git rebase --abort 2>/dev/null || true
            sleep $((attempt * 5))
          done
          exit 1

  schedule-timing-summary:
    # schedule-timing-summary:v1
    name: 排程時間摘要
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Write schedule timing summary
        shell: bash
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EasonLiu0913/stock_data/main/scripts/write_workflow_schedule_summary.js | node
