on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 18 * * 0,2,4' # 台北一三五 02:17：投信＋自營商
    - cron: '47 18 * * 1,3,5' # 台北二四六 02:47：融資融券
    - cron: '17 17 * * 6'     # 台北週日 01:17：券商分點
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      source:
        description: '要補的資料來源'
        required: true
        type: choice
        default: all
        options: [all, institutional, margin, broker]
      max_institutional_dates:
        description: '每個法人 batch 最多補幾個交易日；所有 batch 會自動接續'
        type: number
        default: 10
      max_margin_dates:
        description: '每個融資融券 batch 最多補幾個交易日；所有 batch 會自動接續'
        type: number
        default: 10
      max_broker_dates:
        description: '每個券商分點 batch 最多補幾個交易日；建議 1'
        type: number
        default: 1
      lookback_days:
        description: '法人／融資累積特徵回看交易日數'
        type: number
        default: 10
      min_request_delay_ms:
        description: 'TWSE 請求前最短隨機等待毫秒'
        type: number
        default: 5000
      max_request_delay_ms:
        description: 'TWSE 請求前最長隨機等待毫秒'
        type: number
        default: 15000
      min_date_pause_seconds:
        description: '同一 batch 內完成一個日期後最短休息秒數'
        type: number
        default: 60
      max_date_pause_seconds:
        description: '同一 batch 內完成一個日期後最長休息秒數'
        type: number
        default: 180
      batch_pause_min_seconds:
        description: '完成一個 batch 後最短長休息秒數'
        type: number
        default: 120
      batch_pause_max_seconds:
        description: '完成一個 batch 後最長長休息秒數'
        type: number
        default: 300
      force:
        description: '重新下載既有檔案'
        type: boolean
        default: false
      refresh_dashboard:
        description: '所有 batch 結束後重建研究與 Dashboard'
        type: boolean
        default: true
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/backfill-oversold-rebound-coverage.yml'
      - 'scripts/plan_oversold_rebound_coverage_backfill.js'
      - 'scripts/crawl_twse_margin_balance.js'
      - 'scripts/patch_oversold_rebound_dealer_features.js'
      - 'scripts/run_oversold_rebound_research.js'
      - 'tests/plan_oversold_rebound_coverage_backfill.test.js'
      - 'tests/crawl_twse_margin_balance.test.js'
      - 'tests/patch_oversold_rebound_dealer_features.test.js'

permissions:
  contents: write
  actions: write

concurrency:
  group: oversold-rebound-coverage-backfill-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && 'validation' || 'production' }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  plan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      source: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.source }}
      matrix: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.matrix }}
      has_work: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.has_work }}
      total_batches: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.total_batches }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || 'main' }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - run: npm ci

      - name: Validate backfill code
        run: |
          node --check scripts/plan_oversold_rebound_coverage_backfill.js
          node --check scripts/crawl_twse_margin_balance.js
          node --check scripts/patch_oversold_rebound_dealer_features.js
          node --check scripts/run_oversold_rebound_research.js
          node --test \
            tests/plan_oversold_rebound_coverage_backfill.test.js \
            tests/crawl_twse_margin_balance.test.js \
            tests/patch_oversold_rebound_dealer_features.test.js \
            tests/oversold_rebound_research.test.js

      - name: Resolve source
        id: resolve
        shell: bash
        env:
          INPUT_SOURCE: ${{ inputs.source }}
          SCHEDULE: ${{ github.event.schedule }}
        run: |
          if [ '${{ github.event_name }}' = 'workflow_dispatch' ]; then
            source="${INPUT_SOURCE:-all}"
          elif [ '${{ github.event_name }}' = 'pull_request' ]; then
            source=all
          else
            case "$SCHEDULE" in
              '17 18 * * 0,2,4') source=institutional ;;
              '47 18 * * 1,3,5') source=margin ;;
              '17 17 * * 6') source=broker ;;
              *) source=all ;;
            esac
          fi
          echo "source=$source" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Plan all sequential batches
        id: plan
        shell: bash
        env:
          SOURCE: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.source }}
          LOOKBACK: ${{ inputs.lookback_days }}
          MAX_INSTITUTIONAL: ${{ inputs.max_institutional_dates }}
          MAX_MARGIN: ${{ inputs.max_margin_dates }}
          MAX_BROKER: ${{ inputs.max_broker_dates }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p /tmp/coverage-plans

          plan_source() {
            local source="$1"
            local batch_size="$2"
            local source_lookback="${LOOKBACK:-10}"
            [ "$source" = broker ] && source_lookback=1

            node scripts/plan_oversold_rebound_coverage_backfill.js \
              --sources "$source" \
              --max-dates "$batch_size" \
              --lookback-days "$source_lookback" \
              > "/tmp/coverage-plans/${source}.json"
            cat "/tmp/coverage-plans/${source}.json" >&2
          }

          if [[ "$SOURCE" == all || "$SOURCE" == institutional ]]; then
            plan_source institutional "${MAX_INSTITUTIONAL:-10}"
          fi
          if [[ "$SOURCE" == all || "$SOURCE" == margin ]]; then
            plan_source margin "${MAX_MARGIN:-10}"
          fi
          if [[ "$SOURCE" == all || "$SOURCE" == broker ]]; then
            plan_source broker "${MAX_BROKER:-1}"
          fi

          node <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const directory = '/tmp/coverage-plans';
          const sourceOrder = new Map([['institutional.json', 0], ['margin.json', 1], ['broker.json', 2]]);
          const files = fs.readdirSync(directory)
            .filter(file => file.endsWith('.json'))
            .sort((left, right) => (sourceOrder.get(left) ?? 99) - (sourceOrder.get(right) ?? 99));
          const include = [];
          const summary = [];

          for (const file of files) {
            const plan = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(`${directory}/${file}`, 'utf8'));
            const source = Object.keys(plan.sources)[0];
            const detail = plan.sources[source];
            include.push(...detail.matrix.include);
            summary.push({
              source,
              complete_dates: detail.complete_date_count,
              missing_dates: detail.missing_date_count,
              batch_size: detail.batch_size,
              batches: detail.batch_count,
            });
          }

          fs.writeFileSync('/tmp/coverage-matrix.json', JSON.stringify({ include }));
          fs.writeFileSync('/tmp/coverage-summary.json', JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2));
          NODE

          matrix=$(cat /tmp/coverage-matrix.json)
          total_batches=$(node -e 'const p=require("/tmp/coverage-matrix.json");process.stdout.write(String(p.include.length))')
          echo "matrix=$matrix" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "total_batches=$total_batches" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          if [ "$total_batches" -gt 0 ]; then
            echo 'has_work=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo 'has_work=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

          {
            echo '### 覆蓋率自動分批計畫'
            echo
            node -e '
              const rows=require("/tmp/coverage-summary.json");
              for (const row of rows) {
                console.log(`- ${row.source}：已完整 ${row.complete_dates} 日；待補 ${row.missing_dates} 日；每批 ${row.batch_size} 日；共 ${row.batches} 批`);
              }
            '
            echo
            echo "總批次：${total_batches}；將以 max-parallel=1 自動依序執行。"
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

  backfill:
    needs: plan
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' && needs.plan.outputs.has_work == 'true'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      max-parallel: 1
      matrix: ${{ fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.matrix) }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 355
    name: ${{ matrix.source }} batch ${{ matrix.batch_index }}/${{ matrix.batch_count }} (${{ matrix.first_date }} ~ ${{ matrix.last_date }})
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - run: npm ci

      - name: Install Playwright for broker batch
        if: matrix.source == 'broker'
        run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium

      - name: Backfill batch and commit every completed date
        id: run
        shell: bash
        env:
          BATCH_SOURCE: ${{ matrix.source }}
          BATCH_DATES: ${{ matrix.dates }}
          BATCH_INDEX: ${{ matrix.batch_index }}
          BATCH_COUNT: ${{ matrix.batch_count }}
          HAS_NEXT_BATCH: ${{ matrix.has_next }}
          MIN_DELAY: ${{ inputs.min_request_delay_ms }}
          MAX_DELAY: ${{ inputs.max_request_delay_ms }}
          MIN_PAUSE: ${{ inputs.min_date_pause_seconds }}
          MAX_PAUSE: ${{ inputs.max_date_pause_seconds }}
          BATCH_PAUSE_MIN: ${{ inputs.batch_pause_min_seconds }}
          BATCH_PAUSE_MAX: ${{ inputs.batch_pause_max_seconds }}
          FORCE: ${{ inputs.force }}
        run: |
          set -uo pipefail
          git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/coverage-logs" "$RUNNER_TEMP/coverage-saved"
          changed=false
          failures=()

          pause_between_dates() {
            local minimum="${1:-${MIN_PAUSE:-60}}"
            local maximum="${2:-${MAX_PAUSE:-180}}"
            [ "$maximum" -lt "$minimum" ] && maximum="$minimum"
            local seconds=$((minimum + RANDOM % (maximum - minimum + 1)))
            echo "⏳ 下一日期前休息 ${seconds}s"
            sleep "$seconds"
          }

          pause_between_batches() {
            local minimum="${BATCH_PAUSE_MIN:-120}"
            local maximum="${BATCH_PAUSE_MAX:-300}"
            if [ "$BATCH_SOURCE" = broker ]; then
              [ "$minimum" -lt 300 ] && minimum=300
              [ "$maximum" -lt "$minimum" ] && maximum="$minimum"
            fi
            [ "$maximum" -lt "$minimum" ] && maximum="$minimum"
            local seconds=$((minimum + RANDOM % (maximum - minimum + 1)))
            echo "🛑 batch ${BATCH_INDEX}/${BATCH_COUNT} 完成；長休息 ${seconds}s 後自動接續下一批。"
            sleep "$seconds"
          }

          push_files() {
            local message="$1"
            shift
            local saved="$RUNNER_TEMP/coverage-saved/push"
            rm -rf "$saved"
            mkdir -p "$saved"

            local file
            for file in "$@"; do
              [ -f "$file" ] && cp --parents "$file" "$saved"
            done
            [ -n "$(find "$saved" -type f -print -quit)" ] || return 1

            for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
              git fetch origin main
              git reset --hard origin/main
              cp -a "$saved/." .
              node scripts/generate_file_lists.js --only data_twse_investment_trust,data_twse_dealers,data_twse_margin_balance,data_fubon_broker_details
              git add data_twse_investment_trust data_twse_dealers data_twse_margin_balance data_fubon_broker_details

              if git diff --cached --quiet; then
                echo "ℹ️ 內容已存在於 main。"
                return 0
              fi

              git commit -m "$message"
              if git pull --rebase origin main && git push origin HEAD:main; then
                changed=true
                return 0
              fi
              echo "Push failed; retry ${attempt}/5..."
              sleep $((attempt * 5))
            done
            return 1
          }

          backfill_institutional() {
            IFS=',' read -r -a dates <<< "$BATCH_DATES"
            for index in "${!dates[@]}"; do
              date="${dates[$index]}"
              set +e
              node scripts/crawl_twse_institutional_summaries_range.js \
                --start "$date" --end "$date" --datasets TWT44U,TWT43U \
                --min-delay "${MIN_DELAY:-5000}" --max-delay "${MAX_DELAY:-15000}" \
                --max-retries 4 --retry-cooldown 120000 --max-days 1 \
                2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/coverage-logs/institutional-${date}.log"
              status=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
              set -e

              files=("data_twse_investment_trust/${date}_twse_investment_trust.json" "data_twse_dealers/${date}_twse_dealers.json")
              if [ "$status" -eq 0 ] && push_files "🏛️ Backfill oversold rebound institutional coverage ${date}" "${files[@]}"; then
                echo "✅ institutional ${date}"
              else
                failures+=("institutional:$date")
              fi

              if [ "$index" -lt "$((${#dates[@]} - 1))" ]; then
                pause_between_dates
              fi
            done
          }

          backfill_margin() {
            IFS=',' read -r -a dates <<< "$BATCH_DATES"
            for index in "${!dates[@]}"; do
              date="${dates[$index]}"
              args=(--date "$date" --max-retries 4 --retry-cooldown-ms 120000 --min-delay-ms "${MIN_DELAY:-5000}" --max-delay-ms "${MAX_DELAY:-15000}")
              [ "$FORCE" = true ] && args+=(--force)

              set +e
              node scripts/crawl_twse_margin_balance.js "${args[@]}" 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/coverage-logs/margin-${date}.log"
              status=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
              set -e

              file="data_twse_margin_balance/${date}_twse_margin_balance.csv"
              if [ "$status" -eq 0 ] && push_files "📊 Backfill oversold rebound margin coverage ${date}" "$file"; then
                echo "✅ margin ${date}"
              else
                failures+=("margin:$date")
              fi

              if [ "$index" -lt "$((${#dates[@]} - 1))" ]; then
                pause_between_dates
              fi
            done
          }

          backfill_broker() {
            IFS=',' read -r -a dates <<< "$BATCH_DATES"
            for index in "${!dates[@]}"; do
              date="${dates[$index]}"
              iso="${date:0:4}-${date:4:2}-${date:6:2}"
              args=(
                --date "$iso"
                --final-output-dir data_fubon_broker_details
                --work-root "$RUNNER_TEMP/fubon-work"
                --concurrency 2
                --retries 4
                --min-delay-ms 1200
                --max-delay-ms 3500
                --backoff-base-ms 8000
                --checkpoint-size 100
              )
              [ "$FORCE" = true ] && args+=(--force)

              set +e
              node scripts/crawl_fubon_broker_date_isolated.js "${args[@]}" 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/coverage-logs/broker-${date}.log"
              status=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
              set -e

              file="data_fubon_broker_details/fubon_${date}_券商分點進出明細.json"
              if [ "$status" -eq 0 ] && push_files "🏦 Backfill oversold rebound broker coverage ${date}" "$file"; then
                echo "✅ broker ${date}"
              else
                failures+=("broker:$date")
              fi

              if [ "$index" -lt "$((${#dates[@]} - 1))" ]; then
                pause_between_dates 300 900
              fi
            done
          }

          case "$BATCH_SOURCE" in
            institutional) backfill_institutional ;;
            margin) backfill_margin ;;
            broker) backfill_broker ;;
            *) echo "未知 batch source：$BATCH_SOURCE"; exit 1 ;;
          esac

          echo "changed=$changed" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

          if [ "$HAS_NEXT_BATCH" = true ]; then
            pause_between_batches
          fi

          if [ "${#failures[@]}" -gt 0 ]; then
            printf '未完成：%s\n' "${failures[*]}"
            exit 1
          fi

      - if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: oversold-rebound-coverage-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ matrix.source }}-batch-${{ matrix.batch_index }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/coverage-logs
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

  refresh:
    needs: [plan, backfill]
    if: >
      always() &&
      github.event_name != 'pull_request' &&
      needs.plan.outputs.has_work == 'true' &&
      (github.event_name == 'schedule' || inputs.refresh_dashboard == true)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Report batch outcome
        run: |
          echo "Backfill matrix result: ${{ needs.backfill.result }}"
          if [ '${{ needs.backfill.result }}' != 'success' ]; then
            echo '部分 batch 失敗，但已成功 commit 的日期仍會納入本次 Dashboard 重建。'
          fi

      - name: Rebuild research and Dashboard once
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          gh workflow run mine-oversold-rebound-research.yml \
            --repo '${{ github.repository }}' \
            --ref main \
            -f dry_run=false
          echo '已派送完整研究與 Dashboard 重建。'

  schedule-timing-summary:
    # schedule-timing-summary:v1
    name: 排程時間摘要
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Write schedule timing summary
        shell: bash
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EasonLiu0913/stock_data/main/scripts/write_workflow_schedule_summary.js | node

jobs:

        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - name: Test historical dashboard safeguards
        run: |
          node --check scripts/generate_prediction_dashboard_data.js
          node --check scripts/backfill_prediction_dashboard_fields.js
          node --check scripts/oversold_beta_rebound.js
          node --check scripts/apply_formal_market_strategy_tags.js
          node --check scripts/prediction_tag_strategy_engine.js
          node --check scripts/evaluate_tag_strategy_replay.js
          node --check scripts/recalculate_prediction_strategy_history.js
          node --check scripts/sync_prediction_dashboard_groups.js
          node --check scripts/evaluate_formal_strategy_replay.js
          node --check scripts/install_market_environment_ui.js
          node --check public/prediction-dashboard-rebound-enhancement.js
          node --check public/prediction-replay-formal-strategy-enhancement.js
          node --test \

            tests/prediction_tag_strategy_engine.test.js \
            tests/prediction_dashboard_group_sync.test.js \
            tests/formal_strategy_replay.test.js \
            tests/oversold_beta_rebound.test.js \
            tests/oversold_electronics_strategy.test.js \
            tests/oversold_strategy_replay.test.js

      - name: Backfill derived dashboard fields
        env:
          FROM_DATE: ${{ inputs.from_date }}
          TO_DATE: ${{ inputs.to_date }}
          DRY_RUN: ${{ inputs.dry_run }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          args=(--from "$FROM_DATE" --to "$TO_DATE")
          if [ "$DRY_RUN" = "true" ]; then args+=(--dry-run); fi
          node scripts/backfill_prediction_dashboard_fields.js "${args[@]}"

      - name: Install dashboard readiness card
        if: inputs.dry_run != true
        run: node scripts/install_market_environment_ui.js

      - name: Verify changed-file scope
        if: inputs.dry_run != true
        env:
          FROM_DATE: ${{ inputs.from_date }}
          TO_DATE: ${{ inputs.to_date }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          unexpected=""
          while IFS= read -r status_line; do
            [ -n "$status_line" ] || continue
            file="${status_line:3}"
            allowed=false
            file_date=""

            if [ "$file" = "public/prediction-dashboard.html" ]; then
              allowed=true
            elif [[ "$file" =~ ^data_predictions/(20[0-9]{6})/(summary|industry-summary|group-summary|replay-summary|replay-dashboard|tag-strategy-snapshot)\.json$ ]]; then
              allowed=true
              file_date="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
            elif [[ "$file" =~ ^data_market_environment/(20[0-9]{6})/(oversold_beta_rebound|actual_market_environment)\.json$ ]]; then
              allowed=true
              file_date="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
            elif [[ "$file" =~ ^data_prediction_analysis/(formal-strategy|oversold-beta-rebound|tag-strategy)/(20[0-9]{6})\.json$ ]]; then
              allowed=true
              file_date="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
            fi

            if [ "$allowed" = "true" ] && [ -n "$file_date" ] \
              && { [[ "$file_date" < "$FROM_DATE" ]] || [[ "$file_date" > "$TO_DATE" ]]; }; then
              allowed=false
            fi

            if [ "$allowed" != "true" ]; then
              unexpected+="$status_line"$'\n'
            fi
          done < <(git status --short)

          if [ -n "$unexpected" ]; then
            echo "Unexpected files changed:"
            printf '%s' "$unexpected"
            exit 1
          fi

        if: inputs.dry_run != true
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add \
            data_predictions/*/summary.json \
            data_predictions/*/industry-summary.json \
            data_predictions/*/group-summary.json \
            data_predictions/*/replay-summary.json \
            data_predictions/*/replay-dashboard.json \
            data_predictions/*/tag-strategy-snapshot.json \
            data_market_environment/*/oversold_beta_rebound.json \
            data_market_environment/*/actual_market_environment.json \
            data_prediction_analysis/formal-strategy/*.json \
            data_prediction_analysis/oversold-beta-rebound/*.json \
            data_prediction_analysis/tag-strategy/*.json \
            public/prediction-dashboard.html
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No dashboard field changes"
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m "data: backfill readiness and versioned tag strategies"
          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            if git pull --rebase origin main && git push origin HEAD:main; then
              exit 0
            fi
            git rebase --abort 2>/dev/null || true
            echo "Push failed; retry ${attempt}/5"
            sleep 5
          done
          exit 1

  schedule-timing-summary:
    # schedule-timing-summary:v1
    name: 排程時間摘要
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Write schedule timing summary
        shell: bash
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EasonLiu0913/stock_data/main/scripts/write_workflow_schedule_summary.js | node

name: '[04 預測覆盤] 回填五日盤中結果'

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'scripts/backfill_prediction_replay_5d_outcomes.js'
      - 'scripts/generate_prediction_replay.js'
      - 'tests/backfill_prediction_replay_5d_outcomes.test.js'
      - 'scripts/evaluate_tag_strategy_replay.js'
      - '.github/workflows/backfill-prediction-replay-5d.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:

      - 'scripts/generate_prediction_replay.js'
      - 'tests/backfill_prediction_replay_5d_outcomes.test.js'
      - 'scripts/evaluate_tag_strategy_replay.js'
      - '.github/workflows/backfill-prediction-replay-5d.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

      replay_date:
        description: '預測日期 YYYYMMDD；必須已有預測資料，資料滿五個交易日後才會寫入'
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: prediction-analysis-writer
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || 'main' }}
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - name: Validate five-day outcome pipeline
        run: |
          node --check scripts/backfill_prediction_replay_5d_outcomes.js
          node --check scripts/generate_prediction_replay.js
          node --check scripts/evaluate_tag_strategy_replay.js
          node --test tests/backfill_prediction_replay_5d_outcomes.test.js

  backfill:
    needs: validate
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Sync to latest main commit
        run: |
          git fetch origin main
          git reset --hard origin/main
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/main)"
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - name: Validate date and prediction sources
        shell: bash
        env:
          DATE: ${{ inputs.replay_date }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$DATE" =~ ^20[0-9]{6}$ ]] || { echo "Invalid replay date: $DATE"; exit 1; }
          test -s "data_predictions/$DATE/summary.json" || { echo "Missing data_predictions/$DATE/summary.json"; exit 1; }
          test -s "data_fubon/fubon_${DATE}_sma.json" || { echo "Missing result-day price data for $DATE"; exit 1; }
      - name: Repair missing or empty replay outputs
        shell: bash
        env:
          DATE: ${{ inputs.replay_date }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          needs_repair=false
          for file in replay.json replay-dashboard.json replay-summary.json; do
            if [ ! -s "data_predictions/$DATE/$file" ]; then
              echo "Replay output needs repair: data_predictions/$DATE/$file"
              needs_repair=true
            fi
          done
          if [ "$needs_repair" = "true" ]; then
            node scripts/generate_prediction_replay.js --date "$DATE"
          fi
          for file in replay.json replay-dashboard.json replay-summary.json; do
            test -s "data_predictions/$DATE/$file" || { echo "Missing replay output after repair: $file"; exit 1; }
            node -e 'JSON.parse(require("node:fs").readFileSync(process.argv[1], "utf8"));' "data_predictions/$DATE/$file"
          done
      - name: Backfill five-day intraday outcomes
        id: five_day
        shell: bash
        env:
          DATE: ${{ inputs.replay_date }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          result_file=$(mktemp)
          node scripts/backfill_prediction_replay_5d_outcomes.js --date "$DATE" | tee "$result_file"
          changed=$(node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs");const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8"));process.stdout.write(String(Boolean(p.changed)));' "$result_file")
          status=$(node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs");const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8"));process.stdout.write(String(p.status||"unknown"));' "$result_file")
          echo "changed=$changed" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "status=$status" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "## 五日盤中結果回填" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- 預測日期：$DATE" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- 狀態：$status" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- 資料變更：$changed" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
      - name: Recalculate registered strategy replay
        if: steps.five_day.outputs.changed == 'true'
        shell: bash
        env:
          DATE: ${{ inputs.replay_date }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          snapshot="data_predictions/$DATE/tag-strategy-snapshot.json"
          if [ -s "$snapshot" ]; then
            mode="live_snapshot"
            output="data_prediction_analysis/tag-strategy/$DATE.json"
          else
            mode="historical_recalculation"
            output="data_prediction_analysis/tag-strategy-recalculation/$DATE.json"
            echo "Live strategy snapshot is unavailable for legacy replay date $DATE."
            echo "Using historical recalculation without pretending it was the prediction-time snapshot."
          fi
          node scripts/evaluate_tag_strategy_replay.js --date "$DATE" --mode "$mode"
          test -s "$output" || { echo "Missing strategy replay output: $output"; exit 1; }
          echo "- 策略覆盤模式：$mode" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- 策略覆盤輸出：$output" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
      - name: Commit repaired replay and five-day outcomes
        shell: bash
        env:
          DATE: ${{ inputs.replay_date }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          git add "data_predictions/$DATE"
          for strategy_output in \
            "data_prediction_analysis/tag-strategy/$DATE.json" \
            "data_prediction_analysis/tag-strategy-recalculation/$DATE.json"; do
            if [ -e "$strategy_output" ]; then
              git add "$strategy_output"
            fi
          done
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo 'No replay repair or five-day changes'
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m "data: repair and backfill five-day replay outcome for $DATE"
          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            if git pull --rebase origin main && git push origin HEAD:main; then exit 0; fi
            git rebase --abort 2>/dev/null || true
            sleep $((attempt * 5))
          done
          exit 1

  schedule-timing-summary:
    # schedule-timing-summary:v1
    name: 排程時間摘要
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Write schedule timing summary
        shell: bash
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EasonLiu0913/stock_data/main/scripts/write_workflow_schedule_summary.js | node

      total_batches: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.total_batches }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || 'main' }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - run: npm ci

      - name: Validate planner and crawlers
        run: |
          node --check scripts/plan_twse_core_range_backfill.js
          node --check scripts/crawl_twse_mi_index.js
          node --check scripts/twse_mi_index_maintenance.js
          node --check scripts/crawl_twse_margin_balance.js
          bash -n scripts/run_twse_core_range_backfill_batch.sh
          node --test \
            tests/plan_twse_core_range_backfill.test.js \
            tests/twse_mi_index_maintenance.test.js \
            tests/crawl_twse_margin_balance.test.js

      - name: Resolve source
        id: resolve
        shell: bash
        env:
          INPUT_SOURCE: ${{ inputs.source }}
        run: |
          if [ '${{ github.event_name }}' = 'workflow_dispatch' ]; then
            source="${INPUT_SOURCE:-all}"
          else
            source=all
          fi
          echo "source=$source" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Plan all sequential batches
        id: plan
        shell: bash
        env:
          SOURCE: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.source }}
          START_DATE: ${{ inputs.start_date }}
          END_DATE: ${{ inputs.end_date }}
          MAX_MI_INDEX: ${{ inputs.max_mi_index_dates }}
          MAX_MARGIN: ${{ inputs.max_margin_dates }}
          FORCE: ${{ inputs.force }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p /tmp/twse-core-plans

          plan_source() {
            local source="$1"
            local batch_size="$2"
            local args=(
              --sources "$source"
              --max-dates "$batch_size"
            )
            [ -n "${START_DATE:-}" ] && args+=(--from "$START_DATE")
            [ -n "${END_DATE:-}" ] && args+=(--to "$END_DATE")
            [ "${FORCE:-false}" = true ] && args+=(--force)

            node scripts/plan_twse_core_range_backfill.js "${args[@]}" \
              > "/tmp/twse-core-plans/${source}.json"
            cat "/tmp/twse-core-plans/${source}.json" >&2
          }

          if [[ "$SOURCE" == all || "$SOURCE" == mi_index ]]; then
            plan_source mi_index "${MAX_MI_INDEX:-10}"
          fi
          if [[ "$SOURCE" == all || "$SOURCE" == margin ]]; then
            plan_source margin "${MAX_MARGIN:-10}"
          fi

          node <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const directory = '/tmp/twse-core-plans';
          const sourceOrder = new Map([['mi_index.json', 0], ['margin.json', 1]]);
          const files = fs.readdirSync(directory)
            .filter(file => file.endsWith('.json'))
            .sort((left, right) => (sourceOrder.get(left) ?? 99) - (sourceOrder.get(right) ?? 99));
          const include = [];
          const summary = [];

          for (const file of files) {
            const plan = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(`${directory}/${file}`, 'utf8'));
            const source = Object.keys(plan.sources)[0];
            const detail = plan.sources[source];
            include.push(...detail.matrix.include);
            summary.push({
              source,
              from: detail.from,
              to: detail.to,
              required_dates: detail.required_date_count,
              complete_dates: detail.complete_date_count,
              missing_dates: detail.missing_date_count,
              batch_size: detail.batch_size,
              batches: detail.batch_count,
              coverage_pct: detail.estimated_date_coverage_pct,
              force: detail.force,
            });
          }

          const globalMatrix = include.map((entry, index) => ({
            ...entry,
            global_batch_index: index + 1,
            global_batch_count: include.length,
            has_next_global: index < include.length - 1,
          }));
          fs.writeFileSync('/tmp/twse-core-matrix.json', JSON.stringify({ include: globalMatrix }));
          fs.writeFileSync('/tmp/twse-core-summary.json', JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2));
          NODE

          matrix=$(cat /tmp/twse-core-matrix.json)
          total_batches=$(node -e 'const p=require("/tmp/twse-core-matrix.json");process.stdout.write(String(p.include.length))')
          echo "matrix=$matrix" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "total_batches=$total_batches" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          if [ "$total_batches" -gt 0 ]; then
            echo 'has_work=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo 'has_work=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

          {
            echo '### TWSE 原始資料自動分批計畫'
            echo
            node -e '
              const rows=require("/tmp/twse-core-summary.json");
              for (const row of rows) {
                console.log(`- ${row.source}：${row.from}～${row.to}；應有 ${row.required_dates} 日；已完整 ${row.complete_dates} 日；待補 ${row.missing_dates} 日；覆蓋率 ${row.coverage_pct}%；每批 ${row.batch_size} 日；共 ${row.batches} 批${row.force ? "；強制重抓" : ""}`);
              }
            '
            echo
            echo "總批次：${total_batches}；將以 max-parallel=1 自動依序執行。"
            echo '正常成功日期採用較短隨機等待；真正遇到限流或來源異常時仍保留 120 秒冷卻。'
            echo 'MI_INDEX 若遇台北時間 13:30～13:45 的 TWSE 暫停時段，會等待至 13:46 後自動續跑。'
            echo '回填 commit 使用 GITHUB_TOKEN，不會因每個資料 commit 連續觸發 Pages；本流程也不直接部署網站。'
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

  backfill:
    needs: plan
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' && needs.plan.outputs.has_work == 'true'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      max-parallel: 1
      matrix: ${{ fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.matrix) }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 355
    name: ${{ matrix.source }} batch ${{ matrix.batch_index }}/${{ matrix.batch_count }} (${{ matrix.first_date }} ~ ${{ matrix.last_date }})
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - run: npm ci

      - name: Backfill batch and commit every completed date
        id: run
        shell: bash
        env:
          BATCH_SOURCE: ${{ matrix.source }}
          BATCH_DATES: ${{ matrix.dates }}
          GLOBAL_BATCH_INDEX: ${{ matrix.global_batch_index }}
          GLOBAL_BATCH_COUNT: ${{ matrix.global_batch_count }}
          HAS_NEXT_BATCH: ${{ matrix.has_next_global }}
          MIN_DELAY: ${{ inputs.min_request_delay_ms }}
          MAX_DELAY: ${{ inputs.max_request_delay_ms }}
          MIN_PAUSE: ${{ inputs.min_date_pause_seconds }}
          MAX_PAUSE: ${{ inputs.max_date_pause_seconds }}
          BATCH_PAUSE_MIN: ${{ inputs.batch_pause_min_seconds }}
          BATCH_PAUSE_MAX: ${{ inputs.batch_pause_max_seconds }}
          FORCE: ${{ inputs.force }}
        run: bash scripts/run_twse_core_range_backfill_batch.sh

      - name: Batch summary
        if: always()
        run: |
          {
            echo '### Batch result'
            echo "- Source: ${{ matrix.source }}"
            echo "- Dates: ${{ matrix.first_date }}～${{ matrix.last_date }}"
            echo "- Source batch: ${{ matrix.batch_index }}/${{ matrix.batch_count }}"
            echo "- Global batch: ${{ matrix.global_batch_index }}/${{ matrix.global_batch_count }}"
            echo "- New commits: ${{ steps.run.outputs.changed || 'false' }}"
            echo '- Pages deployment: not triggered by this workflow'
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

  complete:
    needs: [plan, backfill]
    if: always() && github.event_name != 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Final summary
        run: |
          {
            echo '### TWSE 區間資料補齊結果'
            echo "- Planned batches: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.total_batches }}"
            echo "- Backfill result: ${{ needs.backfill.result }}"
            echo '- 正常成功日期等待 20～45 秒；batch 間等待 45～90 秒；限流或來源異常仍保留 120 秒冷卻。'
            echo '- MI_INDEX 會避開台北時間 13:30～13:45 的 TWSE ALL 查詢暫停時段。'
            echo '- 每個日期皆在重置到最新 main 後提交，降低與其他 Action push 衝突。'
            echo '- 本 Action 不呼叫 Pages，避免每個回填 commit 造成網站重複部署。'
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

  schedule-timing-summary:
    # schedule-timing-summary:v1
    name: 排程時間摘要
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Write schedule timing summary
        shell: bash
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |

            throw new Error(`Expected preliminary_earnings before formal filing: ${q2.latest_financial_information?.event_type}`);

          const historical = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('data_fundamental_events_historical/build-summary.json', 'utf8'));

name: "[01 台股資料] Calculate TWSE Margin Maintenance"

on:
  schedule:
    # 平日 21:05、22:05、23:05 台北時間，等待融資餘額與收盤價資料完成。
    - cron: '5 13 * * 1-5'
    - cron: '5 14 * * 1-5'
    - cron: '5 15 * * 1-5'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      date:
        description: 'Target date (YYYYMMDD). Leave empty to use the previous date before 08:00 Taipei time, otherwise today.'
        required: false
        default: ''

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: calculate-twse-margin-maintenance
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  calculate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Check required files and existing result
        id: check
        shell: bash
        run: |
          DATE_INPUT="${{ github.event.inputs.date }}"
          if [ -n "$DATE_INPUT" ]; then
            TARGET_DATE="$DATE_INPUT"
            DATE_SOURCE="manual input"
          else
            # Use an 08:00 Taipei cutoff: before 08:00 calculate the previous calendar day.
            TARGET_DATE=$(TZ='Asia/Taipei' date --date='8 hours ago' '+%Y%m%d')
            DATE_SOURCE="automatic Taipei 08:00 cutoff"
          fi

          if [[ ! "$TARGET_DATE" =~ ^[0-9]{8}$ ]]; then
            echo "Invalid date: $TARGET_DATE (expected YYYYMMDD)"
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "Resolved target date: $TARGET_DATE ($DATE_SOURCE)"

          MARGIN_FILE="data_twse_margin_balance/${TARGET_DATE}_twse_margin_balance.csv"
          PRICE_FILE="data_twse_mi_index/${TARGET_DATE}_twse_mi_index.json"
          ETF_FILE="data_twse/twse_industry_ETF.csv"
          OUTPUT_FILE="data_twse_margin_maintenance/${TARGET_DATE}_twse_margin_maintenance.json"

          echo "target_date=$TARGET_DATE" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "output_file=$OUTPUT_FILE" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

          if [ -f "$OUTPUT_FILE" ]; then
            echo "should_run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "Result already exists: $OUTPUT_FILE"
            exit 0
          fi

          MISSING_FILES=()
          for REQUIRED_FILE in "$MARGIN_FILE" "$PRICE_FILE" "$ETF_FILE"; do
            if [ ! -f "$REQUIRED_FILE" ]; then
              MISSING_FILES+=("$REQUIRED_FILE")
            fi
          done

          if [ "${#MISSING_FILES[@]}" -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "should_run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "Required files are not ready; calculation skipped:"
            printf '  - %s\n' "${MISSING_FILES[@]}"
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "should_run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "All required files exist; calculating $TARGET_DATE."

      - name: Setup Node.js
        if: steps.check.outputs.should_run == 'true'
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - name: Calculate TWSE margin maintenance ratio
        if: steps.check.outputs.should_run == 'true'
        run: |
          node scripts/calculate_twse_margin_maintenance.js --date "${{ steps.check.outputs.target_date }}"

      - name: Commit and push result
        if: steps.check.outputs.should_run == 'true'
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git config --local user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git add -- data_twse_margin_maintenance/

          if git diff --staged --quiet; then
            echo "No TWSE margin maintenance changes"
            exit 0
          fi

          git commit -m "chore: calculate TWSE margin maintenance ${{ steps.check.outputs.target_date }}"
          git pull --rebase origin main
          git push origin main

  schedule-timing-summary:
    # schedule-timing-summary:v1
    name: 排程時間摘要
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Write schedule timing summary
        shell: bash
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EasonLiu0913/stock_data/main/scripts/write_workflow_schedule_summary.js | node

name: "[02 外部市場] Crawl External Market Indicators"

on:
  schedule:
    # 台灣時間週二至週六 05:10、05:40、06:10、06:40、07:10、07:40。
    # 每一輪都實際抓取；盤中／尚未完整的 provisional snapshot 會保留，後續輪次持續覆蓋直到 final。
    - cron: '10 21 * * 1-5'
    - cron: '40 21 * * 1-5'
    - cron: '10 22 * * 1-5'
    - cron: '40 22 * * 1-5'
    - cron: '10 23 * * 1-5'
    - cron: '40 23 * * 1-5'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      date:
        description: '美國市場日期 YYYYMMDD；留空時依紐約時間自動判斷'
        required: false
        default: ''
      force_overwrite:
        description: '強制重新抓取並覆蓋已是 final 的同日期資料'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: crawl-external-market-indicators
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  crawl:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'

      - name: Resolve target market date
        id: target
        shell: bash
        env:
          INPUT_DATE: ${{ github.event.inputs.date || '' }}
          FORCE_OVERWRITE: ${{ github.event.inputs.force_overwrite || 'false' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -n "$INPUT_DATE" ]; then
            target=$(node scripts/crawl_external_market_indicators.js --resolve-date --date "$INPUT_DATE")
          else
            target=$(node scripts/crawl_external_market_indicators.js --resolve-date)
          fi
          echo "target_date=$target" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "force=$FORCE_OVERWRITE" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Target U.S. market date: $target"
          echo "Current New York time: $(TZ='America/New_York' date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z')"
          echo "The crawler will run regardless of market phase; provisional/intraday data is persisted and refreshed later."

      - name: Crawl external market indicators
        id: crawl
        shell: bash
        env:
          TARGET_DATE: ${{ steps.target.outputs.target_date }}
          FORCE_OVERWRITE: ${{ steps.target.outputs.force }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          args=(--date "$TARGET_DATE")
          if [ "$FORCE_OVERWRITE" != "true" ]; then
            args+=(--skip-existing)
          fi
          node scripts/crawl_external_market_indicators.js "${args[@]}"

      - name: Validate five primary indicators, market date and finality
        id: validate
        shell: bash
        env:
          EXPECTED_DATE: ${{ steps.target.outputs.target_date }}
          OUTPUT_FILE: ${{ steps.crawl.outputs.output_file }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node scripts/validate_external_market_snapshot.js \
            --expected-date "$EXPECTED_DATE" \
            --file "$OUTPUT_FILE"

      - name: Report provisional snapshot
        if: steps.validate.outputs.ready != 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo "External-market snapshot saved but is not final yet."
          echo "Expected market date: ${{ steps.target.outputs.target_date }}"
          echo "Actual primary market date: ${{ steps.validate.outputs.actual_date }}"
          echo "Agreement: ${{ steps.validate.outputs.agreement }}"
          echo "Data status: ${{ steps.validate.outputs.data_status }}"
          echo "Captured at: ${{ steps.validate.outputs.captured_at }}"
          echo "Needs refresh: ${{ steps.validate.outputs.needs_refresh }}"
          echo "A later scheduled run will crawl again and overwrite this provisional snapshot."

      - name: Generate market risk snapshot if needed
        id: risk
        if: steps.validate.outputs.ready == 'true'
        shell: bash
        env:
          MARKET_DATE: ${{ steps.validate.outputs.actual_date }}
          CRAWL_SKIPPED: ${{ steps.crawl.outputs.skipped || 'false' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          risk_file="data_market_risk/${MARKET_DATE}/market_risk_snapshot.json"
          if [ "$CRAWL_SKIPPED" = "true" ] && [ -s "$risk_file" ]; then
            echo "Market risk snapshot already exists for final external data; skipping regeneration."
            echo "skipped=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0
          fi
          node scripts/generate_market_risk_snapshot.js --date "$MARKET_DATE"
          echo "skipped=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Generate relevant files.json if needed
        if: steps.crawl.outputs.skipped != 'true' || steps.risk.outputs.skipped != 'true'
        run: node scripts/generate_file_lists.js --only data_external_market,data_market_risk

      - name: Run external market and market environment tests
        run: node --test tests/external_market_snapshot_status.test.js tests/market_environment.test.js

      - name: Write crawl summary
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          {
            echo "## External Market Crawl"
            echo ""
            echo "- Target market date: \`${{ steps.target.outputs.target_date }}\`"
            echo "- Actual market date: \`${{ steps.validate.outputs.actual_date || 'n/a' }}\`"
            echo "- Data status: \`${{ steps.validate.outputs.data_status || steps.crawl.outputs.data_status || 'unknown' }}\`"
            echo "- Final: \`${{ steps.validate.outputs.is_final || steps.crawl.outputs.is_final || 'false' }}\`"
            echo "- Needs refresh: \`${{ steps.validate.outputs.needs_refresh || steps.crawl.outputs.needs_refresh || 'unknown' }}\`"
            echo "- Captured at: \`${{ steps.validate.outputs.captured_at || 'n/a' }}\`"
            echo "- External crawl skipped because final exists: \`${{ steps.crawl.outputs.skipped || 'false' }}\`"
            echo "- Market risk regeneration skipped: \`${{ steps.risk.outputs.skipped || 'false' }}\`"
            echo "- Ready for downstream market environment: \`${{ steps.validate.outputs.ready || 'false' }}\`"
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Commit and push changes
        if: success()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add config/external_market_indicators.json config/stock_news_aliases.json data_external_market/ data_market_risk/
          if git diff --staged --quiet; then
            echo "No external market changes"
            exit 0

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          date_input='${{ inputs.date }}'
          start_input='${{ inputs.start_date }}'
          end_input='${{ inputs.end_date }}'

          if [ -n "$date_input" ] && { [ -n "$start_input" ] || [ -n "$end_input" ]; }; then
            echo 'date 不能和 start_date/end_date 同時使用。'
            exit 1
          fi

          if [ -n "$start_input" ] || [ -n "$end_input" ]; then
            [ -z "$start_input" ] && start_input="$end_input"
            [ -z "$end_input" ] && end_input="$start_input"

            echo "start_date=$start_input" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "end_date=$end_input" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

            --end '${{ needs.validate-inputs.outputs.end_date }}'

            const plan=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(0,"utf8"));
            console.error(`交易日 ${plan.trading_date_count}；已完整略過 ${plan.skipped_complete_date_count}；待抓 ${plan.pending_date_count}；批次 ${plan.matrix.include.length}`);

          batches=$(node -e 'const p=require("/tmp/fubon-plan.json"); process.stdout.write(String(p.matrix.include.length))')

          echo "pending_dates=$pending" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "batches=$batches" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

          }

          remove_incomplete_day() {
            local iso_date="$1"
            local compact="${iso_date//-/}"
            local filename="fubon_${compact}_券商分點進出明細.json"
            local destination="$FINAL_OUTPUT_DIR/$filename"

            if [ ! -f "$destination" ] || official_is_complete "$destination"; then

            fi

              git fetch origin main
              git reset --hard origin/main
              if [ ! -f "$destination" ] || official_is_complete "$destination"; then
                return 0
              fi
              rm -f "$destination"
              node scripts/generate_file_lists.js --only data_fubon_broker_details
              git add -A -- "$destination" "$FINAL_OUTPUT_DIR/files.json"
              if git diff --staged --quiet; then
                return 0
              fi
              git commit -m "🧹 Remove incomplete Fubon broker details ${compact}"
              if git push origin HEAD:main; then
                echo "✅ $iso_date 未完成正式檔已移除。"
                return 0
              fi
              echo "Delete push failed for $iso_date, retry $attempt/5..."
              sleep 5
            done
            return 1
          }

          persist_complete_day() {

            local compact="${iso_date//-/}"

              mv "$destination.tmp" "$destination"

              git add -- "$destination" "$FINAL_OUTPUT_DIR/files.json"

              --retries "${INPUT_RETRIES:-3}"
              --min-delay-ms "${INPUT_MIN_DELAY_MS:-800}"
              --max-delay-ms "${INPUT_MAX_DELAY_MS:-2500}"
              --backoff-base-ms "${INPUT_BACKOFF_BASE_MS:-5000}"
              --checkpoint-size "${INPUT_CHECKPOINT_SIZE:-100}"
            )
            if [ "$INPUT_FORCE" = 'true' ]; then args+=(--force); fi

            set +e
            node scripts/crawl_fubon_broker_date_isolated.js "${args[@]}" 2>&1 | tee "$log_file"

                completed_dates+=("$iso_date")
              else
                echo "❌ $iso_date 完整檔案已產生，但 push 失敗。"
                failed_dates+=("$iso_date:persist")
              fi
            else

            fi

          first_status=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
          status=$first_status
          echo "First crawler pass exit code: $first_status" | tee -a "$crawl_log"

          # Exit code 2 means resumable incompleteness. Run one more pass in the
          # same job so explicit no-data branches can reach the required second
          # confirmation round and transient pending branches get another chance.
          # Do not forward --force: completed CSV files must be reused.
          if [ "$first_status" = "2" ]; then
            echo "=== Automatic pending retry pass ===" | tee -a "$crawl_log"
            timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=30s 25m \
              node scripts/scraper_json_driven.js "$target" \
              2>&1 | tee -a "$crawl_log"
            status=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
            echo "Automatic retry pass exit code: $status" | tee -a "$crawl_log"
          fi

          echo "exit_code=$status" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Crawler exit code: $status"
          exit 0

      - name: Verify broker branch files
        if: steps.calendar.outputs.should_run == 'true'
        id: verify
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          set +e

          node scripts/check_fubon_brokers_trade.js "${{ steps.target.outputs.date }}" \
            2>&1 | tee /tmp/fubon-brokers-verify.log
          status=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
          echo "exit_code=$status" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Verification exit code: $status"
          exit 0

      - name: Upload partial crawl artifact
        if: always() && steps.calendar.outputs.should_run == 'true'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: fubon-brokers-trade-${{ steps.target.outputs.date }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            data_fubon_brokers_trade/${{ steps.target.outputs.date }}/
            /tmp/fubon-brokers-crawl.log
            /tmp/fubon-brokers-verify.log
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Commit and push completed and partial results
        if: always() && steps.calendar.outputs.should_run == 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          target="${{ steps.target.outputs.date }}"
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add "data_fubon_brokers_trade/${target}/"

          if git diff --staged --quiet; then
            echo "No changes to commit"
            exit 0
          fi

          current_time=$(TZ='Asia/Taipei' date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
          if [ "${{ steps.verify.outputs.exit_code }}" = "0" ]; then
            message="🏦 Complete Fubon brokers trade ${target} - ${current_time}"
          else
            message="🏦 Checkpoint partial Fubon brokers trade ${target} - ${current_time}"
          fi
          git commit -m "$message"

          if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
            echo "Unexpected uncommitted changes remain before rebase:"
            git status --short
            exit 1
          fi

          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            if git pull --rebase origin main && git push origin HEAD:main; then
              exit 0
            fi
            git rebase --abort 2>/dev/null || true
            echo "Push failed, retry ${attempt}/5..."
            sleep 5
          done

          echo "Failed to push after 5 attempts. Partial results remain available as a workflow artifact."
          exit 1

      - name: Mark incomplete crawl as failed after saving progress
        if: always() && steps.calendar.outputs.should_run == 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          crawl_status="${{ steps.crawl.outputs.exit_code }}"
          verify_status="${{ steps.verify.outputs.exit_code }}"

          if [ "$crawl_status" != "0" ] || [ "$verify_status" != "0" ]; then
            echo "Broker crawl is incomplete after the automatic retry pass, but completed CSV files and _crawl-status.json were preserved."
            echo "Crawler exit code: ${crawl_status:-unknown}"
            echo "Verification exit code: ${verify_status:-unknown}"
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "Broker crawl and verification completed successfully."

  schedule-timing-summary:
    # schedule-timing-summary:v1
    name: 排程時間摘要
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Write schedule timing summary
        shell: bash
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EasonLiu0913/stock_data/main/scripts/write_workflow_schedule_summary.js | node

      include_previous_month:

concurrency:

jobs:
  crawl:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Checkout main
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - name: Sync latest main
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git fetch origin main
          git reset --hard origin/main

      - name: Resolve revenue months
        id: months
        shell: bash
        env:
          INPUT_MONTH: ${{ inputs.revenue_month || '' }}
          INCLUDE_PREVIOUS: ${{ inputs.include_previous_month || 'false' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          explicit=false
          if [ -n "$INPUT_MONTH" ]; then
            month="$INPUT_MONTH"
            explicit=true
          else
            month=$(node -e "process.stdout.write(require('./scripts/crawl_mops_monthly_revenue').autoRevenueMonth())")
          fi
          previous=$(node -e "process.stdout.write(require('./scripts/crawl_mops_monthly_revenue').previousRevenueMonth(process.argv[1]))" "$month")
          previous_file="data_mops_monthly_revenue/$previous/monthly_revenue.json"
          if [ "$INCLUDE_PREVIOUS" = "true" ] || { [ "$explicit" = "false" ] && [ ! -s "$previous_file" ]; }; then
            months="$previous,$month"
            rebuild_from="$previous"
          else
            months="$month"
            rebuild_from="$month"
          fi
          echo "month=$month" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "months=$months" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "rebuild_from=$rebuild_from" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Target revenue months: $months"

      - name: Run parser and metadata regression tests
        run: |
          node --check scripts/crawl_mops_monthly_revenue.js
          node --check scripts/apply_mops_snapshot_policy.js
          node --check scripts/rebuild_mops_monthly_revenue_metadata.js
          node --test tests/mops_monthly_revenue.test.js

      - name: Crawl MOPS monthly revenue
        shell: bash
        env:
          MONTHS: ${{ steps.months.outputs.months }}
          FORCE_NEW_SNAPSHOT: ${{ inputs.force_new_snapshot || 'false' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          IFS=',' read -ra month_list <<< "$MONTHS"
          for month in "${month_list[@]}"; do
            node scripts/crawl_mops_monthly_revenue.js --month "$month"
            policy_args=(--month "$month")
            if [ "$FORCE_NEW_SNAPSHOT" = "true" ]; then
              policy_args+=(--force-new-snapshot)
            fi
            node scripts/apply_mops_snapshot_policy.js "${policy_args[@]}"
          done

      - name: Rebuild baseline chain metadata
        run: node scripts/rebuild_mops_monthly_revenue_metadata.js --from "${{ steps.months.outputs.rebuild_from }}"

      - name: Validate generated payload
        shell: bash
        env:
          TARGET_MONTH: ${{ steps.months.outputs.month }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node - <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const month = process.env.TARGET_MONTH;
          const file = `data_mops_monthly_revenue/${month}/monthly_revenue.json`;
          const payload = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'));
          if (payload.revenue_month !== month) throw new Error('Revenue month mismatch');
          if (!Array.isArray(payload.companies) || payload.companies.length === 0) throw new Error('No MOPS company rows were generated');
          if (!payload.companies.every((row) => /^\d{4,6}$/.test(row.stock_code))) throw new Error('Invalid stock code in MOPS payload');
          if (!['baseline_seed', 'collecting', 'likely_complete'].includes(payload.collection.status)) throw new Error('Invalid completion status');
          console.log(JSON.stringify({
            revenue_month: month,
            companies: payload.companies.length,
            report_date: payload.source.report_date,
            baseline_month: payload.collection.baseline_month,
            baseline_company_count: payload.collection.baseline_company_count,
            coverage_ratio: payload.collection.coverage_ratio,
            snapshot_count: payload.collection.snapshot_count,
            completion_status: payload.collection.status,
          }, null, 2));
          NODE

      - name: Commit verified MOPS revenue data
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add data_mops_monthly_revenue
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No MOPS monthly revenue changes"
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m "data: update MOPS monthly revenue ${{ steps.months.outputs.month }}"
          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            if git pull --rebase origin main && git push origin HEAD:main; then exit 0; fi
            git rebase --abort 2>/dev/null || true
            sleep $((attempt * 5))
          done
          exit 1

    name: 排程時間摘要
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Write schedule timing summary
        shell: bash
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EasonLiu0913/stock_data/main/scripts/write_workflow_schedule_summary.js | node

        shell: bash
        env:
          EIA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.EIA_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${EIA_API_KEY:-}" ]; then
            echo "Missing repository secret: EIA_API_KEY" >&2

        id: generate
        shell: bash

          EIA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.EIA_API_KEY }}
          INPUT_DATE: ${{ inputs.date || '' }}
          FORCE_OVERWRITE: ${{ inputs.force_overwrite || 'false' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          args=()
          if [ -n "$INPUT_DATE" ]; then
            args+=(--date "$INPUT_DATE")
          fi
          if [ "$FORCE_OVERWRITE" = "true" ]; then
            args+=(--force)
          fi

          result=$(node scripts/crawl_refined_product_tightness.js "${args[@]}")

            fi

          npm ci
          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
          
      - name: Run Crawler
        run: |
          echo "🚀 Starting crawl from index ${{ inputs.start_index }} with limit ${{ inputs.limit }}..."
          # Run the script with arguments
          node scripts/crawl_history_sma.js ${{ inputs.start_index }} ${{ inputs.limit }}
        env:
          CI: true

          echo "🔄 Merging historical SMA data into daily files..."

            git commit -m "chore: update historical SMA data (Index ${{ inputs.start_index }}-${{ inputs.limit }})"
            
            # Retry loop for push to handle race conditions
            MAX_RETRIES=5
            count=0
            success=false

              git stash --include-untracked || true

jobs:
  crawl-sma:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      target_date: ${{ steps.crawl.outputs.target_date }}
      ready: ${{ steps.crawl.outputs.ready }}
      available_sma_date: ${{ steps.crawl.outputs.available_sma_date }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:

      - name: Setup Node.js

          node-version: '24'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Cache Playwright browsers
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/ms-playwright
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-playwright-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-playwright-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Install Playwright browsers
        run: npx playwright install chromium

      - name: Validate SMA date detector and schedule resolver
        run: |
          node --check scripts/detect_latest_sma_date.js
          node scripts/detect_latest_sma_date.js --self-test
          node --check scripts/resolve_scheduled_sma_target_date.js
          node scripts/resolve_scheduled_sma_target_date.js --self-test

      - name: Resolve target date and run SMA crawler
        id: crawl
        shell: bash
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          SCHEDULE_EXPR: ${{ github.event.schedule || '' }}
          INPUT_DATE: ${{ inputs.date || '' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          ready="true"
          available_sma_date=""
          target_source="manual_current_date"
          scheduled_at_utc=""
          scheduled_at_taipei=""
          schedule_delay_minutes=""

          if [ -n "$INPUT_DATE" ]; then
            target_date="$INPUT_DATE"
            target_source="manual_explicit_date"
            echo "📅 手動目標交易日：$target_date"
          elif [ "$EVENT_NAME" = "schedule" ]; then
            schedule_json=$(node scripts/resolve_scheduled_sma_target_date.js --schedule "$SCHEDULE_EXPR" --json)
            target_date=$(node -e 'const p=JSON.parse(process.argv[1]);process.stdout.write(p.target_date);' "$schedule_json")
            scheduled_at_utc=$(node -e 'const p=JSON.parse(process.argv[1]);process.stdout.write(p.scheduled_at_utc);' "$schedule_json")
            scheduled_at_taipei=$(node -e 'const d=new Date(process.argv[1]);const p=new Intl.DateTimeFormat("zh-TW",{timeZone:"Asia/Taipei",year:"numeric",month:"2-digit",day:"2-digit",hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",hourCycle:"h23"}).formatToParts(d);const v=Object.fromEntries(p.map(x=>[x.type,x.value]));process.stdout.write(`${v.year}-${v.month}-${v.day} ${v.hour}:${v.minute}`);' "$scheduled_at_utc")
            schedule_delay_minutes=$(node -e 'const p=JSON.parse(process.argv[1]);process.stdout.write(String(p.delay_minutes));' "$schedule_json")
            target_source="scheduled_intended_date"
            echo "📅 排程原定目標交易日：$target_date"
            echo "🕒 原定排程時間（台北時間）：$scheduled_at_taipei"
            echo "⏱️ GitHub 排程延遲：約 ${schedule_delay_minutes} 分鐘"
          else
            target_date=$(TZ='Asia/Taipei' date '+%Y%m%d')
            echo "📅 手動執行、未指定日期；使用台北今天：$target_date"
          fi

          [[ "$target_date" =~ ^20[0-9]{6}$ ]] || {
            echo "Invalid SMA target date: $target_date"
            exit 1
          }

          available_sma_date=$(node scripts/detect_latest_sma_date.js)
          echo "📈 富邦最新可用 SMA 日期：$available_sma_date"

          if [ -n "$available_sma_date" ]; then
            [[ "$available_sma_date" =~ ^20[0-9]{6}$ ]] || {
              echo "Invalid available SMA date: $available_sma_date"
              exit 1
            }
          fi

          if [ "$available_sma_date" != "$target_date" ]; then
            ready="false"
          fi

          echo "target_date=$target_date" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "ready=$ready" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "available_sma_date=$available_sma_date" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

          echo "## SMA Crawl" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- 日期來源：$target_source" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- 流程目標交易日：$target_date" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if [ -n "$scheduled_at_taipei" ]; then
            echo "- 原定排程時間（台北時間）：$scheduled_at_taipei" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            echo "- GitHub 排程延遲：約 ${schedule_delay_minutes} 分鐘" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi
          if [ -n "$available_sma_date" ]; then
            echo "- 富邦最新可用 SMA 日期：$available_sma_date" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi

          if [ "$ready" != "true" ]; then
            echo "- SMA 狀態：來源尚未更新到目標交易日，本輪不爬取、不產生 5% 清單，等待下一個排程重試。" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            echo "⏭️ SMA 尚未更新到 $target_date；目前最新為 $available_sma_date。本輪安全結束。"
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "- SMA 狀態：目標日期已就緒，開始爬取。" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          node scripts/crawl_sma_data.js --date "$target_date"

        if: steps.crawl.outputs.ready == 'true'
        run: node scripts/generate_file_lists.js --only data_fubon

        run: |

          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add data_fubon/

          if git diff --staged --quiet; then

            fi
            echo "No changes to commit"
            exit 0
          fi

          if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
            echo "Unexpected uncommitted changes remain before rebase:"
            git status --short
            exit 1
          fi

          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            if git pull --rebase origin main && git push origin HEAD:main; then
              exit 0
            fi
            git rebase --abort 2>/dev/null || true
            echo "Push failed, retry ${attempt}/5..."
            sleep 5
          done

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository

jobs:
  crawl-history:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 360
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Validate dealer crawler code
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node --check scripts/crawl_history_twse_dealers.js
          node --check scripts/validate_twse_dealers.js

      - name: Crawl TWSE dealers history with semantic retry
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          target='${{ github.event.inputs.date }}'

          base_args=(
            --min-delay "${{ github.event.inputs.min_delay }}"
            --max-delay "${{ github.event.inputs.max_delay }}"
            --max-retries 2
            --rate-limit-cooldown "${{ github.event.inputs.rate_limit_cooldown }}"
            --mismatch-cooldown "${{ github.event.inputs.mismatch_cooldown }}"
          )

          if [ -n "$target" ]; then
            [[ "$target" =~ ^20[0-9]{6}$ ]] || { echo "Invalid date: $target" >&2; exit 1; }
            output="data_twse_dealers/${target}_twse_dealers.json"

            for pass in 1 2 3; do
              args=("${base_args[@]}" --date "$target")

              # Existing files are trusted only after semantic validation. An
              # invalid existing file must be overwritten even when force=false.
              force_this_pass=false
              if [ "${{ github.event.inputs.force }}" = "true" ] || [ "$pass" -gt 1 ]; then
                force_this_pass=true
              elif [ -e "$output" ] && ! node scripts/validate_twse_dealers.js "$output" "$target" >/tmp/dealer-existing-validation.json 2>&1; then
                echo "Existing dealer snapshot is invalid; forcing refresh."
                cat /tmp/dealer-existing-validation.json || true
                force_this_pass=true
              fi
              [ "$force_this_pass" = true ] && args+=(--force)

              set +e
              node scripts/crawl_history_twse_dealers.js "${args[@]}"
              crawl_status=$?
              set -e

              if [ "$crawl_status" -eq 0 ] && node scripts/validate_twse_dealers.js "$output" "$target"; then
                echo "✅ $target dealer snapshot passed semantic validation on pass $pass/3."
                break
              fi

              if [ "$pass" -eq 3 ]; then
                echo "❌ $target dealer snapshot is still incomplete after 3 passes." >&2
                [ -e "$output" ] && node scripts/validate_twse_dealers.js "$output" "$target" || true
                exit 1
              fi

              cooldown=$((30 * pass))
              echo "⏳ Dealer snapshot not ready; waiting ${cooldown}s before retry $((pass + 1))/3."
              sleep "$cooldown"
            done
          else
            args=("${base_args[@]}")
            if [ -n "${{ github.event.inputs.start_date }}" ]; then
              args+=(--start "${{ github.event.inputs.start_date }}")
            fi
            if [ -n "${{ github.event.inputs.end_date }}" ]; then
              args+=(--end "${{ github.event.inputs.end_date }}")
            fi
            if [ "${{ github.event.inputs.force }}" = "true" ]; then

          git config --local user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git add data_twse_dealers/

          if git diff --staged --quiet; then
            if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
              echo "Unexpected uncommitted changes remain even though there are no TWSE dealers changes:"
              git status --short
              exit 1
            fi
            echo "No TWSE dealers changes"
            exit 0
          fi

          CURRENT_DATE=$(TZ='Asia/Taipei' date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
          git commit -m "chore: update TWSE dealers history ${CURRENT_DATE}"

          if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
            echo "Unexpected uncommitted changes remain before rebase:"
            git status --short
            exit 1
          fi

          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            if git pull --rebase origin main && git push origin HEAD:main; then
              exit 0
            fi
            git rebase --abort 2>/dev/null || true
            echo "Push failed, retry ${attempt}/5..."
            sleep 5
          done

          echo "Failed to push TWSE dealers history after 5 attempts."
          exit 1

  schedule-timing-summary:

    name: 排程時間摘要

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Write schedule timing summary

    inputs:
      date:

      start_date:
