        required: false
        type: string
      end_date:
        description: '結束交易日 YYYYMMDD；留空使用市場圖最新交易日'
        required: false
        type: string
      max_dates:
        description: '每個 batch 最多補幾個交易日；所有 batch 會自動接續'
        required: false
        type: number
        default: 10
      min_request_delay_ms:
        description: '每次 TWSE 請求前最短隨機等待毫秒'
        required: false
        type: number
        default: 5000
      max_request_delay_ms:
        description: '每次 TWSE 請求前最長隨機等待毫秒'
        required: false
        type: number
        default: 15000
      min_date_pause_seconds:
        description: '同一 batch 內完成一個日期後最短休息秒數'
        required: false
        type: number
        default: 60
      max_date_pause_seconds:
        description: '同一 batch 內完成一個日期後最長休息秒數'
        required: false
        type: number
        default: 180
      batch_pause_min_seconds:
        description: '完成一個 batch 後最短長休息秒數'
        required: false
        type: number
        default: 120
      batch_pause_max_seconds:
        description: '完成一個 batch 後最長長休息秒數'
        required: false
        type: number
        default: 300
      force:
        description: '重新下載日期區間內已存在且有效的檔案'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/crawl-twse-institutional-investors-history.yml'
      - 'scripts/plan_twse_institutional_investors_backfill.js'
      - 'scripts/run_twse_institutional_investors_backfill_batch.sh'
      - 'scripts/crawl_history_twse_institutional_investors.js'
      - 'tests/plan_twse_institutional_investors_backfill.test.js'

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: institutional-investors-range-backfill-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && 'validation' || 'production' }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  plan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      matrix: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.matrix }}
      has_work: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.has_work }}
      total_batches: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.total_batches }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || 'main' }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Validate planner and crawler
        run: |
          node --check scripts/plan_twse_institutional_investors_backfill.js
          node --check scripts/crawl_history_twse_institutional_investors.js
          bash -n scripts/run_twse_institutional_investors_backfill_batch.sh
          node --test tests/plan_twse_institutional_investors_backfill.test.js

      - name: Plan all sequential batches
        id: plan
        shell: bash
        env:
          DATE: ${{ inputs.date }}
          START_DATE: ${{ inputs.start_date }}
          END_DATE: ${{ inputs.end_date }}
          MAX_DATES: ${{ inputs.max_dates }}
          FORCE: ${{ inputs.force }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          args=(--max-dates "${MAX_DATES:-10}")

          if [ -n "${DATE:-}" ]; then
            args+=(--date "$DATE")
          else
            [ -n "${START_DATE:-}" ] && args+=(--from "$START_DATE")
            [ -n "${END_DATE:-}" ] && args+=(--to "$END_DATE")
          fi
          [ "${FORCE:-false}" = true ] && args+=(--force)

          node scripts/plan_twse_institutional_investors_backfill.js "${args[@]}" > /tmp/institutional-plan.json
          cat /tmp/institutional-plan.json >&2

          matrix=$(node -e 'const p=require("/tmp/institutional-plan.json");process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(p.matrix))')
          total_batches=$(node -e 'const p=require("/tmp/institutional-plan.json");process.stdout.write(String(p.batch_count))')
          echo "matrix=$matrix" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "total_batches=$total_batches" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          if [ "$total_batches" -gt 0 ]; then
            echo 'has_work=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo 'has_work=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

          {
            echo '### 三大法人合併明細自動分批計畫'
            echo
            node -e '
              const p=require("/tmp/institutional-plan.json");
              console.log(`- 日期範圍：${p.from}～${p.to}`);
              console.log(`- 市場交易日：${p.required_date_count} 日`);
              console.log(`- 已完整：${p.complete_date_count} 日`);
              console.log(`- 待補或損壞：${p.missing_date_count} 日`);
              console.log(`- 目前覆蓋率：${p.estimated_date_coverage_pct}%`);
              console.log(`- 每批：${p.batch_size} 日；共 ${p.batch_count} 批`);
              console.log(`- 強制重抓：${p.force ? "是" : "否"}`);
            '
            echo
            echo '所有 batch 以 max-parallel=1 依序執行；每完成一個日期立即安全提交。'
            echo '本流程不呼叫 Pages，也沒有 workflow_run 監聽。'
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

  backfill:
    needs: plan
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' && needs.plan.outputs.has_work == 'true'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      max-parallel: 1
      matrix: ${{ fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.matrix) }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 355
    name: batch ${{ matrix.batch_index }}/${{ matrix.batch_count }} (${{ matrix.first_date }} ~ ${{ matrix.last_date }})
    steps:
      - name: Checkout latest main
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Backfill batch and commit every completed date
        id: run
        shell: bash
        env:
          BATCH_DATES: ${{ matrix.dates }}
          BATCH_INDEX: ${{ matrix.batch_index }}
          BATCH_COUNT: ${{ matrix.batch_count }}
          HAS_NEXT_BATCH: ${{ matrix.has_next }}
          MIN_DELAY: ${{ inputs.min_request_delay_ms }}
          MAX_DELAY: ${{ inputs.max_request_delay_ms }}

          BATCH_PAUSE_MIN: ${{ inputs.batch_pause_min_seconds }}

    - cron: '19 11 * * 1-5'

    - cron: '29 13 * * 1-5'

    - cron: '31 14 * * 1-5'

concurrency:

jobs:
  crawl-twse-institutional-investors:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Check existing TWSE institutional investors file
        id: existing
        shell: bash
        run: |
          DATE_INPUT="${{ github.event.inputs.date }}"
          if [ -n "$DATE_INPUT" ]; then
            TARGET_DATE="$DATE_INPUT"
          else
            # Before 03:00 Taipei time, the market data still belongs to the previous day.
            TARGET_DATE=$(TZ='Asia/Taipei' date --date='3 hours ago' '+%Y%m%d')
          fi

          OUTPUT_FILE="data_twse_institutional_investors/${TARGET_DATE}_twse_institutional_investors.json"
          echo "target_date=$TARGET_DATE" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "output_file=$OUTPUT_FILE" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

          if [ -f "$OUTPUT_FILE" ]; then
            echo "exists=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "TWSE institutional investors file already exists: $OUTPUT_FILE"
          else
            echo "exists=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Setup Node.js
        if: steps.existing.outputs.exists != 'true'
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - name: Install dependencies
        if: steps.existing.outputs.exists != 'true'
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run TWSE institutional investors crawler
        if: steps.existing.outputs.exists != 'true'
        run: |
          node scripts/crawl_twse_institutional_investors.js \
            --date "${{ steps.existing.outputs.target_date }}" \
            --max-retries 0 \
            --rate-limit-cooldown 180000

      - name: Generate TWSE institutional files.json only
        if: steps.existing.outputs.exists != 'true'
        run: node scripts/generate_file_lists.js --only data_twse_institutional_investors

      - name: Commit and push changes
        if: steps.existing.outputs.exists != 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add data_twse_institutional_investors/

          if git diff --staged --quiet; then
            if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
              echo "Unexpected uncommitted changes remain even though there are no TWSE institutional changes:"
              git status --short
              exit 1
            fi
            echo "No TWSE institutional investors changes to commit"
            exit 0
          fi

          CURRENT_DATE=$(TZ='Asia/Taipei' date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
          git commit -m "chore: update TWSE institutional investors data ${CURRENT_DATE}"

          if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
            echo "Unexpected uncommitted changes remain before rebase:"
            git status --short
            exit 1
          fi

          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            if git pull --rebase origin main && git push origin HEAD:main; then
              exit 0
            fi
            git rebase --abort 2>/dev/null || true
            echo "Push failed, retry ${attempt}/5..."
            sleep 5
          done

          echo "Failed to push TWSE institutional investors data after 5 attempts."
          exit 1

  schedule-timing-summary:
    # schedule-timing-summary:v1
    name: 排程時間摘要
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Write schedule timing summary
        shell: bash
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EasonLiu0913/stock_data/main/scripts/write_workflow_schedule_summary.js | node

permissions:

concurrency:
  group: crawl-twse-institutional-summaries
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  crawl-range:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 360
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Resolve selected institutional datasets
        id: datasets
        shell: bash
        env:
          FOREIGN_INVESTORS: ${{ inputs.foreign_investors }}
          INVESTMENT_TRUST: ${{ inputs.investment_trust }}
          DEALERS: ${{ inputs.dealers }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          SELECTED_IDS=()
          SELECTED_LABELS=()

          if [ "$FOREIGN_INVESTORS" = "true" ]; then
            SELECTED_IDS+=("TWT38U")
            SELECTED_LABELS+=("外資及陸資")
          fi
          if [ "$INVESTMENT_TRUST" = "true" ]; then
            SELECTED_IDS+=("TWT44U")
            SELECTED_LABELS+=("投信")
          fi
          if [ "$DEALERS" = "true" ]; then
            SELECTED_IDS+=("TWT43U")
            SELECTED_LABELS+=("自營商")
          fi

          if [ "${#SELECTED_IDS[@]}" -eq 0 ]; then
            SELECTED_IDS=("TWT38U" "TWT44U" "TWT43U")
            SELECTED_LABELS=("外資及陸資" "投信" "自營商")
            echo "selection_mode=default-all" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "No institution checkbox selected; defaulting to all three datasets."
          else
            echo "selection_mode=explicit" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

          IDS=$(IFS=,; echo "${SELECTED_IDS[*]}")
          LABELS=$(IFS=,; echo "${SELECTED_LABELS[*]}")
          echo "ids=$IDS" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "labels=$LABELS" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Selected datasets: $IDS ($LABELS)"

      - name: Run institutional-summary range safety tests
        id: tests
        run: |
          node --test \
            tests/crawl_twse_foreign_investors.test.js \
            tests/crawl_twse_institutional_summaries.test.js \
            tests/crawl_twse_institutional_summaries_range.test.js

      - name: Crawl TWSE institutional summaries range
        id: crawl
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        env:
          START_DATE: ${{ inputs.start_date }}
          END_DATE: ${{ inputs.end_date }}
          MIN_DELAY_MS: ${{ inputs.min_delay_ms }}
          MAX_DELAY_MS: ${{ inputs.max_delay_ms }}
          MAX_RETRIES: ${{ inputs.max_retries }}
          RETRY_COOLDOWN_MS: ${{ inputs.retry_cooldown_ms }}
          MAX_DAYS: ${{ inputs.max_days }}
          SELECTED_DATASETS: ${{ steps.datasets.outputs.ids }}
          CRAWL_LOG_FILE: ${{ runner.temp }}/twse-institutional-range-crawl.log
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          npm run crawl:twse-institutional-summaries-range -- \
            --start "$START_DATE" \
            --end "$END_DATE" \
            --min-delay "$MIN_DELAY_MS" \
            --max-delay "$MAX_DELAY_MS" \
            --max-retries "$MAX_RETRIES" \
            --retry-cooldown "$RETRY_COOLDOWN_MS" \
            --max-days "$MAX_DAYS" \
            --datasets "$SELECTED_DATASETS" \
            2>&1 | tee "$CRAWL_LOG_FILE"

      - name: Build range crawl report
        id: report
        if: >-
          always() &&
          steps.tests.outcome == 'success' &&
          (steps.crawl.outcome == 'success' || steps.crawl.outcome == 'failure')
        shell: bash
        env:
          START_DATE: ${{ inputs.start_date }}
          END_DATE: ${{ inputs.end_date }}
          CRAWL_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.crawl.outcome }}
          SELECTED_DATASETS: ${{ steps.datasets.outputs.ids }}
          SELECTED_LABELS: ${{ steps.datasets.outputs.labels }}
          SELECTION_MODE: ${{ steps.datasets.outputs.selection_mode }}
          CRAWL_LOG_FILE: ${{ runner.temp }}/twse-institutional-range-crawl.log
          REPORT_FILE: ${{ runner.temp }}/twse-institutional-range-report.json
        run: |
          node <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('node:fs');

          const logFile = process.env.CRAWL_LOG_FILE;
          const reportFile = process.env.REPORT_FILE;
          const log = fs.existsSync(logFile) ? fs.readFileSync(logFile, 'utf8') : '';
          const lines = log.split(/\r?\n/);
          const failures = [];
          const skippedNonTradingDates = [];

          for (const line of lines) {
            const failure = line.match(/^❌\s+(\d{8})\s+(\S+)\s+([^:]+):\s*(.+)$/);
            if (failure) {
              failures.push({
                targetDate: failure[1],
                endpointId: failure[2],
                label: failure[3].trim(),
                message: failure[4].trim(),
              });
              continue;
            }
            const skipped = line.match(/^⏭️\s+Skip\s+(\d{8}):/);
            if (skipped) skippedNonTradingDates.push(skipped[1]);
          }

          const summaryMatch = log.match(
            /Created=(\d+), Existing=(\d+), SkippedDates=(\d+), Requests=(\d+), Failed=(\d+)/,
          );
          const fatalLine = [...lines]
            .reverse()
            .find((line) => /^❌ Failed to crawl TWSE institutional range:/.test(line));
          const normalizedRange = log.match(
            /^📅 Range:\s*(\d{8})\s*~\s*(\d{8})\s*$/m,
          );

          const failuresByDate = new Map();
          for (const failure of failures) {
            const items = failuresByDate.get(failure.targetDate) || [];
            items.push({
              endpointId: failure.endpointId,
              label: failure.label,
              message: failure.message,
            });
            failuresByDate.set(failure.targetDate, items);
          }
          const failedDates = [...failuresByDate.keys()].sort();

          const counts = summaryMatch ? {
            created: Number(summaryMatch[1]),
            existing: Number(summaryMatch[2]),
            skipped_non_trading_dates: Number(summaryMatch[3]),
            network_requests: Number(summaryMatch[4]),
            failed: Number(summaryMatch[5]),
          } : {
            created: null,
            existing: null,
            skipped_non_trading_dates: skippedNonTradingDates.length,
            network_requests: null,
            failed: failures.length,
          };

          const report = {
            schemaVersion: 2,
            generated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
            range: {
              start: normalizedRange?.[1]
                || String(process.env.START_DATE || '').trim(),
              end: normalizedRange?.[2]
                || String(process.env.END_DATE || '').trim(),
            },
            crawl_outcome: process.env.CRAWL_OUTCOME,
            selection_mode: process.env.SELECTION_MODE,
            selected_datasets: String(process.env.SELECTED_DATASETS || '')
              .split(',')
              .filter(Boolean),
            selected_labels: String(process.env.SELECTED_LABELS || '')
              .split(',')
              .filter(Boolean),
            counts,
            skipped_non_trading_dates: [...new Set(skippedNonTradingDates)].sort(),
            failed_dates: failedDates,
            failures,
            fatal_error: fatalLine
              ? fatalLine.replace(/^❌ Failed to crawl TWSE institutional range:\s*/, '')
              : null,
            rerun_suggestions: failedDates.map((date) => ({
              start_date: date,
              end_date: date,
              failed_endpoints: failuresByDate.get(date),
            })),
          };

          fs.writeFileSync(reportFile, `${JSON.stringify(report, null, 2)}\n`, 'utf8');
          console.log(`Range report written: ${reportFile}`);
          console.log(`Failed dates: ${failedDates.join(', ') || '(none)'}`);
          NODE

      - name: Publish range crawl summary
        if: steps.report.outcome == 'success'
        shell: bash
        env:
          REPORT_FILE: ${{ runner.temp }}/twse-institutional-range-report.json
        run: |
          node <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const report = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.env.REPORT_FILE, 'utf8'));
          const escapeCell = (value) => String(value ?? '')
            .replaceAll('|', '\\|')
            .replace(/\r?\n/g, ' ');
          const countText = (value) => Number.isFinite(value) ? value : '無法統計';
          const selectionNote = report.selection_mode === 'default-all'
            ? '全部未勾，預設三個都抓'
            : '依勾選項目';
          const lines = [
            '### TWSE 三大法人區間爬取報告',
            '',
            `- 區間：${report.range.start} ～ ${report.range.end}`,
            `- 抓取法人：${report.selected_labels.join('、') || '未指定'}（${selectionNote}）`,
            `- 新增：${countText(report.counts.created)} 份；既有：${countText(report.counts.existing)} 份；失敗：${countText(report.counts.failed)} 份`,
            `- 跳過非交易日：${countText(report.counts.skipped_non_trading_dates)} 天；實際請求：${countText(report.counts.network_requests)} 次`,
            '',
          ];

          if (report.failures.length) {
            lines.push('| 失敗日期 | 端點 | 法人 | 原因 |');
            lines.push('|---|---|---|---|');
            for (const failure of report.failures) {
              lines.push(
                `| ${escapeCell(failure.targetDate)} | ${escapeCell(failure.endpointId)} | ${escapeCell(failure.label)} | ${escapeCell(failure.message)} |`,
              );
            }
            lines.push('', '#### 建議重跑');
            for (const suggestion of report.rerun_suggestions) {
              const endpoints = suggestion.failed_endpoints
                .map((item) => `${item.endpointId} ${item.label}`)
                .join('、');
              lines.push(
                `- \`start_date=${suggestion.start_date}\`、\`end_date=${suggestion.end_date}\`，並只勾選失敗法人（${endpoints}）`,
              );
            }
          } else if (report.fatal_error) {
            lines.push(`❌ 無法辨識特定失敗日期：${escapeCell(report.fatal_error)}`);
          } else {
            lines.push('✅ 沒有失敗日期，不需要重跑。');
          }

          lines.push(
            '',
            '完整 Console Log 與 JSON 報告可在本次 Action 的 Artifacts 下載。',
          );
          fs.appendFileSync(
            process.env.GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY,
            `${lines.join('\n')}\n`,
          );
          NODE

      - name: Upload range crawl records
        if: steps.report.outcome == 'success'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: twse-institutional-range-report-${{ inputs.start_date }}-${{ inputs.end_date }}
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/twse-institutional-range-crawl.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/twse-institutional-range-report.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Generate institutional-summary files.json only
        id: file_lists
        if: >-
          always() &&
          steps.tests.outcome == 'success' &&
          (steps.crawl.outcome == 'success' || steps.crawl.outcome == 'failure')
        run: |
          node scripts/generate_file_lists.js --only \
            data_twse_foreign_investors,data_twse_investment_trust,data_twse_dealers

      - name: Commit and push validated range data
        if: steps.file_lists.outcome == 'success'
        shell: bash
        env:
          START_DATE: ${{ inputs.start_date }}
          END_DATE: ${{ inputs.end_date }}
          SELECTED_LABELS: ${{ steps.datasets.outputs.labels }}
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

          git add \
            data_twse_foreign_investors \
            data_twse_investment_trust \
            data_twse_dealers
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
              echo "Unexpected uncommitted changes remain:"
              git status --short
              exit 1
            fi
            echo "No institutional-summary range changes"
            exit 0
          fi

          git commit -m \
            "chore: update TWSE institutional summaries ${START_DATE}-${END_DATE} (${SELECTED_LABELS})"

          if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
            echo "Unexpected uncommitted changes remain before rebase:"
            git status --short
            exit 1
          fi

          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            if git pull --rebase origin main && git push origin HEAD:main; then
              exit 0
            fi
            git rebase --abort 2>/dev/null || true
            echo "Range push failed; retry ${attempt}/5"
            sleep 5
          done

          echo "Range push failed after 5 attempts"
          exit 1

      - name: Report range crawl failure
        if: always() && steps.crawl.outcome == 'failure'
        shell: bash
        env:
          REPORT_FILE: ${{ runner.temp }}/twse-institutional-range-report.json
        run: |
          echo "One or more downloads failed. Valid completed files were committed."
          if [ -s "$REPORT_FILE" ]; then
            node <<'NODE'
            const fs = require('node:fs');
            const report = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.env.REPORT_FILE, 'utf8'));
            if (report.failures.length) {
              console.error('Failed downloads:');
              for (const failure of report.failures) {
                console.error(
                  `- ${failure.targetDate} ${failure.endpointId} ${failure.label}: ${failure.message}`,
                );
              }
              console.error('Suggested reruns:');
              for (const suggestion of report.rerun_suggestions) {
                const endpoints = suggestion.failed_endpoints
                  .map((item) => `${item.endpointId} ${item.label}`)
                  .join(', ');
                console.error(
                  `- start_date=${suggestion.start_date}, end_date=${suggestion.end_date}; check only ${endpoints}`,
                );
              }
            } else if (report.fatal_error) {
              console.error(`Fatal crawl error: ${report.fatal_error}`);
            }
            NODE
          else
            echo "Range report was not generated; inspect the crawl step for the fatal error."
          fi
          exit 1

  schedule-timing-summary:
    # schedule-timing-summary:v1
    name: 排程時間摘要
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Write schedule timing summary
        shell: bash
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EasonLiu0913/stock_data/main/scripts/write_workflow_schedule_summary.js | node

permissions:

concurrency:

jobs:
  crawl-twse-mi-index:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Check existing TWSE MI_INDEX file
        id: existing
        shell: bash
        run: |
          DATE_INPUT="${{ github.event.inputs.date }}"
          if [ -n "$DATE_INPUT" ]; then
            TARGET_DATE="$DATE_INPUT"
          else
            # Before 03:00 Taipei time, the market data still belongs to the previous day.
            TARGET_DATE=$(TZ='Asia/Taipei' date --date='3 hours ago' '+%Y%m%d')
          fi

          OUTPUT_FILE="data_twse_mi_index/${TARGET_DATE}_twse_mi_index.json"
          echo "target_date=$TARGET_DATE" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "output_file=$OUTPUT_FILE" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

          if [ -f "$OUTPUT_FILE" ] && node - "$OUTPUT_FILE" <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('fs');
          const file = process.argv[2];
          try {
            const payload = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'));
            const tables = Array.isArray(payload?.tables) ? payload.tables : [];
            const rowCount = tables.reduce(
              (sum, table) => sum + (Array.isArray(table?.data) ? table.data.length : 0),
              0,
            );
            if (tables.length === 0 || rowCount === 0) process.exit(1);
            console.log(`Valid TWSE MI_INDEX file: ${file} (${tables.length} tables, ${rowCount} rows)`);
          } catch (error) {
            console.error(`Invalid TWSE MI_INDEX file: ${file}: ${error.message}`);
            process.exit(1);
          }
          NODE
          then
            echo "exists=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "TWSE MI_INDEX file already exists and is valid: $OUTPUT_FILE"
          else
            echo "exists=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            if [ -f "$OUTPUT_FILE" ]; then
              echo "TWSE MI_INDEX file exists but is invalid; crawler will retry: $OUTPUT_FILE"
            else
              echo "TWSE MI_INDEX file is missing; crawler will fetch it: $OUTPUT_FILE"

        if: steps.existing.outputs.exists != 'true'
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - name: Install dependencies
        if: steps.existing.outputs.exists != 'true'
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run TWSE MI_INDEX crawler
        if: steps.existing.outputs.exists != 'true'

        run: |

      - name: Validate crawled TWSE MI_INDEX file
        if: steps.existing.outputs.exists != 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          OUTPUT_FILE="${{ steps.existing.outputs.output_file }}"
          node - "$OUTPUT_FILE" <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('fs');
          const file = process.argv[2];
          if (!fs.existsSync(file)) {
            console.error(`TWSE MI_INDEX crawler did not produce output: ${file}`);
            process.exit(1);
          }
          try {
            const payload = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'));
            const tables = Array.isArray(payload?.tables) ? payload.tables : [];
            const rowCount = tables.reduce(
              (sum, table) => sum + (Array.isArray(table?.data) ? table.data.length : 0),
              0,
            );
            if (tables.length === 0 || rowCount === 0) {
              console.error(`TWSE MI_INDEX output is invalid: ${file} (${tables.length} tables, ${rowCount} rows)`);
              process.exit(1);
            }
            console.log(`Validated TWSE MI_INDEX output: ${file} (${tables.length} tables, ${rowCount} rows)`);
          } catch (error) {
            console.error(`TWSE MI_INDEX output is not valid JSON: ${file}: ${error.message}`);
            process.exit(1);
          }
          NODE

      - name: Generate TWSE MI_INDEX files.json only
        if: steps.existing.outputs.exists != 'true'
        run: node scripts/generate_file_lists.js --only data_twse_mi_index

      - name: Commit and push changes
        if: steps.existing.outputs.exists != 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add data_twse_mi_index/

          if git diff --staged --quiet; then
            if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
              echo "Unexpected uncommitted changes remain even though there are no TWSE MI_INDEX changes:"
              git status --short
              exit 1
            fi
            echo "No TWSE MI_INDEX changes to commit"
            exit 0
          fi

          CURRENT_DATE=$(TZ='Asia/Taipei' date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
          git commit -m "chore: update TWSE MI_INDEX data ${CURRENT_DATE}"

          if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
            echo "Unexpected uncommitted changes remain before rebase:"
            git status --short
            exit 1
          fi

          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            if git pull --rebase origin main && git push origin HEAD:main; then
              exit 0
            fi
            git rebase --abort 2>/dev/null || true
            echo "Push failed, retry ${attempt}/5..."
            sleep 5
          done

          echo "Failed to push TWSE MI_INDEX data after 5 attempts."
          exit 1

  schedule-timing-summary:

    name: 排程時間摘要

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

      - name: Write schedule timing summary

name: "[06 回填修復] Crawl Wantgoo 融資融券觀測資料"

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      date:
        description: '預期資料日期（YYYYMMDD）；留空使用台灣今天'
        required: false
        default: ''
        type: string
      force:
        description: '經人工確認後覆寫同日期觀測資料'
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean
permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: crawl-wantgoo-margin-observation
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  crawl:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json

      - name: Cache Playwright browsers
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/ms-playwright
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-playwright-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-playwright-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Install Chromium
        run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium

      - name: Run Wantgoo observation safety tests
        run: node --test tests/crawl_wantgoo_margin_observation.test.js

      - name: Resolve expected date
        id: date
        shell: bash
        env:
          INPUT_DATE: ${{ inputs.date || '' }}
        run: |
          if [ -n "$INPUT_DATE" ]; then
            if ! [[ "$INPUT_DATE" =~ ^20[0-9]{6}$ ]]; then
              echo "Invalid date: $INPUT_DATE (expected YYYYMMDD)"
              exit 1
            fi
            target_date="$INPUT_DATE"
          else
            target_date=$(TZ=Asia/Taipei date +%Y%m%d)
            taipei_today=$(TZ=Asia/Taipei date +%F)
            if ! node -e '
              const { isTradingDate, loadHolidaySet } = require("./scripts/resolve_forecast_dates");
              process.exit(isTradingDate(process.argv[1], loadHolidaySet()) ? 0 : 1);
            ' "$taipei_today"; then
              echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "Skip: $taipei_today is a weekend or configured non-trading day."
              exit 0
            fi
          fi
          echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "date=$target_date" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Random request delay
        if: steps.date.outputs.run == 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: sleep $((RANDOM % 91 + 15))

      - name: Crawl Wantgoo margin observation
        if: steps.date.outputs.run == 'true'
        shell: bash
        env:
          TARGET_DATE: ${{ steps.date.outputs.date }}
          FORCE_RUN: ${{ inputs.force || false }}
        run: |
          args=(--date "$TARGET_DATE")
          if [ "$FORCE_RUN" = "true" ]; then
            args+=(--force)
          fi
          node scripts/crawl_wantgoo_margin_observation.js "${args[@]}"

      - name: Commit observation data
        if: steps.date.outputs.run == 'true'
        shell: bash
        env:
          TARGET_DATE: ${{ steps.date.outputs.date }}
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add -- data_wantgoo_margin
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No Wantgoo observation changes for $TARGET_DATE"
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m "chore: add Wantgoo margin observation $TARGET_DATE"
          if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
            echo "Unexpected uncommitted changes remain before rebase:"
            git status --short
            exit 1
          fi
          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            if git pull --rebase origin main && git push origin HEAD:main; then
              exit 0
            fi
            git rebase --abort 2>/dev/null || true
            echo "Wantgoo observation push failed; retry $attempt/5"
            sleep 5
          done
          echo "Wantgoo observation push failed after 5 attempts"
          exit 1

    # schedule-timing-summary:v1
    name: 排程時間摘要
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Write schedule timing summary
        shell: bash

name: "[05 清單] 每日漲幅 5% 以上股票"

on:
  schedule:
    # 平日 14:02、15:02、15:41 台北時間，分三次確認當日清單是否已完成
    - cron: '2 6 * * 1-5'
    - cron: '2 7 * * 1-5'
    - cron: '41 7 * * 1-5'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      date:
        description: '指定單一交易日 YYYYMMDD；留空使用最新 SMA 日期'
        required: false
        default: ''
      dates:
        description: '可選：逗號分隔多個交易日，例如 20260810,20260811；設定後優先於 date'
        required: false
        default: ''
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      date:
        description: '指定單一交易日 YYYYMMDD；留空使用最新 SMA 日期'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      dates:
        description: '可選：逗號分隔多個交易日；設定後優先於 date'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''

permissions:
  contents: write
  pages: write
  id-token: write

# SMA 正式流程由 crawl-sma.yml 透過 workflow_call 串接。
# 不再監聽 data_fubon push，避免同一份 SMA commit 同時啟動 push + workflow_call 兩份 run。
# GITHUB_TOKEN 產生的資料 commit 不會再次觸發 push workflow，因此 Pages 必須以 reusable workflow 直接接續。
concurrency:
  group: daily-gainers-over-5
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  generate:
    name: 產生每日漲幅 5% 以上清單
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      target_date: ${{ steps.generate.outputs.target_date }}
      stock_count: ${{ steps.generate.outputs.stock_count }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout generator and output only
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 1
          filter: blob:none
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            /config/daily-gainers-ai-contract.json
            /config/daily-gainers-theme-taxonomy.json
            /data_daily_gain_over_5/
            /scripts/lib/daily_gainers_ai_contract.js
            /scripts/generate_daily_gainers_over_5.js
            /scripts/build_daily_gainers_market_summary.js
            /scripts/validate_daily_gainers_market_summary.js
            /.github/workflows/

      - name: Resolve dates and materialize required SMA files
        id: resolve
        shell: bash
        env:
          INPUT_DATE: ${{ inputs.date }}
          INPUT_DATES: ${{ inputs.dates }}
          COMMIT_MESSAGE: ${{ github.event.head_commit.message }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          mapfile -t all_dates < <(
            git ls-tree -r --name-only HEAD data_fubon \
              | sed -n 's#^data_fubon/fubon_\(20[0-9]\{6\}\)_sma\.json$#\1#p' \
              | sort
          )
          if [ "${#all_dates[@]}" -lt 2 ]; then
            echo "Not enough SMA files in git tree" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

          dates_raw="${INPUT_DATES:-}"
          automatic_mode=false
          if [ -z "$dates_raw" ] && [[ "${COMMIT_MESSAGE:-}" == *"[backfill-daily-gainers-20260810-20260814]"* ]]; then
            dates_raw="20260810,20260811,20260812,20260813,20260814"
          elif [ -z "$dates_raw" ] && [ -n "${INPUT_DATE:-}" ]; then
            dates_raw="$INPUT_DATE"
          elif [ -z "$dates_raw" ]; then
            automatic_mode=true
            dates_raw="${all_dates[${#all_dates[@]}-1]}"
          fi

          taipei_today="$(TZ='Asia/Taipei' date '+%Y%m%d')"
          taipei_weekday="$(TZ='Asia/Taipei' date '+%u')"
          taipei_hhmm="$(TZ='Asia/Taipei' date '+%H%M')"
          if [ "$automatic_mode" = "true" ] \
            && [ "$taipei_weekday" -ge 1 ] \
            && [ "$taipei_weekday" -le 5 ] \
            && [ "$taipei_hhmm" -ge 1330 ] \
            && [ "$dates_raw" != "$taipei_today" ]; then
            echo "ready=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "dates=" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::warning title=今日 5% 漲幅清單尚未就緒::台北今天是 ${taipei_today}，但目前最新 SMA 日期仍是 ${dates_raw}。本次自動執行將跳過，不會重新產生前一交易日清單。"
            {
              echo "## 每日漲幅 5% 以上股票：資料尚未就緒"
              echo ""
              echo "- 台北今天：\`${taipei_today}\`"
              echo "- 最新 SMA 日期：\`${dates_raw}\`"
              echo "- 判定：**今日 SMA 尚未產生或尚未進入 main**"
              echo "- 本次處理：**跳過產生舊日期清單**"
              echo "- 後續：等待下一個排程重試，或確認 \`data_fubon/fubon_${taipei_today}_sma.json\` 已完成後手動重跑。"
            } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            exit 0
          fi

          IFS=',' read -ra requested_dates <<< "$dates_raw"
          declare -A needed=()
          for raw_date in "${requested_dates[@]}"; do
            target_date="$(echo "$raw_date" | xargs)"
            [ -n "$target_date" ] || continue
            found=-1
            for i in "${!all_dates[@]}"; do
              if [ "${all_dates[$i]}" = "$target_date" ]; then
                found=$i
                break
              fi
            done
            if [ "$found" -le 0 ]; then
              echo "SMA target or previous trading date missing: $target_date" >&2
              exit 1
            fi
            needed["${all_dates[$((found-1))]}"]=1
            needed["$target_date"]=1
          done

          patterns=(
            '/config/daily-gainers-ai-contract.json'
            '/config/daily-gainers-theme-taxonomy.json'
            '/data_daily_gain_over_5/'
            '/scripts/lib/daily_gainers_ai_contract.js'
            '/scripts/generate_daily_gainers_over_5.js'
            '/scripts/build_daily_gainers_market_summary.js'
            '/scripts/validate_daily_gainers_market_summary.js'
            '/.github/workflows/'
          )
          for d in "${!needed[@]}"; do
            patterns+=("/data_fubon/fubon_${d}_sma.json")
          done
          git sparse-checkout set --no-cone "${patterns[@]}"

          echo "ready=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "dates=$dates_raw" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Materialized SMA dates: ${!needed[*]}"

      - name: Setup Node.js
        if: steps.resolve.outputs.ready == 'true'
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'

      - name: Validate generators
        if: steps.resolve.outputs.ready == 'true'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node --check scripts/generate_daily_gainers_over_5.js
          node --check scripts/build_daily_gainers_market_summary.js
          node --check scripts/validate_daily_gainers_market_summary.js
          node scripts/generate_daily_gainers_over_5.js --self-test
          node scripts/build_daily_gainers_market_summary.js --self-test
          node scripts/validate_daily_gainers_market_summary.js --self-test

      - name: Generate daily list and preliminary market summary
        if: steps.resolve.outputs.ready == 'true'
        id: generate
        shell: bash
        env:
          RESOLVED_DATES: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.dates }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          IFS=',' read -ra requested_dates <<< "$RESOLVED_DATES"
          total_count=0
          last_date=""
          echo "## 每日漲幅 5% 以上股票" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          for raw_date in "${requested_dates[@]}"; do
            target_date="$(echo "$raw_date" | xargs)"
            [ -n "$target_date" ] || continue
            result=$(node scripts/generate_daily_gainers_over_5.js --date "$target_date")
            echo "$result"
            stock_count=$(node -e 'const p=JSON.parse(process.argv[1]);process.stdout.write(String(p.stock_count))' "$result")
            total_count=$((total_count + stock_count))
            last_date="$target_date"

            node scripts/build_daily_gainers_market_summary.js --date "$target_date"
            node scripts/validate_daily_gainers_market_summary.js --date "$target_date"
            summary_status="$(node -e "const p=require('./data_daily_gain_over_5/market-summary/${target_date}.json');process.stdout.write(String(p.status))")"

            echo "- $target_date：$stock_count 檔；Market Summary：$summary_status" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          done
          echo "target_date=$last_date" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "stock_count=$total_count" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "- 條件：收盤價相對前一個 SMA 交易日收盤價漲幅 ≥ 5%" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- 新清單會同步建立 market-summary；若最新版 Unified Analysis 尚未完成則保持 preliminary，絕不混用舊 schema。" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Commit generated list and market summary
        if: steps.resolve.outputs.ready == 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add data_daily_gain_over_5/
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No daily-gainers changes"
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m "data: update daily gainers over 5% ${{ steps.generate.outputs.target_date }}"
          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            git fetch origin main
            if git rebase origin/main && git push origin HEAD:main; then
              exit 0
            fi
            git rebase --abort 2>/dev/null || true
            sleep 5
          done
          exit 1

  validate-analysis-coverage:
    name: 檢查既有原因分析 coverage
    needs: generate
    if: needs.generate.result == 'success' && needs.generate.outputs.target_date != ''
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout latest main
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 1
      - name: Report cause-analysis coverage
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          date="${{ needs.generate.outputs.target_date }}"
          list="data_daily_gain_over_5/${date}.json"
          cause="data_daily_gain_over_5/analysis/${date}.json"
          node - "$list" "$cause" <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const listFile = process.argv[2];
          const causeFile = process.argv[3];
          const list = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(listFile, 'utf8'));
          const stocks = Array.isArray(list?.stocks) ? list.stocks : [];
          let analyses = [];
          if (fs.existsSync(causeFile)) {
            try { analyses = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(causeFile, 'utf8'))?.analyses || []; } catch {}
          }
          const expected = new Set(stocks.map(x => String(x.code || '')).filter(Boolean));
          const actual = new Set(analyses.map(x => String(x.code || '')).filter(Boolean));
          const missing = [...expected].filter(code => !actual.has(code));
          console.log(JSON.stringify({date: list.target_date || '', expected: expected.size, completed: actual.size, missing}, null, 2));
          fs.appendFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY,
            `## 5% 上漲原因 coverage\n- 日期：${list.target_date || ''}\n- 應分析：${expected.size}\n- 已分析：${actual.size}\n- 缺漏：${missing.length ? missing.join(', ') : '無'}\n`);
          NODE

  deploy:
    name: 發布每日漲幅清單到 GitHub Pages
    needs: generate
    if: needs.generate.result == 'success' && needs.generate.outputs.target_date != ''
    uses: ./.github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml
    with:
      target_date: ${{ needs.generate.outputs.target_date }}

  schedule-timing-summary:
    # schedule-timing-summary:v1
    name: 排程時間摘要
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Write schedule timing summary
        shell: bash
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EasonLiu0913/stock_data/main/scripts/write_workflow_schedule_summary.js | node

name: "[04 預測覆盤] 每日預測覆盤"

on:
  schedule:
    # GitHub cron uses UTC; Taiwan time is UTC+8.
    # Daily 14:03 Asia/Taipei = 06:03 UTC.
    - cron: '3 6 * * *'
    # Daily 14:42 Asia/Taipei = 06:42 UTC.
    - cron: '42 6 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      replay_date:
        description: '要覆盤的預測交易日 YYYYMMDD；留空自動使用最新 SMA 結果日'
        required: false
        default: ''
        type: string
      force_comparison:
        description: '同日期已有覆盤比較時仍重新產生'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      force_environment:
        description: '重新產生實際市場環境、Shadow policy 與策略覆盤'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      low_volume_threshold:
        description: '低量門檻：實際成交量 ÷ 前 20 日平均成交量'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: '0.75'

permissions:
  contents: write
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: prediction-analysis-writer
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  preflight:
    name: 檢查覆盤是否已存在
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      date: ${{ steps.check.outputs.date }}
      should_run: ${{ steps.check.outputs.should_run }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Sync to latest main commit
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git fetch origin main
          git reset --hard origin/main
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/main)"

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - name: Resolve replay date and check existing result
        id: check
        shell: bash
        env:
          DATE: ${{ inputs.replay_date }}
          FORCE_RUN: ${{ inputs.force_comparison }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node --check scripts/resolve_prediction_replay_date.js

          args=()
          date_source="最新 SMA 結果日"
          if [ -n "${DATE:-}" ]; then
            args+=(--date "$DATE")
            date_source="手動指定"
          fi

          date=$(node scripts/resolve_prediction_replay_date.js "${args[@]}")
          [[ "$date" =~ ^20[0-9]{6}$ ]] || { echo "Invalid replay date: $date"; exit 1; }

          comparison_file="data_prediction_comparisons/$date/comparison.json"
          replay_file="data_predictions/$date/replay.json"
          dashboard_file="data_predictions/$date/replay-dashboard.json"

          should_run=true
          if [ "$FORCE_RUN" != "true" ] \
            && [ -s "$comparison_file" ] \
            && [ -s "$replay_file" ] \
            && [ -s "$dashboard_file" ]; then
            should_run=false
          fi

          echo "date=$date" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "should_run=$should_run" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

          echo "## 每日預測覆盤：執行前檢查" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- 覆盤日期來源：$date_source" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- 本次覆盤日期：$date" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- V1／V2 比較結果（comparison.json）：$([ -s "$comparison_file" ] && echo '已存在' || echo '尚未產生')" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- 核心覆盤結果（replay.json）：$([ -s "$replay_file" ] && echo '已存在' || echo '尚未產生')" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- 覆盤 Dashboard 資料（replay-dashboard.json）：$([ -s "$dashboard_file" ] && echo '已存在' || echo '尚未產生')" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- 本次需要執行覆盤：$should_run" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

  replay_and_compare:
    name: 產生 V1／V2 覆盤、環境驗證與比較
    needs: preflight
    if: needs.preflight.outputs.should_run == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Sync to latest main commit
        run: |
          git fetch origin main
          git reset --hard origin/main
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/main)"

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Resolve and verify comparison date
        id: date
        shell: bash
        env:
          DATE: ${{ needs.preflight.outputs.date }}
          FORCE_RUN: ${{ inputs.force_comparison }}
          FORCE_ENVIRONMENT: ${{ inputs.force_environment }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          node --check scripts/resolve_prediction_replay_date.js
          node scripts/resolve_prediction_replay_date.js --self-test

          args=(--date "$DATE")
          date_source="preflight"

          date=$(node scripts/resolve_prediction_replay_date.js "${args[@]}")
          [[ "$date" =~ ^20[0-9]{6}$ ]] || { echo "Invalid replay date: $date"; exit 1; }

          comparison_run=true
          if [ "$FORCE_RUN" != "true" ] \
            && [ -s "data_prediction_comparisons/$date/comparison.json" ] \
            && [ -s "data_predictions/$date/replay.json" ] \
            && [ -s "data_predictions/$date/replay-dashboard.json" ]; then comparison_run=false; fi
          factor_run=false
          if [ "$comparison_run" = "true" ] || [ ! -s "data_prediction_analysis/$date/industry-factor-ranges.json" ]; then factor_run=true; fi
          volume_run=false
          if [ "$comparison_run" = "true" ] || [ ! -s "data_prediction_analysis/$date/volume-filter-impact.json" ]; then volume_run=true; fi
          environment_run=false
          if [ "$FORCE_ENVIRONMENT" = "true" ] || [ "$comparison_run" = "true" ] || [ ! -s "data_market_environment/$date/actual_market_environment.json" ]; then environment_run=true; fi
          formal_strategy_run=false
          if [ "$FORCE_ENVIRONMENT" = "true" ] || [ "$comparison_run" = "true" ] || [ "$environment_run" = "true" ] || [ ! -s "data_prediction_analysis/formal-strategy/$date.json" ]; then formal_strategy_run=true; fi
          tag_strategy_run=false
          if [ "$FORCE_ENVIRONMENT" = "true" ] || [ "$comparison_run" = "true" ] || [ "$environment_run" = "true" ] || [ ! -s "data_prediction_analysis/tag-strategy/$date.json" ]; then tag_strategy_run=true; fi
          observation_tag_run=false
          if [ "$FORCE_ENVIRONMENT" = "true" ] || [ "$comparison_run" = "true" ] || [ "$tag_strategy_run" = "true" ] || [ ! -s "data_prediction_analysis/observation-tag/$date.json" ]; then observation_tag_run=true; fi

          echo "run=$comparison_run" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "factor_run=$factor_run" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "volume_run=$volume_run" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "environment_run=$environment_run" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "formal_strategy_run=$formal_strategy_run" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "tag_strategy_run=$tag_strategy_run" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "observation_tag_run=$observation_tag_run" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "date=$date" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

          echo "## 每日預測覆盤：本次處理項目" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- 覆盤日期來源：執行前檢查（Preflight）" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- 本次覆盤日期：$date" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- 產生／更新 V1／V2 比較結果：$comparison_run" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- 產生／更新實際市場環境：$environment_run" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- 計算既有正式策略覆盤：$formal_strategy_run" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- 計算標籤組合策略覆盤：$tag_strategy_run" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- 計算觀察型風險標籤覆盤：$observation_tag_run" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Run market environment and strategy tests
        run: |
          node --check scripts/prediction_tag_strategy_engine.js
          node --check scripts/evaluate_tag_strategy_replay.js
          node --check scripts/evaluate_observation_tag_replay.js
          node --check scripts/recalculate_prediction_strategy_history.js
          node --check scripts/backfill_prediction_replay_5d_outcomes.js
          node --test \
            tests/market_environment.test.js \
            tests/formal_strategy_replay.test.js \
            tests/prediction_tag_strategy_engine.test.js \
            tests/evaluate_tag_strategy_replay.test.js \
            tests/evaluate_observation_tag_replay.test.js \
            tests/backfill_prediction_replay_5d_outcomes.test.js

      - name: Replay V1
        if: steps.date.outputs.run == 'true'
        run: node scripts/generate_prediction_replay.js --date "${{ steps.date.outputs.date }}"

      - name: Replay V2 with five evaluation angles
        if: steps.date.outputs.run == 'true'
        run: node scripts/generate_prediction_replay_v2.js --date "${{ steps.date.outputs.date }}" --cost-bps 30

      - name: Backfill five-day intraday outcomes
        id: five_day
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          result_file=$(mktemp)
          node scripts/backfill_prediction_replay_5d_outcomes.js --date "${{ steps.date.outputs.date }}" | tee "$result_file"
          changed=$(node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs");const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8"));process.stdout.write(String(Boolean(p.changed)));' "$result_file")
          status=$(node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs");const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8"));process.stdout.write(String(p.status||"unknown"));' "$result_file")
          echo "changed=$changed" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "status=$status" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          if [ "$status" = "pending_five_trading_days" ]; then
            echo "- 五日盤中績效：尚未滿 5 個交易日，暫待後續交易日補齊（本次無新資料可寫入）" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          else
            echo "- 五日盤中績效：$status（本次是否有新資料寫入：$changed）" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi

      - name: Analyze low-volume exclusion impact
        if: steps.date.outputs.volume_run == 'true'
        run: node scripts/analyze_replay_volume_filter.js --date "${{ steps.date.outputs.date }}" --low-volume-threshold "${{ inputs.low_volume_threshold }}"

      - name: Generate V1 and V2 accuracy comparison
        if: steps.date.outputs.run == 'true'
        run: node scripts/compare_prediction_versions.js --date "${{ steps.date.outputs.date }}"

      - name: Generate industry r1 r3 and 7-day RS analysis
        if: steps.date.outputs.factor_run == 'true'
        run: node scripts/analyze_replay_factor_ranges.js --date "${{ steps.date.outputs.date }}"

      - name: Generate actual market environment and compare shadow policy
        if: steps.date.outputs.environment_run == 'true'
        run: node scripts/generate_actual_market_environment.js --date "${{ steps.date.outputs.date }}"

      - name: Evaluate existing formal strategy labels
        if: steps.date.outputs.formal_strategy_run == 'true'
        run: node scripts/evaluate_formal_strategy_replay.js --date "${{ steps.date.outputs.date }}"

      - name: Evaluate registered tag strategies
        if: steps.date.outputs.tag_strategy_run == 'true' || steps.five_day.outputs.changed == 'true'
        run: node scripts/evaluate_tag_strategy_replay.js --date "${{ steps.date.outputs.date }}"

      - name: Evaluate observation-only risk tags
        if: steps.date.outputs.observation_tag_run == 'true' || steps.five_day.outputs.changed == 'true'
        run: node scripts/evaluate_observation_tag_replay.js --date "${{ steps.date.outputs.date }}"

      - name: Analyze relative leadership by market environment
        if: steps.date.outputs.environment_run == 'true' || steps.date.outputs.run == 'true'
        run: node scripts/analyze_relative_leadership_by_environment.js --date "${{ steps.date.outputs.date }}" --max-dates 30

      - name: Commit replay comparison, environment, and analyses
        if: steps.date.outputs.run == 'true' || steps.date.outputs.factor_run == 'true' || steps.date.outputs.volume_run == 'true' || steps.date.outputs.environment_run == 'true' || steps.date.outputs.formal_strategy_run == 'true' || steps.date.outputs.tag_strategy_run == 'true' || steps.date.outputs.observation_tag_run == 'true' || steps.five_day.outputs.changed == 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add data_predictions data_predictions_v2 data_prediction_comparisons data_prediction_analysis data_market_environment
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then echo "No replay, environment, or analysis changes"; exit 0; fi
          git commit -m "feat: update replay environment and analyses for ${{ steps.date.outputs.date }}"
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" || { git status --short; exit 1; }
          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            if git pull --rebase origin main && git push origin HEAD:main; then exit 0; fi
            git rebase --abort 2>/dev/null || true
            sleep 5
          done
          exit 1

  deploy_pages:
    name: 覆盤完成後發布 GitHub Pages
    needs: [preflight, replay_and_compare]
    if: needs.preflight.outputs.should_run == 'true' && needs.replay_and_compare.result == 'success'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml

  schedule-timing-summary:
    # schedule-timing-summary:v1
    name: 排程時間摘要
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Write schedule timing summary
        shell: bash
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EasonLiu0913/stock_data/main/scripts/write_workflow_schedule_summary.js | node
files..github/workflows/daily-stock-prediction:
name: '[04 預測覆盤] 每日產生股票預測'

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '52 23 * * 0-4'
    - cron: '22 0 * * 1-5'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      forecast_date:
        description: '要產生預測的交易日 YYYYMMDD；留空時依最新完整資料基準日自動推算下一交易日'
        required: false
        type: string
      force_v1:
        description: '同日期已有完整成功 V1 結果時仍重新產生'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      force_v2:
        description: '同日期已有完整成功 V2 結果時仍重新產生'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      force_environment:
        description: '覆蓋既有市場環境 Shadow snapshot'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: write
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: daily-stock-prediction
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  generate_v1:
    name: 1. 產生或沿用 V1 預測
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      target_date: ${{ steps.dates.outputs.target_date }}
      environment_hash: ${{ steps.final_state.outputs.environment_hash }}
      v1_generated: ${{ steps.dates.outputs.run }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Sync to latest main commit
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git fetch origin main
          git reset --hard origin/main
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/main)"
          echo "SOURCE_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Resolve forecast date and inspect V1 completion
        id: dates
        shell: bash
        env:
          INPUT_FORECAST_DATE: ${{ inputs.forecast_date }}
          FORCE_RUN: ${{ inputs.force_v1 }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          if [ -n "${INPUT_FORECAST_DATE:-}" ]; then
            target_date="$INPUT_FORECAST_DATE"
            date_mode="manual"
          else
            node --check scripts/resolve_latest_complete_prediction_base.js
            auto_json=$(node scripts/resolve_latest_complete_prediction_base.js --json)
            target_date=$(node -e 'const p=JSON.parse(process.argv[1]);process.stdout.write(p.forecast_target_date);' "$auto_json")
            auto_base=$(node -e 'const p=JSON.parse(process.argv[1]);process.stdout.write(p.base_trade_date);' "$auto_json")
            auto_eligible=$(node -e 'const p=JSON.parse(process.argv[1]);process.stdout.write(p.latest_eligible_base_date);' "$auto_json")
            auto_checked=$(node -e 'const p=JSON.parse(process.argv[1]);process.stdout.write(String(p.checked_candidates));' "$auto_json")
            date_mode="auto_latest_complete_base"
            echo "Auto date resolution: base=$auto_base target=$target_date latest_eligible=$auto_eligible checked=$auto_checked"
          fi

          node scripts/resolve_forecast_dates.js \
            --target-date "$target_date" \
            --github-env \
            --skip-market-context > /tmp/forecast-dates.env
          cat /tmp/forecast-dates.env >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          set -a
          source /tmp/forecast-dates.env
          set +a

          echo "target_date=$FORECAST_TARGET_DATE" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "date_mode=$date_mode" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

          manifest="data_predictions/$FORECAST_TARGET_DATE/manifest.json"
          status_file="data_predictions/$FORECAST_TARGET_DATE/generation-status.txt"
          reusable=false
          if [ "$FORCE_RUN" != "true" ] && [ -s "$manifest" ] && [ -s "$status_file" ] \
            && [ "$(tr -d '\r\n' < "$status_file")" = "success" ]; then
            if node -e "const fs=require('fs');const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1]));const d=m.forecast_date_compact||String(m.forecast_date||'').replaceAll('-','');if(d!==process.argv[2])process.exit(1);if(Number(m.generated_reports)<1)process.exit(1);if(!m.market_environment?.snapshot_hash)process.exit(1);" "$manifest" "$FORECAST_TARGET_DATE"; then
              reusable=true
            fi
          fi

          if [ "$reusable" = "true" ]; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "V1 complete; reuse $manifest"
            echo "- V1：完整，沿用既有成果；仍會繼續檢查 V2 與後續發布" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          else
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "- V1：缺少或不完整，重新產生" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi

          echo "## 每日產生股票預測" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- 日期模式：$date_mode" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- 資料基準交易日：$FORECAST_BASE_DATE_ISO" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- 預測交易日：$FORECAST_TARGET_DATE_ISO" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Ensure required external market indicators
        if: steps.dates.outputs.run == 'true'
        id: external_market
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          expected_us_date=$(node <<'NODE'
          const { weekdayAtOrBefore } = require('./scripts/market_environment_lib');
          function zonedParts(date, timeZone) {
            const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', {timeZone,year:'numeric',month:'2-digit',day:'2-digit',hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit',hourCycle:'h23'}).formatToParts(date);
            return Object.fromEntries(parts.map((part) => [part.type, part.value]));
          }
          function previousCalendarDate(compact) {
            const date = new Date(Date.UTC(Number(compact.slice(0,4)),Number(compact.slice(4,6))-1,Number(compact.slice(6,8))));
            date.setUTCDate(date.getUTCDate()-1);
            return date.toISOString().slice(0,10).replaceAll('-','');
          }
          const baseDate=String(process.env.FORECAST_BASE_DATE||'');
          if(!/^20\d{6}$/.test(baseDate)) throw new Error(`Invalid FORECAST_BASE_DATE: ${baseDate}`);
          const now=new Date(); const ny=zonedParts(now,'America/New_York'); const nyDate=`${ny.year}${ny.month}${ny.day}`;
          const hour=Number(ny.hour), minute=Number(ny.minute); const closed=hour>16||(hour===16&&minute>=30);
          const latestCompleted=weekdayAtOrBefore(closed?nyDate:previousCalendarDate(nyDate));
          const expectedFromBase=weekdayAtOrBefore(baseDate);
          process.stdout.write(expectedFromBase<latestCompleted?expectedFromBase:latestCompleted);
          NODE
          )
          [[ "$expected_us_date" =~ ^20[0-9]{6}$ ]] || exit 1
          external_file="data_external_market/$expected_us_date/external_market_indicators.json"
          risk_file="data_market_risk/$expected_us_date/market_risk_snapshot.json"
          crawled=false
          external_ready=false
          if [ -s "$external_file" ] && node scripts/validate_external_market_snapshot.js --expected-date "$expected_us_date" --file "$external_file" --strict; then
            external_ready=true
          fi
          if [ "$external_ready" != "true" ]; then
            node scripts/crawl_external_market_indicators.js --date "$expected_us_date"
            node scripts/validate_external_market_snapshot.js --expected-date "$expected_us_date" --file "$external_file" --strict
            crawled=true
          fi
          if [ "$crawled" = "true" ] || [ ! -s "$risk_file" ]; then node scripts/generate_market_risk_snapshot.js --date "$expected_us_date"; fi
          node scripts/generate_file_lists.js --only data_external_market,data_market_risk

      - name: Capture immutable prediction market context
        if: steps.dates.outputs.run == 'true'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node scripts/resolve_forecast_dates.js --target-date "$FORECAST_TARGET_DATE" --github-env --capture-market-context > /tmp/prediction-context.env
          cat /tmp/prediction-context.env >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Generate or reuse market environment snapshot
        if: steps.dates.outputs.run == 'true'
        env:
          FORCE_ENVIRONMENT: ${{ inputs.force_environment }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          args=(--forecast-date "$FORECAST_TARGET_DATE" --base-date "$FORECAST_BASE_DATE" --strict)
          if [ "$FORCE_ENVIRONMENT" = "true" ]; then args+=(--force); fi
          node scripts/generate_market_environment.js "${args[@]}"

      - name: Verify immutable market environment snapshot
        if: steps.dates.outputs.run == 'true'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          args=(--forecast-date "$FORECAST_TARGET_DATE" --base-date "$FORECAST_BASE_DATE")
          if [ "$FORECAST_TARGET_DATE" -lt "$(TZ='Asia/Taipei' date '+%Y%m%d')" ]; then args+=(--allow-historical-reconstruction); fi
          node scripts/verify_market_environment.js "${args[@]}"

      - name: Run market environment and fixed strategy tests
        if: steps.dates.outputs.run == 'true'
        run: node --test tests/market_environment.test.js tests/formal_market_strategy_tags.test.js tests/prediction_dashboard_group_sync.test.js tests/oversold_beta_rebound.test.js tests/oversold_electronics_strategy.test.js

      - name: Check required forecast files
        if: steps.dates.outputs.run == 'true'
        run: node scripts/check_forecast_required_files.js

      - name: Verify fresh source files
        if: steps.dates.outputs.run == 'true'
        run: node scripts/prepare_and_verify_forecast_inputs.js

      - name: Generate market risk snapshot
        if: steps.dates.outputs.run == 'true'
        run: node scripts/generate_market_risk_snapshot.js --date "$FORECAST_BASE_DATE"

      - name: Normalize non-trading days for this run
        if: steps.dates.outputs.run == 'true'
        run: node scripts/normalize_non_trading_days.js

      - name: Generate V1 prediction outputs
        if: steps.dates.outputs.run == 'true'
        id: generate
        shell: bash
        run: |
          mkdir -p data_predictions
          set +e
          node scripts/generate_all_stock_predictions.js > /tmp/generation.log 2>&1
          status=$?
          echo "exit_code=$status" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          generation_status=$([ "$status" -eq 0 ] && echo success || echo failed)
          forecast_dir=$(node -e "const fs=require('fs');const f='data_predictions/manifest.json';if(!fs.existsSync(f))process.exit(1);const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f));process.stdout.write(m.output_directory||'')" 2>/dev/null)
          if [ -n "$forecast_dir" ]; then
            mkdir -p "$forecast_dir"
            cp /tmp/generation.log "$forecast_dir/generation.log"
            cp .forecast-input-validation.json "$forecast_dir/input-validation.json"
            echo "$generation_status" > "$forecast_dir/generation-status.txt"
          else
            cp /tmp/generation.log data_predictions/generation.log
            cp .forecast-input-validation.json data_predictions/input-validation.json
            echo "$generation_status" > data_predictions/generation-status.txt
          fi
          exit 0

      - name: Build rebound readiness and fixed strategy registry
        if: steps.dates.outputs.run == 'true' && steps.generate.outputs.exit_code == '0'
        run: node scripts/backfill_prediction_dashboard_fields.js --date "${{ steps.dates.outputs.target_date }}"

      - name: Attach environment snapshot to V1 outputs
        if: steps.dates.outputs.run == 'true' && steps.generate.outputs.exit_code == '0'
        run: node scripts/attach_market_environment.js --date "${{ steps.dates.outputs.target_date }}" --version v1

      - name: Install market environment banner
        if: steps.dates.outputs.run == 'true' && steps.generate.outputs.exit_code == '0'
        run: node scripts/install_market_environment_ui.js

      - name: Restore temporary source normalization
        if: always() && steps.dates.outputs.run == 'true'
        run: git restore --worktree -- data_history_sma/non_trading_days.json

      - name: Generate V1 V2 HTML viewer data
        if: steps.dates.outputs.run == 'true' && steps.generate.outputs.exit_code == '0'
        run: node scripts/generate_prediction_version_ui.js --date "${{ steps.dates.outputs.target_date }}"

      - name: Commit V1 result, environment, and viewer
        if: steps.dates.outputs.run == 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add data_normalized data_external_market data_market_risk data_market_environment data_predictions data_prediction_context data_prediction_ui public/index.html public/prediction-version-dashboard.html public/prediction-dashboard.html
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then echo "No V1, external market, or environment changes"; exit 0; fi
          if [ "${{ steps.generate.outputs.exit_code }}" = "0" ]; then message="feat: regenerate verified ${FORECAST_TARGET_DATE} V1 forecasts with market environment"; else message="fix: record ${FORECAST_TARGET_DATE} V1 generation failure"; fi
          git commit -m "$message"
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" || { git status --short; exit 1; }
          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            if git pull --rebase origin main && git push origin HEAD:main; then exit 0; fi
            git rebase --abort 2>/dev/null || true
            sleep 5
          done
          exit 1

      - name: Verify final V1 completion state
        id: final_state
        shell: bash
        env:
          DATE: ${{ steps.dates.outputs.target_date }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          manifest="data_predictions/$DATE/manifest.json"
          status_file="data_predictions/$DATE/generation-status.txt"
          test -s "$manifest"
          test -s "$status_file"
          test "$(tr -d '\r\n' < "$status_file")" = "success"
          environment_hash=$(node -e "const fs=require('fs');const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1]));const d=m.forecast_date_compact||String(m.forecast_date||'').replaceAll('-','');if(d!==process.argv[2])throw Error('V1 date mismatch');if(Number(m.generated_reports)<1)throw Error('V1 has no reports');const h=m.market_environment?.snapshot_hash;if(!h)throw Error('V1 missing environment hash');process.stdout.write(h);" "$manifest" "$DATE")
          echo "environment_hash=$environment_hash" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Mark V1 generation failure
        if: steps.dates.outputs.run == 'true' && steps.generate.outputs.exit_code != '0'
        run: exit 1

  generate_v2:
    name: 2. 產生或沿用 V2 預測
    needs: generate_v1
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      v2_generated: ${{ steps.source.outputs.run }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Sync to latest main commit
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git fetch origin main
          git reset --hard origin/main
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/main)"

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Resolve and verify V1 source, then inspect V2 completion
        id: source
        shell: bash
        env:
          DATE: ${{ needs.generate_v1.outputs.target_date }}
          EXPECTED_ENV_HASH: ${{ needs.generate_v1.outputs.environment_hash }}
          FORCE_RUN: ${{ inputs.force_v2 }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          date="$DATE"
          [[ "$date" =~ ^20[0-9]{6}$ ]] || exit 1

          v1_manifest="data_predictions/$date/manifest.json"
          v1_status="data_predictions/$date/generation-status.txt"
          test -s "$v1_manifest"
          test -s "$v1_status"
          test "$(tr -d '\r\n' < "$v1_status")" = "success"
          node -e "const fs=require('fs');const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1]));const d=m.forecast_date_compact||String(m.forecast_date||'').replaceAll('-','');if(d!==process.argv[2])throw Error('V1 date mismatch');if(Number(m.generated_reports)<1)throw Error('V1 has no reports');if(m.market_environment?.snapshot_hash!==process.argv[3])throw Error('V1 environment hash mismatch');" "$v1_manifest" "$date" "$EXPECTED_ENV_HASH"

          v2_manifest="data_predictions_v2/$date/manifest.json"
          reusable=false
          if [ "$FORCE_RUN" != "true" ] && [ -s "$v2_manifest" ]; then
            if node -e "const fs=require('fs');const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1]));const d=m.forecast_date_compact||String(m.forecast_date||'').replaceAll('-','');if(d!==process.argv[2])process.exit(1);if(Number(m.generated_reports)<1)process.exit(1);if(m.market_environment?.snapshot_hash!==process.argv[3])process.exit(1);" "$v2_manifest" "$date" "$EXPECTED_ENV_HASH"; then

            fi
          fi

            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "- V2：完整，沿用既有成果" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          else

      - name: Generate V2 only

      - name: Attach environment snapshot to V2 outputs

      - name: Verify final V2 completion state
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          manifest="data_predictions_v2/${{ steps.source.outputs.date }}/manifest.json"
          test -s "$manifest"
          node -e "const fs=require('fs');const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1]));const d=m.forecast_date_compact||String(m.forecast_date||'').replaceAll('-','');if(d!==process.argv[2])throw Error('V2 date mismatch');if(Number(m.generated_reports)<1)throw Error('V2 has no reports');if(m.market_environment?.snapshot_hash!==process.argv[3])throw Error('V2 environment hash mismatch');" "$manifest" "${{ steps.source.outputs.date }}" "${{ needs.generate_v1.outputs.environment_hash }}"

      - name: Commit V2 outputs and viewer
        if: steps.source.outputs.run == 'true'
        shell: bash

          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add data_predictions_v2 data_prediction_ui data_market_environment public/index.html public/prediction-version-dashboard.html public/prediction-dashboard.html

          git commit -m "feat: publish ${{ steps.source.outputs.date }} V2 with shared market environment"
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" || { git status --short; exit 1; }
