name: "[00 網站部署] Deploy GitHub Pages"

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - "public/**"
      - "config/**"
      - "data*/**"
      - "normalized/**"
      - "scripts/generate_public_index.js"
      - "scripts/validate_public_pages.js"
      - "scripts/validate_public_index_writers.js"
      - "scripts/prepare_pages_site.sh"
      - "scripts/prepare_eps_valuation_pages_payload.js"
      - "scripts/scan_pages_dependencies.js"
      - "scripts/trim_pages_artifact.js"
      - "scripts/apply_pages_size_budget.js"
      - ".github/workflows/build-twse-market-chart.yml"
      - ".github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml"
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      target_date:
        description: "只驗證這個交易日 YYYYMMDD；留空使用最新預測日"
        required: false
        default: ""
        type: string
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      target_date:
        description: "只驗證這個交易日 YYYYMMDD；留空使用最新預測日"
        required: false
        default: ""
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

# Publication layer only: this workflow never commits repository data and always
# rebuilds from the latest main. Newer publication requests may therefore cancel
# stale Pages-only runs without losing committed data.
concurrency:
  group: github-pages
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  deploy:
    name: Deploy selective repository-root compatible site
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout only Pages source files
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 1
          filter: blob:none
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            /public/
            /config/public-page-registry.json
            /scripts/
            /.github/workflows/

      - name: Enforce canonical public page registry
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node --check scripts/generate_public_index.js
          node --check scripts/validate_public_pages.js
          node --check scripts/validate_public_index_writers.js
          node scripts/generate_public_index.js
          node scripts/generate_public_index.js --check
          node scripts/validate_public_pages.js
          node scripts/validate_public_index_writers.js

      - name: Audit every frontend data dependency
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          bash -n scripts/prepare_pages_site.sh
          node --check scripts/scan_pages_dependencies.js
          node --check scripts/trim_pages_artifact.js
          node --check scripts/apply_pages_size_budget.js
          node --check scripts/prepare_eps_valuation_pages_payload.js
          bash scripts/prepare_pages_site.sh --self-test
          node scripts/scan_pages_dependencies.js --self-test
          node scripts/trim_pages_artifact.js --self-test
          node scripts/apply_pages_size_budget.js --self-test
          node scripts/prepare_eps_valuation_pages_payload.js --self-test

          node scripts/scan_pages_dependencies.js . \
            | sort -u \
            | tee /tmp/pages-dependencies.txt
          node scripts/scan_pages_dependencies.js --json . \
            > /tmp/pages-dependency-audit.json

          for required_dependency in \
            config \
            data_prediction_analysis \
            data_fubon \
            data_twse_margin_balance \
            data_twse_institutional_investors \
            data_twse_mi_index \
            data_twse_margin_maintenance
          do
            grep -qx "$required_dependency" /tmp/pages-dependencies.txt || {
              echo "Frontend dependency was not discovered: $required_dependency" >&2
              exit 1
            }
          done

          {
            echo '/public/'
            echo '/config/public-page-registry.json'
            echo '/scripts/'
            echo '/.github/workflows/'
            while IFS= read -r dependency; do
              [ -n "$dependency" ] || continue
              object_type=$(git cat-file -t "HEAD:$dependency" 2>/dev/null || true)
              case "$object_type" in
                tree) echo "/$dependency/" ;;
                blob) echo "/$dependency" ;;
                *)
                  echo "Missing Git object for published dependency: $dependency" >&2
                  exit 1
                  ;;
              esac
            done < /tmp/pages-dependencies.txt
          } | sort -u > /tmp/pages-sparse-checkout.txt

          git sparse-checkout set --no-cone --stdin < /tmp/pages-sparse-checkout.txt

      - name: Prepare and validate complete Pages artifact
        shell: bash
        env:
          TARGET_DATE: ${{ inputs.target_date }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          bash scripts/prepare_pages_site.sh . _site "${TARGET_DATE:-}"

          while IFS= read -r dependency; do
            [ -n "$dependency" ] || continue
            [ -e "_site/$dependency" ] && continue

            source_path="$dependency"
            destination_path="_site/$dependency"
            if [ -d "$source_path" ]; then
              mkdir -p "$destination_path"
              rsync -aL "$source_path/" "$destination_path/"
            elif [ -f "$source_path" ]; then
              mkdir -p "$(dirname "$destination_path")"
              cp -L "$source_path" "$destination_path"
            else
              echo "Missing frontend dependency after sparse checkout: $dependency" >&2
              exit 1
            fi
          done < /tmp/pages-dependencies.txt

          while IFS= read -r dependency; do
            [ -n "$dependency" ] || continue
            test -e "_site/$dependency" || {
              echo "Pages artifact is missing discovered dependency: $dependency" >&2
              exit 1
            }
          done < /tmp/pages-dependencies.txt

          test -f _site/config/strategy-tag-registry.json || {
            echo 'Pages artifact is missing config/strategy-tag-registry.json.' >&2
            exit 1
          }
          test -f _site/data_prediction_analysis/strategy-snapshots/manifest.json || {
            echo 'Pages artifact is missing the strategy snapshot manifest.' >&2
            exit 1
          }
          test -f _site/data_fubon/files.json || {
            echo 'Pages artifact is missing data_fubon/files.json.' >&2
            exit 1
          }
          test -f _site/data_twse_margin_balance/files.json || {
            echo 'Pages artifact is missing data_twse_margin_balance/files.json.' >&2
            exit 1
          }
          test -f _site/data_twse_margin_balance/20260803_twse_margin_balance.csv || {
            echo 'Pages artifact is missing the requested 20260803 margin balance file.' >&2
            exit 1
          }

          node scripts/prepare_eps_valuation_pages_payload.js --site _site | tee /tmp/eps-pages-payload-summary.json
          test -s _site/data_prediction_analysis/eps-valuation/valuation-summary.json
          test -s _site/data_prediction_analysis/eps-valuation/coverage-summary.json
          test -d _site/data_prediction_analysis/eps-valuation/valuation-by-stock
          test -d _site/data_prediction_analysis/eps-valuation/coverage-by-stock

          # Stage 1: normal presentation windows and known non-public workfiles.
          node scripts/trim_pages_artifact.js --site _site | tee /tmp/pages-trim-summary.json

          # Stage 2: only when Stage 1 still exceeds 850 MiB. Tighten secondary
          # history windows and discard research-only publication copies until the
          # artifact approaches the 800 MiB operating target. Repository data is untouched.
          node scripts/apply_pages_size_budget.js \
            --site _site \
            --target-mib 800 \
            --trigger-mib 850 \
            | tee /tmp/pages-size-budget-summary.json

          test -f _site/data_fubon/files.json
          test -f _site/data_twse_mi_index/files.json
          node - <<'NODE'
          const fs=require('node:fs');
          for(const dataset of ['data_fubon','data_twse_mi_index']){
            const root=`_site/${dataset}`;
            const list=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(`${root}/files.json`,'utf8'));
            for(const file of list){
              if(file==='files.json') continue;
              if(!fs.existsSync(`${root}/${file}`)) throw new Error(`${dataset}/files.json references missing ${file}`);
            }
          }
          NODE

          # Re-check core public payload after every slimming phase so capacity
          # management cannot silently remove the minimum viable Pages contract.
          test -f _site/config/strategy-tag-registry.json
          test -f _site/data_prediction_analysis/strategy-snapshots/manifest.json
          test -s _site/data_prediction_analysis/eps-valuation/valuation-summary.json
          test -s _site/data_prediction_analysis/eps-valuation/coverage-summary.json

          dependency_count=$(grep -cve '^$' /tmp/pages-dependencies.txt || true)
          frontend_asset_count=$(find public -type f \
            \( -name '*.html' -o -name '*.js' -o -name '*.mjs' -o -name '*.css' \) \
            | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
          artifact_size=$(du -sh _site | cut -f1)
          artifact_bytes=$(du -sb _site | cut -f1)
          target_bytes=$((800 * 1024 * 1024))
          warning_bytes=$((850 * 1024 * 1024))
          maximum_bytes=$((950 * 1024 * 1024))

          echo 'Largest published roots after staged trimming:'
          du -sh _site/* 2>/dev/null | sort -hr | head -20 || true

          if [ "$artifact_bytes" -gt "$maximum_bytes" ]; then
            echo "::error::Pages artifact is ${artifact_size} after both slimming stages, above the repository safety cap of 950 MiB. GitHub Pages published sites are limited to 1 GiB."
            exit 1
          elif [ "$artifact_bytes" -gt "$warning_bytes" ]; then
            echo "::warning::Pages artifact is ${artifact_size} after Stage 2 and remains above 850 MiB. Deployment is still under the hard cap but additional secondary datasets should be reviewed."
          elif [ "$artifact_bytes" -gt "$target_bytes" ]; then
            echo "::notice::Pages artifact is ${artifact_size}; below the Stage 2 trigger but above the preferred 800 MiB operating target."
          fi

          echo "## GitHub Pages dependency audit" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- Public page registry: validated" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- Public index writer ownership: validated" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- Frontend assets scanned: $frontend_asset_count" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- Published root dependencies: $dependency_count" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- Target date: ${TARGET_DATE:-latest prediction date}" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- Artifact size after staged trimming: $artifact_size" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- Pages operating target / Stage 2 trigger / hard cap: 800 / 850 / 950 MiB" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- Stage 1 windows: fubon 10, TWSE index 8, institutional/dealer/foreign 10, normalized 4, predictions 1" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- Stage 2 windows when needed: fubon 6, TWSE index 5, institutional/dealer/foreign 6, normalized 2, prediction-analysis dates 5" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- Stage 2 secondary research cuts when still above target: momentum history/replay/research and tag-strategy recalculation" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- EPS valuation core summaries and strategy snapshot manifest are protected and revalidated after trimming" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- Repository historical data remains untouched; slimming affects only the _site publication artifact" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Configure GitHub Pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v6

      - name: Upload Pages artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v5
        with:
          name: github-pages-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: _site

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v5
        with:
          artifact_name: github-pages-${{ github.run_attempt }}

  schedule-timing-summary:
    # schedule-timing-summary:v1
    name: 排程時間摘要
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Write schedule timing summary
        shell: bash
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EasonLiu0913/stock_data/main/scripts/write_workflow_schedule_summary.js | node

name: "[07 維護更新] Audit GitHub Actions Node 24"

# Repository-wide guardrail for GitHub Actions runtime versions.
# This workflow intentionally NEVER edits or pushes .github/workflows files.
# Workflow-file migrations must be committed by a user/connector identity that
# has permission to modify GitHub Actions workflows.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/**'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/**'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: audit-github-actions-node24-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  audit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Audit for obsolete Node runtimes and official Actions
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import re
          import sys

          banned = [
              re.compile(r'actions/checkout@v[456](?:\s|$)'),
              re.compile(r'actions/setup-node@v[456](?:\s|$)'),
              re.compile(r'actions/cache(?:/(?:restore|save))?@v4(?:\s|$)'),
              re.compile(r'actions/upload-artifact@v[456](?:\s|$)'),
              re.compile(r'actions/download-artifact@v[456](?:\s|$)'),
              re.compile(r'actions/github-script@v7(?:\s|$)'),
              re.compile(r'actions/configure-pages@v5(?:\s|$)'),
              re.compile(r'actions/upload-pages-artifact@v4(?:\s|$)'),
              re.compile(r'actions/deploy-pages@v4(?:\s|$)'),
              re.compile(r'actions/setup-python@v5(?:\s|$)'),
              re.compile(r"(?m)^\s*node-version:\s*['\"]?(?:20|22)(?:\.x)?['\"]?\s*$"),
          ]

          failures = []
          official_uses = set()
          workflow_files = sorted(Path('.github/workflows').glob('*.yml')) + sorted(Path('.github/workflows').glob('*.yaml'))

          for path in workflow_files:
              text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
              for match in re.finditer(r'(?m)^\s*uses:\s*(actions/[^\s#]+)', text):
                  official_uses.add(match.group(1))
              for pattern in banned:
                  for match in pattern.finditer(text):
                      line = text.count('\n', 0, match.start()) + 1
                      failures.append(f'{path}:{line}: {match.group(0).strip()}')

          print(f'Workflow files audited: {len(workflow_files)}')
          print('Official actions found:')
          for item in sorted(official_uses):
              print(f'  {item}')

          if failures:
              print(f'\nNode 24 migration gaps found: {len(failures)}', file=sys.stderr)
              for failure in failures:
                  print(failure, file=sys.stderr)
              print('\nDo not auto-push workflow edits from this workflow.', file=sys.stderr)
              print('Apply the migration through a user/connector identity with workflow-write permission.', file=sys.stderr)
              sys.exit(1)

          print('\nNode 24 workflow audit passed.')
          PY

  schedule-timing-summary:
    # schedule-timing-summary:v1
    name: 排程時間摘要
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Write schedule timing summary
        shell: bash
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EasonLiu0913/stock_data/main/scripts/write_workflow_schedule_summary.js | node

name: "[06 回填修復] 遷移舊版 5% AI 研究到最新 Contract"

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'research_pending/daily-gainers-legacy-migration-request.json'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: migrate-legacy-daily-gainers-ai
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  migrate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      target_date: ${{ steps.request.outputs.target_date }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout current migration runtime
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 1
          filter: blob:none
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            /config/daily-gainers-ai-contract.json
            /scripts/lib/daily_gainers_ai_contract.js
            /scripts/daily_gainers_ai_contract_cli.js
            /scripts/validate_daily_gainers_ai_analysis.js
            /scripts/publish_daily_gainers_unified_analysis.js
            /scripts/migrate_legacy_daily_gainers_ai.js
            /data_daily_gain_over_5/analysis-facts/
            /data_daily_gain_over_5/analysis-ai/
            /data_daily_gain_over_5/analysis/
            /research_pending/daily-gainers-ai/
            /research_pending/daily-gainers-legacy-migration-request.json
            /.github/workflows/

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'

      - name: Resolve migration request
        id: request
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          request="research_pending/daily-gainers-legacy-migration-request.json"
          [ -s "$request" ] || { echo "Missing $request" >&2; exit 1; }
          date="$(jq -r '.target_date // empty' "$request")"
          legacy_commit="$(jq -r '.legacy_commit // empty' "$request")"
          legacy_path="$(jq -r '.legacy_path // empty' "$request")"
          [[ "$date" =~ ^20[0-9]{6}$ ]] || { echo "Invalid target_date: $date" >&2; exit 1; }
          [[ "$legacy_commit" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]] || { echo "Invalid legacy_commit" >&2; exit 1; }
          [ -n "$legacy_path" ] || { echo "legacy_path required" >&2; exit 1; }
          echo "target_date=$date" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "legacy_commit=$legacy_commit" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "legacy_path=$legacy_path" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Fetch legacy research snapshot
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          legacy_commit="${{ steps.request.outputs.legacy_commit }}"
          legacy_path="${{ steps.request.outputs.legacy_path }}"
          git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin "$legacy_commit"
          git cat-file -e "$legacy_commit:$legacy_path"
          git show "$legacy_commit:$legacy_path" > /tmp/legacy-daily-gainers.json
          node - /tmp/legacy-daily-gainers.json "${{ steps.request.outputs.target_date }}" <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const p = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[2], 'utf8'));
          if (p.target_date !== process.argv[3]) throw new Error(`legacy target_date mismatch: ${p.target_date}`);
          if (!Array.isArray(p.analyses)) throw new Error('legacy analyses missing');
          console.log(JSON.stringify({target_date:p.target_date,stocks:p.analyses.length,schema_version:p.schema_version}));
          NODE

      - name: Migrate, validate and publish using newest main
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          date="${{ steps.request.outputs.target_date }}"
          legacy_commit="${{ steps.request.outputs.legacy_commit }}"
          legacy_path="${{ steps.request.outputs.legacy_path }}"
          pending="research_pending/daily-gainers-ai/${date}.json"
          ai_published="data_daily_gain_over_5/analysis-ai/${date}.json"
          unified="data_daily_gain_over_5/analysis/${date}.json"
          facts="data_daily_gain_over_5/analysis-facts/${date}.json"
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            git fetch origin main
            git reset --hard origin/main
            git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin "$legacy_commit"
            git show "$legacy_commit:$legacy_path" > /tmp/legacy-daily-gainers.json
            [ -s "$facts" ] || { echo "Missing current facts $facts" >&2; exit 1; }
            node scripts/daily_gainers_ai_contract_cli.js assert-facts "$facts"
            node scripts/migrate_legacy_daily_gainers_ai.js /tmp/legacy-daily-gainers.json "$facts" "$pending"
            node scripts/daily_gainers_ai_contract_cli.js assert-ai "$pending"
            node scripts/validate_daily_gainers_ai_analysis.js "$date" "$pending"
            mkdir -p "$(dirname "$ai_published")"
            cp "$pending" "$ai_published"
            node scripts/publish_daily_gainers_unified_analysis.js "$date"
            node scripts/daily_gainers_ai_contract_cli.js assert-published "$unified"
            git add -- "$pending" "$ai_published" "$unified"
            if git diff --cached --quiet; then
              echo "Legacy research is already migrated to current contract"
              exit 0
            fi
            git commit -m "analysis: migrate 5% AI research ${date} to current contract"
            if git push origin HEAD:main; then
              echo "## 舊版 5% AI 研究已遷移" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
              echo "- 日期：$date" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
              echo "- Legacy commit：$legacy_commit" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
              echo "- 正式 generation_mode：ai_verified" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
              exit 0
            fi
            sleep 5
          done
          echo "Failed to push migrated AI research" >&2
          exit 1

  deploy:
    name: 發布遷移後 5% AI 研究到 GitHub Pages
    needs: migrate
    if: needs.migrate.result == 'success' && needs.migrate.outputs.target_date != ''
    uses: ./.github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml
    with:
      target_date: ${{ needs.migrate.outputs.target_date }}

  schedule-timing-summary:
    # schedule-timing-summary:v1
    name: 排程時間摘要
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Write schedule timing summary
        shell: bash
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

        type: string
      start:

        required: false
        type: string
      end:
        description: '回填結束 prediction date YYYYMMDD'
        required: false
        type: string
      replay_lookback:
        description: '每次重新刷新最近幾個訊號日的 T+1/T+3/T+5'
        required: true
        default: '10'
        type: string
  pull_request:

    paths:
      - 'scripts/momentum_history_replay.js'
      - 'scripts/run_momentum_history_replay.js'
      - 'scripts/momentum_research_summary.js'
      - 'scripts/generate_momentum_research_summary.js'
      - 'tests/momentum_history_replay.test.js'
      - 'tests/momentum_research_summary.test.js'
      - 'public/momentum-research-dashboard.html'
      - 'config/public-page-registry.json'
      - '.github/workflows/momentum-history-replay.yml'

permissions:

  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  # 這是 repository/data writer；依 AGENTS.md 不可取消進行中的未提交資料。
  group: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && format('momentum-history-replay-pr-{0}', github.event.pull_request.number) || 'momentum-history-replay-main' }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          # Validation intentionally checks the exact event SHA.
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || 'main' }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - name: Validate momentum history, replay, and research engines
        run: |
          node --check scripts/momentum_history_replay.js
          node --check scripts/run_momentum_history_replay.js
          node --check scripts/momentum_research_summary.js
          node --check scripts/generate_momentum_research_summary.js
          node --test tests/momentum_tag_features.test.js tests/momentum_history_replay.test.js tests/momentum_research_summary.test.js
      - name: Dry-run latest completed momentum prediction
        run: |
          node scripts/run_momentum_history_replay.js --latest --dry-run

    needs: validate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          # IMPORTANT: generated-data writers must start from the latest branch ref,
          # not the PR event SHA. Earlier runs may already have committed refreshed
          # deterministic JSON to the same PR branch while this run was queued.
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.ref || 'main' }}

      - name: Generate history and refresh replay outcomes

          INPUT_START: ${{ inputs.start }}
          INPUT_END: ${{ inputs.end }}

            args+=(--date "$INPUT_DATE")
          elif [ -n "${INPUT_START:-}" ] || [ -n "${INPUT_END:-}" ]; then
            [ -z "${INPUT_START:-}" ] || args+=(--start "$INPUT_START")
            [ -z "${INPUT_END:-}" ] || args+=(--end "$INPUT_END")
          else
            args+=(--latest)
          fi
          node scripts/run_momentum_history_replay.js "${args[@]}" | tee /tmp/momentum-history-replay.json
          node - <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const p = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/tmp/momentum-history-replay.json', 'utf8'));
          console.log(`Snapshot source: ${p.source}`);
          console.log(`History dates: ${p.histories.map(x => x.signal_date).join(', ') || 'none'}`);
          console.log(`Replay refreshed: ${p.refreshed_replays.length}`);
          NODE
      - name: Build Momentum research group summary
        run: node scripts/generate_momentum_research_summary.js | tee /tmp/momentum-research-summary.json
      - name: Generate and validate canonical public index
        run: |
          node scripts/generate_public_index.js
          node scripts/generate_public_index.js --check
          node scripts/validate_public_pages.js
          node scripts/validate_public_index_writers.js
      - name: Commit momentum research data with safe rebuild on branch races
        env:
          TARGET_BRANCH: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.ref || 'main' }}
          INPUT_DATE: ${{ inputs.date }}
          INPUT_START: ${{ inputs.start }}
          INPUT_END: ${{ inputs.end }}
          INPUT_LOOKBACK: ${{ inputs.replay_lookback }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'

          regenerate_from_current_branch() {
            local args=(--replay-lookback "${INPUT_LOOKBACK:-10}")
            if [ "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" = 'pull_request' ] || [ "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" = 'push' ]; then
              args+=(--latest-count 2)
            elif [ -n "${INPUT_DATE:-}" ]; then
              args+=(--date "$INPUT_DATE")
            elif [ -n "${INPUT_START:-}" ] || [ -n "${INPUT_END:-}" ]; then
              [ -z "${INPUT_START:-}" ] || args+=(--start "$INPUT_START")
              [ -z "${INPUT_END:-}" ] || args+=(--end "$INPUT_END")
            else
              args+=(--latest)
            fi

            echo "Regenerating momentum evidence from $(git rev-parse --short HEAD) on $TARGET_BRANCH"
            node scripts/run_momentum_history_replay.js "${args[@]}" | tee /tmp/momentum-history-replay.json
            node scripts/generate_momentum_research_summary.js | tee /tmp/momentum-research-summary.json
            node scripts/generate_public_index.js
            node scripts/generate_public_index.js --check
            node scripts/validate_public_pages.js
            node scripts/validate_public_index_writers.js
          }

          stage_and_commit() {
            git add data_prediction_analysis/momentum-history data_prediction_analysis/momentum-replay data_prediction_analysis/momentum-research public/index.html
            if git diff --cached --quiet; then
              echo 'No momentum research or public index changes'
              return 1
            fi
            git commit -m 'analysis: refresh momentum research evidence'
            return 0
          }

          if ! stage_and_commit; then
            exit 0
          fi

          # Generated JSON must never be rebased onto a newer branch because that
          # would make results produced from old inputs look current. If the branch
          # advances, discard the local generated commit, reset to the latest branch,
          # regenerate and revalidate from those exact inputs, then try again.
          for attempt in 1 2 3 4; do
            if git push origin HEAD:"$TARGET_BRANCH"; then
              echo "Momentum research push succeeded on attempt $attempt"
              exit 0
            fi

            echo "Push attempt $attempt rejected; refreshing $TARGET_BRANCH and rebuilding generated evidence" >&2
            git fetch origin "$TARGET_BRANCH"
            remote_sha="$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)"
            local_parent="$(git rev-parse HEAD^)"

            # If remote still equals the generation base, this was likely a transient
            # push failure rather than a branch race; keep the commit and retry.
            if [ "$remote_sha" = "$local_parent" ]; then
              sleep $((attempt * 5))
              continue
            fi

            echo "Target branch moved to ${remote_sha:0:9}; discarding stale generated commit and rebuilding from latest branch." >&2
            git reset --hard "$remote_sha"
            regenerate_from_current_branch
            if ! stage_and_commit; then
              echo 'Latest branch already contains equivalent momentum research evidence'
              exit 0
            fi
            sleep $((attempt * 5))
          done

          echo 'Failed to push freshly regenerated momentum research data after rebuild retries' >&2
          exit 1

  deploy_pages:
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
    needs: generate
    uses: ./.github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml

  schedule-timing-summary:
    # schedule-timing-summary:v1

concurrency:

jobs:

    steps:

        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:

        id: dates
        shell: bash
        env:
          INPUT_DATE: ${{ inputs.forecast_date || '' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          args=(--github-env)
          if [ -n "$INPUT_DATE" ]; then args+=(--target-date "$INPUT_DATE"); fi
          node scripts/resolve_forecast_dates.js "${args[@]}" > /tmp/environment-dates.env
          cat /tmp/environment-dates.env
          cat /tmp/environment-dates.env >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          set -a
          source /tmp/environment-dates.env
          set +a
          echo "forecast_date=$FORECAST_TARGET_DATE" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "base_date=$FORECAST_BASE_DATE" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Validate existing snapshot before retry
        id: existing
        shell: bash
        env:
          FORCE: ${{ inputs.force || 'false' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          if [ "$FORCE" = "true" ]; then
            echo "skip=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "Manual force requested; existing snapshot will not be reused."
            exit 0
          fi

          args=(--forecast-date "$FORECAST_TARGET_DATE" --base-date "$FORECAST_BASE_DATE")
          if [ "$FORECAST_TARGET_DATE" -lt "$(TZ='Asia/Taipei' date '+%Y%m%d')" ]; then
            args+=(--allow-historical-reconstruction)
          fi

          if node scripts/verify_market_environment.js "${args[@]}"; then
            echo "skip=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "Existing market environment snapshot passed the full integrity gate; retry is unnecessary."
          else
            echo "skip=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "Existing market environment snapshot is missing, incomplete, stale, or invalid; regeneration is required."

          args=(--forecast-date "$FORECAST_TARGET_DATE" --base-date "$FORECAST_BASE_DATE" --force)
          if [ "$STRICT" != "false" ]; then args+=(--strict); fi
          node scripts/generate_market_environment.js "${args[@]}"

      - name: Verify regenerated environment integrity
        if: steps.existing.outputs.skip != 'true'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          args=(--forecast-date "$FORECAST_TARGET_DATE" --base-date "$FORECAST_BASE_DATE")
          if [ "$FORECAST_TARGET_DATE" -lt "$(TZ='Asia/Taipei' date '+%Y%m%d')" ]; then
            args+=(--allow-historical-reconstruction)
          fi
          node scripts/verify_market_environment.js "${args[@]}"

        if: steps.existing.outputs.skip != 'true'
        run: node scripts/install_market_environment_ui.js

      - name: Run market environment tests
        if: steps.existing.outputs.skip != 'true'
        run: node --test tests/market_environment.test.js

      - name: Commit and push snapshot and UI
        if: steps.existing.outputs.skip != 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            if git pull --rebase origin main && git push origin HEAD:main; then exit 0; fi

            sleep 5
          done
          exit 1

      - name: Report retry decision
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          {

            if [ -n "$changed_path" ]; then
              target_date="$(basename "$changed_path" .json)"
              mode="pending_push"
            else
              target_date=""
              mode="code_or_workflow_push"
              echo "No pending AI file changed in this push; skip data publication."
              echo "target_date=" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "mode=$mode" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
            fi
          else
            hour="$(TZ='Asia/Taipei' date '+%H')"
            if [ "$hour" -lt 12 ]; then
              target_date="$(find research_pending/daily-gainers-ai -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '20??????.json' -printf '%f\n' 2>/dev/null | sed 's/\.json$//' | sort | tail -1)"
              mode="next_day_recheck"
              if [ -z "$target_date" ]; then
                echo "No pending AI synthesis exists for morning recheck"
                echo "target_date=" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
                echo "mode=$mode" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
                exit 0
              fi
            else
              target_date="$(TZ='Asia/Taipei' date '+%Y%m%d')"
              mode="same_day"
            fi
          fi
          [[ "$target_date" =~ ^20[0-9]{6}$ ]] || { echo "Invalid date: $target_date" >&2; exit 1; }
          echo "target_date=$target_date" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "mode=$mode" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Upgrade deterministic facts to current contract
        if: steps.date.outputs.target_date != ''
        id: facts
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          date="${{ steps.date.outputs.target_date }}"
          facts="data_daily_gain_over_5/analysis-facts/${date}.json"

          latest=false
          if [ -s "$facts" ] && node scripts/daily_gainers_ai_contract_cli.js facts-latest "$facts"; then
            latest=true
          fi

          if [ "$latest" != true ]; then
            echo "Facts are missing or outside current contract; regenerating ${date}"
            node --check scripts/build_daily_gainers_ai_facts.js
            node scripts/build_daily_gainers_ai_facts.js "$date"
            node scripts/daily_gainers_ai_contract_cli.js assert-facts "$facts"

            git add -- "$facts"
            if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
              git commit -m "analysis: upgrade 5% AI facts ${date} to current contract"
              pushed=false
              for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
                if git push origin HEAD:main; then
                  pushed=true
                  break
                fi
                git fetch origin main
                git reset --hard origin/main
                node scripts/build_daily_gainers_ai_facts.js "$date"
                node scripts/daily_gainers_ai_contract_cli.js assert-facts "$facts"
                git add -- "$facts"
                if git diff --cached --quiet; then
                  pushed=true
                  break
                fi
                git commit -m "analysis: upgrade 5% AI facts ${date} to current contract"
                sleep 5
              done
              [ "$pushed" = true ] || { echo "Failed to push upgraded facts" >&2; exit 1; }
            fi
          fi

          echo "latest=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Check pending AI against semantic facts snapshot
        id: pending
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          date="${{ steps.date.outputs.target_date }}"
          if [ -z "$date" ]; then
            echo "ready=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0
          fi
          facts="data_daily_gain_over_5/analysis-facts/${date}.json"
          pending="research_pending/daily-gainers-ai/${date}.json"
          ready=true
          reason="ready"
          [ -s "$facts" ] || { ready=false; reason="facts_missing"; }
          [ -s "$pending" ] || { ready=false; reason="pending_missing"; }

          if [ "$ready" = true ] && ! node scripts/daily_gainers_ai_contract_cli.js ai-latest "$pending"; then
            ready=false
            reason="pending_outdated"
          fi

          if [ "$ready" = true ]; then
            ai_time="$(node -e 'const p=require("./'"$pending"'"); process.stdout.write(String(p.generated_at||""))')"
            base_commit="$(git log --format='%H %cI' -- "$facts" | awk -v t="$ai_time" '$2 <= t && !found {print $1; found=1}')"
            if [ -z "$base_commit" ]; then
              ready=false
              reason="facts_snapshot_not_found"
            else
              tmp_base="$(mktemp)"
              git show "$base_commit:$facts" > "$tmp_base"
              if ! node - "$tmp_base" "$facts" "$pending" <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const crypto = require('node:crypto');
          const base = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[2], 'utf8'));
          const current = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[3], 'utf8'));
          const ai = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[4], 'utf8'));
          const stripVolatile = (value) => {
            if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map(stripVolatile);
            if (value && typeof value === 'object') {
              const out = {};
              for (const key of Object.keys(value).sort()) {
                if (key === 'generated_at') continue;
                out[key] = stripVolatile(value[key]);
              }
              return out;
            }
            return value;
          };
          const digest = (obj) => crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(stripVolatile(obj))).digest('hex');
          const baseHash = digest(base);
          const currentHash = digest(current);
          if (baseHash !== currentHash) {
            console.error(JSON.stringify({baseHash,currentHash}));
            process.exit(1);
          }
          if (Number(current.stock_count) !== Number(ai.stock_count)) process.exit(1);
          const factCodes = new Set((current.stocks || []).map(x => String(x.code || '')).filter(Boolean));
          const aiCodes = new Set((ai.analyses || []).map(x => String(x.code || '')).filter(Boolean));
          const missing = [...factCodes].filter(code => !aiCodes.has(code));
          const extra = [...aiCodes].filter(code => !factCodes.has(code));
          if (missing.length || extra.length || factCodes.size !== aiCodes.size) process.exit(1);
          console.log(JSON.stringify({semanticFactsHash: currentHash, stocks: factCodes.size}));
          NODE
              then
                ready=false
                reason="facts_semantically_changed_after_ai"
              fi
              rm -f "$tmp_base"
            fi
          fi

          echo "ready=$ready" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "reason=$reason" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          if [ "$ready" != true ]; then
            echo "## AI 解讀尚未可發布" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            echo "- 日期：$date" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            echo "- 模式：${{ steps.date.outputs.mode }}" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            echo "- 原因：$reason" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi

      - name: Validate pending AI schema against facts
        if: steps.pending.outputs.ready == 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          date="${{ steps.date.outputs.target_date }}"
          node --check scripts/validate_daily_gainers_ai_analysis.js
          node scripts/daily_gainers_ai_contract_cli.js assert-ai "research_pending/daily-gainers-ai/${date}.json"
          node scripts/validate_daily_gainers_ai_analysis.js "$date" "research_pending/daily-gainers-ai/${date}.json"

      - name: Promote AI, unified analysis, and market summary in one commit
        if: steps.pending.outputs.ready == 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          date="${{ steps.date.outputs.target_date }}"
          pending="research_pending/daily-gainers-ai/${date}.json"
          ai_published="data_daily_gain_over_5/analysis-ai/${date}.json"
          unified="data_daily_gain_over_5/analysis/${date}.json"
          market_summary="data_daily_gain_over_5/market-summary/${date}.json"
          market_manifest="data_daily_gain_over_5/market-summary/manifest.json"

          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            git fetch origin main
            git reset --hard origin/main
            [ -s "$pending" ] || { echo "Pending AI file disappeared before publish: $pending" >&2; exit 1; }
            node scripts/daily_gainers_ai_contract_cli.js assert-facts "data_daily_gain_over_5/analysis-facts/${date}.json"
            node scripts/daily_gainers_ai_contract_cli.js assert-ai "$pending"
            node scripts/validate_daily_gainers_ai_analysis.js "$date" "$pending"
            mkdir -p "$(dirname "$ai_published")"
            cp "$pending" "$ai_published"
            node scripts/publish_daily_gainers_unified_analysis.js "$date"
            node scripts/daily_gainers_ai_contract_cli.js assert-published "$unified"
            node scripts/build_daily_gainers_market_summary.js --date "$date"
            node scripts/validate_daily_gainers_market_summary.js --date "$date"
            node - "$market_summary" <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const file = process.argv[2];
          const summary = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'));
          if (summary.status !== 'final') throw new Error(`Expected final market summary; got ${summary.status}`);
          NODE
            git add -- "$ai_published" "$unified" "$market_summary" "$market_manifest"
            if git diff --cached --quiet; then
              echo "AI, unified analysis, and market summary are already current"
              exit 0
            fi
            git commit -m "analysis: publish unified AI research and market summary for 5% gainers ${date}"
            if git push origin HEAD:main; then
              echo "## 5% AI 研究與市場總結已驗證並發布" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
              echo "- 日期：$date" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
              echo "- AI 檔：$ai_published" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
              echo "- Unified 正式檔：$unified" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
              echo "- Market Summary：$market_summary" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
              exit 0
            fi
            sleep 5
          done
          echo "Failed to publish validated AI/unified/summary after 5 attempts" >&2
          exit 1

  deploy-pages:
    name: 發布 5% AI 研究到 GitHub Pages
    needs: validate-and-publish
    if: needs.validate-and-publish.result == 'success' && needs.validate-and-publish.outputs.publish_ready == 'true' && needs.validate-and-publish.outputs.target_date != ''
    uses: ./.github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml
    with:

  schedule-timing-summary:
    # schedule-timing-summary:v1
    name: 排程時間摘要
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Write schedule timing summary
        shell: bash
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |

concurrency:
  group: prediction-strategy-history-recalculation

jobs:
  recalculate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Sync to latest main
        run: |
          git fetch origin main
          git reset --hard origin/main

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - name: Validate strategy engine and version isolation
        run: |
          node --check scripts/prediction_tag_strategy_engine.js
          node --check scripts/strategy_tag_engine.js
          node --check scripts/apply_strategy_tag_registry.js
          node --check scripts/evaluate_tag_strategy_replay.js
          node --check scripts/recalculate_prediction_strategy_history.js
          node --test \
            tests/prediction_tag_strategy_engine.test.js \
            tests/evaluate_tag_strategy_replay.test.js \
            tests/strategy_registry_versioning.test.js

      - name: Recalculate selected registry and strategy version
        env:
          REGISTRY_FILE: ${{ inputs.registry_file }}
          STRATEGY_FAMILY: ${{ inputs.strategy_family }}
          STRATEGY_ID: ${{ inputs.strategy_id }}
          FROM_DATE: ${{ inputs.from_date }}
          TO_DATE: ${{ inputs.to_date }}
          DRY_RUN: ${{ inputs.dry_run }}
        shell: bash

jobs:

    name: 保留既有研究並補齊缺漏股票
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      target_date: ${{ steps.date.outputs.target_date }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout main
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'

      - name: Resolve target date
        id: date
        shell: bash
        env:
          INPUT_DATE: ${{ github.event.inputs.date }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          date="${INPUT_DATE:-}"
          if [ -z "$date" ]; then
            date="$(TZ='Asia/Taipei' date '+%Y%m%d')"
          fi
          [[ "$date" =~ ^20[0-9]{6}$ ]] || { echo "Invalid date: $date" >&2; exit 1; }
          echo "target_date=$date" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Validate required inputs
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          date="${{ steps.date.outputs.target_date }}"
          [ -s "data_daily_gain_over_5/${date}.json" ] || { echo "Missing daily list" >&2; exit 1; }
          [ -s "data_daily_gain_over_5/analysis/${date}.json" ] || { echo "Missing existing cause analysis" >&2; exit 1; }
          node --check scripts/backfill_daily_gainers_research.js

      - name: Generate fallback research and merge only missing codes
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          date="${{ steps.date.outputs.target_date }}"
          cause="data_daily_gain_over_5/analysis/${date}.json"
          original="$(mktemp)"
          cp "$cause" "$original"

          node scripts/backfill_daily_gainers_research.js "$date"

          node - "$date" "$original" "$cause" <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const date = process.argv[2];
          const originalPath = process.argv[3];
          const fallbackPath = process.argv[4];
          const list = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(`data_daily_gain_over_5/${date}.json`, 'utf8'));
          const original = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(originalPath, 'utf8'));
          const fallback = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(fallbackPath, 'utf8'));
          const expected = Array.isArray(list.stocks) ? list.stocks.map(x => String(x.code || '')) : [];
          const oldMap = new Map((original.analyses || []).map(x => [String(x.code || ''), x]));
          const fallbackMap = new Map((fallback.analyses || []).map(x => [String(x.code || ''), x]));
          const missingBefore = expected.filter(code => !oldMap.has(code));
          const merged = expected.map(code => oldMap.get(code) || fallbackMap.get(code)).filter(Boolean);
          const payload = {
            ...original,
            target_date: date,
            generated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
            stock_count: expected.length,
            coverage_repair: {
              repaired_at: new Date().toISOString(),
              preserved_existing_count: oldMap.size,
              filled_missing_count: missingBefore.length,
              filled_codes: missingBefore
            },
            analyses: merged
          };
          const actual = new Set(merged.map(x => String(x.code || '')));
          const missingAfter = expected.filter(code => !actual.has(code));
          const extra = [...actual].filter(code => !expected.includes(code));
          if (merged.length !== expected.length || missingAfter.length || extra.length) {
            throw new Error(`coverage repair failed: ${JSON.stringify({expected:expected.length,actual:merged.length,missingAfter,extra})}`);
          }
          fs.writeFileSync(fallbackPath, JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2) + '\n');
          console.log(JSON.stringify({date, expected: expected.length, preserved: oldMap.size, filled: missingBefore.length, filled_codes: missingBefore}, null, 2));
          fs.appendFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY,
            `## 5% 上漲原因 coverage 修復\n- 日期：${date}\n- 應有：${expected.length}\n- 保留既有：${oldMap.size}\n- 補齊缺漏：${missingBefore.length}\n- 補齊代號：${missingBefore.join(', ') || '無'}\n- 修復後：${merged.length}/${expected.length}\n`);
          NODE

          # backfill generator may refresh compatibility flow; this repair intentionally commits cause only.
          git checkout -- "data_daily_gain_over_5/analysis-flow/${date}.json" 2>/dev/null || true
          rm -f "$original"

      - name: Commit repaired cause analysis
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          date="${{ steps.date.outputs.target_date }}"
          file="data_daily_gain_over_5/analysis/${date}.json"
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add -- "$file"
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "Cause coverage already complete"
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m "analysis: repair 5% cause coverage ${date}"
          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            git fetch origin main
            if git rebase origin/main && git push origin HEAD:main; then
              exit 0
            fi
            git rebase --abort 2>/dev/null || true
            sleep 5
          done
          exit 1

  deploy:
    name: 發布修復後每日 5% 頁面
    needs: repair
    if: needs.repair.result == 'success'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml
    with:

  schedule-timing-summary:

    name: 排程時間摘要

    steps:
      - name: Write schedule timing summary

        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

              JSON.stringify(payload.selected_stock_codes) === JSON.stringify(expectedStocks) &&
              Array.isArray(payload.rows) &&
              Array.isArray(payload.stock_summaries)
            );
            const item = {
              batch_index: index + 1,
              batch_count: plan.batches.length,
              offset: batch.offset,
              batch_size: batch.batch_size,
              first_stock: batch.start_stock,
              last_stock: batch.end_stock,
              output_file: batch.output_file,
            };
            if (valid) {
              completed.push(item);
            } else {
              if (fs.existsSync(batch.output_file)) invalid.push(item);
              pending.push(item);
            }
          }

          const finalFiles = [
            'data_prediction_analysis/eps-valuation/valuation-backtest.json',
            'data_prediction_analysis/eps-valuation/coverage-report.json',
            'data_prediction_analysis/eps-valuation/formal-report-event-gap-report.json',
          ];
          const finalOutputsReady = finalFiles.every(file => {
            try { return fs.statSync(file).size > 0; } catch { return false; }
          });

          process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({
            matrix: { include: pending },
            total_stocks: plan.stock_count,
            total_batches: plan.batches.length,
            completed_batches: completed.length,
            pending_batches: pending.length,
            invalid_batches: invalid.length,
            final_outputs_ready: finalOutputsReady,
            completed,
            pending,
            invalid,
          }));
          NODE

          node - <<'NODE' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const result = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.env.RUNNER_TEMP + '/eps-resume-matrix.json', 'utf8'));
          console.log(`matrix=${JSON.stringify(result.matrix)}`);
          console.log(`has_work=${result.pending_batches > 0 ? 'true' : 'false'}`);
          console.log(`total_batches=${result.total_batches}`);
          console.log(`completed_batches=${result.completed_batches}`);
          console.log(`pending_batches=${result.pending_batches}`);
          console.log(`total_stocks=${result.total_stocks}`);
          console.log(`final_outputs_ready=${result.final_outputs_ready ? 'true' : 'false'}`);
          NODE

          stock_count=$(node -p "require('./data_prediction_analysis/eps-valuation/valuation-batch-plan.json').stock_count")
          batch_count=$(node -p "require('./data_prediction_analysis/eps-valuation/valuation-batch-plan.json').expected_batch_count")
          completed_count=$(node -p "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(process.env.RUNNER_TEMP + '/eps-resume-matrix.json','utf8')).completed_batches")
          pending_count=$(node -p "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(process.env.RUNNER_TEMP + '/eps-resume-matrix.json','utf8')).pending_batches")
          invalid_count=$(node -p "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(process.env.RUNNER_TEMP + '/eps-resume-matrix.json','utf8')).invalid_batches")
          final_ready=$(node -p "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(process.env.RUNNER_TEMP + '/eps-resume-matrix.json','utf8')).final_outputs_ready")
          {
            echo "### EPS 估值自動分批 / Resume 計畫"
            echo
            echo "- 股票：${stock_count} 檔"
            echo "- 每批：${{ inputs.batch_size }} 檔"
            echo "- 總批次：${batch_count} 批"
            echo "- 已完成且驗證有效：${completed_count} 批（自動 skip）"
            echo "- 待執行：${pending_count} 批"
            echo "- 存在但不相容 checkpoint：${invalid_count} 批（視為待執行並覆寫）"
            echo "- 正式輸出已存在：${final_ready}"
            echo "- 強制重跑 finalize：${{ inputs.force_finalize }}"
            echo "- 執行方式：max-parallel=1，只跑缺少／不相容批次；每批完成立即 commit。"
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

  backfill:
    name: "Batch ${{ matrix.batch_index }}/${{ matrix.batch_count }} · ${{ matrix.first_stock }}~${{ matrix.last_stock }}"
    needs: plan
    if: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.has_work == 'true' }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      max-parallel: 1
      matrix: ${{ fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.matrix) }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - name: Checkout latest main
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0
          filter: blob:none
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            /scripts/
            /data_finmind_quarterly_financial_quality/
            /data_fundamental_events/
            /data_twse_market_chart/
            /data_twse_mi_index/
            /data_history_sma/
            /data_fubon/
            /data_prediction_analysis/eps-valuation/

      - name: Run valuation batch with isolated stock workers
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node --check scripts/generate_eps_valuation_lab.js
          node --check scripts/run_eps_valuation_batches.js
          test -s data_prediction_analysis/eps-valuation/valuation-batch-plan.json
          node scripts/run_eps_valuation_batches.js \
            --mode batch \
            --offset "${{ matrix.offset }}" \
            --batch-size "${{ matrix.batch_size }}"
          test -s "${{ matrix.output_file }}"
          node - <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const file = process.env.BATCH_OUTPUT;
          const payload = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'));
          if (payload.dataset !== 'eps_valuation_batch_result') throw new Error('Invalid batch dataset');
          if (payload.execution_mode !== 'isolated_stock_workers') throw new Error('Batch did not use isolated stock workers');
          NODE
        env:
          BATCH_OUTPUT: ${{ matrix.output_file }}

      - name: Commit batch checkpoint
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add "${{ matrix.output_file }}"
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "Batch checkpoint already exists with identical content."
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m "research: EPS valuation batch ${{ matrix.batch_index }}/${{ matrix.batch_count }} (${{ matrix.first_stock }}-${{ matrix.last_stock }})"
          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            if git pull --rebase origin main && git push origin HEAD:main; then
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "Push failed; retry ${attempt}/5..."
            if [ "$attempt" -eq 5 ]; then exit 1; fi
            sleep $((attempt * 5))
          done

  finalize:
    name: Finalize EPS valuation research
    needs: [plan, backfill]
    if: ${{ always() && needs.plan.result == 'success' && (needs.backfill.result == 'success' || needs.backfill.result == 'skipped') && (needs.plan.outputs.has_work == 'true' || needs.plan.outputs.final_outputs_ready != 'true' || inputs.force_finalize == true) }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - name: Checkout all completed checkpoints
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0
          filter: blob:none
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            /scripts/
            /config/public-page-registry.json
            /public/
            /data_twse/twse_industry_Stock.json
            /data_finmind_quarterly_financial_quality/
            /data_fundamental_events/
            /data_twse_market_chart/
            /data_twse_mi_index/
            /data_history_sma/
            /data_fubon/
            /data_prediction_analysis/eps-valuation/

      - name: Merge batches and refresh reports
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node --check scripts/run_eps_valuation_batches.js
          node --check scripts/generate_eps_valuation_coverage.js
          node --check scripts/generate_formal_report_event_gap_report.js
          node scripts/run_eps_valuation_batches.js --mode finalize
          node scripts/generate_eps_valuation_coverage.js
          node scripts/generate_formal_report_event_gap_report.js
          test -s data_prediction_analysis/eps-valuation/valuation-backtest.json
          test -s data_prediction_analysis/eps-valuation/coverage-report.json
          test -s data_prediction_analysis/eps-valuation/formal-report-event-gap-report.json
          node - <<'NODE'
          const valuation = require('./data_prediction_analysis/eps-valuation/valuation-backtest.json');
          const coverage = require('./data_prediction_analysis/eps-valuation/coverage-report.json');
          const gap = require('./data_prediction_analysis/eps-valuation/formal-report-event-gap-report.json');
          if (!Array.isArray(valuation.formula_summary) || !Array.isArray(valuation.rows)) process.exit(1);
          if (!Array.isArray(coverage.stocks) || !coverage.summary || coverage.stocks.length !== coverage.summary.total_stocks) process.exit(1);
          if (gap.mode !== 'investigation_only' || gap.mutates_fundamental_events !== false) process.exit(1);
          console.log({
            plannedStocks: valuation.planned_stock_count,
            valuationStocks: valuation.stock_count,
            samples: valuation.sample_count,
            formulas: valuation.formula_summary.length,
            coverageStocks: coverage.summary.total_stocks,
            eligibleStocks: coverage.summary.eligible_stocks,
            directFallbackStocks: gap.summary.stocks_with_direct_fallback_candidates,
            directFallbackEvents: gap.summary.direct_fallback_candidate_events,
          });
          NODE

      - name: Regenerate homepage from canonical public page registry
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node --check scripts/generate_public_index.js
          node scripts/generate_public_index.js
          node scripts/validate_public_pages.js

      - name: Commit finalized output
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add data_prediction_analysis/eps-valuation public/index.html
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No finalized research changes."
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m "research: finalize automatic batched EPS valuation backtest"
          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            if git pull --rebase origin main && git push origin HEAD:main; then
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "Push failed; retry ${attempt}/5..."
            if [ "$attempt" -eq 5 ]; then exit 1; fi
            sleep $((attempt * 5))
          done

  deploy_pages:
    name: Deploy EPS valuation lab to GitHub Pages
    needs: [plan, finalize]
    if: ${{ always() && needs.plan.result == 'success' && (needs.finalize.result == 'success' || (needs.finalize.result == 'skipped' && needs.plan.outputs.final_outputs_ready == 'true')) }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pages: write
      id-token: write
    uses: ./.github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml
    with:
      target_date: ""

  schedule-timing-summary:
    # schedule-timing-summary:v1
    name: 排程時間摘要
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Write schedule timing summary
        shell: bash
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EasonLiu0913/stock_data/main/scripts/write_workflow_schedule_summary.js | node

name: "[06 回填修復] Retry Institutional Failed"

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '13 13 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      date:
        description: 'Target Date (YYYYMMDD format, e.g., 20260204)'

permissions:
  contents: write
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: retry-institutional
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  retry-institutional:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      is_trading_day: ${{ steps.trading-day.outputs.is_trading_day }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json

      - name: Determine target date
        id: date
        run: |
          if [ -n "${{ github.event.inputs.date }}" ]; then
            echo "target=${{ github.event.inputs.date }}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            TARGET_DATE=$(TZ='Asia/Taipei' date '+%Y%m%d')
            echo "target=${TARGET_DATE}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Check TWSE trading day
        id: trading-day
        run: node scripts/check_twse_trading_day.js --date ${{ steps.date.outputs.target }}

      - name: Cache Playwright browsers
        if: steps.trading-day.outputs.is_trading_day == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/ms-playwright
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-playwright-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-playwright-

      - name: Install dependencies
        if: steps.trading-day.outputs.is_trading_day == 'true'
        run: npm ci

      - name: Install Playwright browsers
        if: steps.trading-day.outputs.is_trading_day == 'true'
        run: npx playwright install chromium

      - name: Reconcile retry list before retry
        if: steps.trading-day.outputs.is_trading_day == 'true'
        run: |
          node --check scripts/reconcile_institutional_data.js
          node scripts/reconcile_institutional_data.js --date ${{ steps.date.outputs.target }}
          cp "data_fubon/fubon_${{ steps.date.outputs.target }}_institutional_status.json" /tmp/institutional_status_before_retry.json

      - name: Check if failed list exists
        if: steps.trading-day.outputs.is_trading_day == 'true'
        id: check
        run: |
          FAILED_FILE="data_fubon/fubon_${{ steps.date.outputs.target }}_institutional_failedList.json"
          if [ -f "$FAILED_FILE" ]; then
            COUNT=$(jq length "$FAILED_FILE")
            echo "exists=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "count=$COUNT" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "📋 Found $COUNT failed stocks to retry"
          else
            echo "exists=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "✅ No failed list found, nothing to retry"
          fi

      - name: Run Institutional retry
        if: steps.trading-day.outputs.is_trading_day == 'true' && steps.check.outputs.exists == 'true'
        run: node scripts/retry_institutional_failed.js --date ${{ steps.date.outputs.target }}

      - name: Reconcile completeness after retry
        if: steps.trading-day.outputs.is_trading_day == 'true'
        run: node scripts/reconcile_institutional_data.js --date ${{ steps.date.outputs.target }}

      - name: Write Institutional retry summary
        if: steps.trading-day.outputs.is_trading_day == 'true'
        run: node scripts/write_institutional_actions_summary.js --date ${{ steps.date.outputs.target }} --before /tmp/institutional_status_before_retry.json

      - name: Generate Fubon files.json only
        if: steps.trading-day.outputs.is_trading_day == 'true'
        run: node scripts/generate_file_lists.js --only data_fubon

      - name: Commit and push changes
        if: steps.trading-day.outputs.is_trading_day == 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add data_fubon/

          if git diff --staged --quiet; then
            if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
              echo "Unexpected uncommitted changes remain even though there are no retry-institutional changes:"
              git status --short
              exit 1
            fi
            echo "No changes to commit"
            exit 0
          fi

          CURRENT_DATE=$(TZ='Asia/Taipei' date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
          git commit -m "🔄 Retry Institutional failed stocks - ${CURRENT_DATE}"

          if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
            echo "Unexpected uncommitted changes remain before rebase:"
            git status --short
            exit 1
          fi

          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            if git pull --rebase origin main && git push origin HEAD:main; then
              exit 0
            fi
            git rebase --abort 2>/dev/null || true
            echo "Push failed, retry ${attempt}/5..."
            sleep 5
          done

          echo "Failed to push retry-institutional data after 5 attempts."
          exit 1

  deploy-pages:
    name: 法人補全後發布 GitHub Pages
    needs: retry-institutional
    if: needs.retry-institutional.result == 'success' && needs.retry-institutional.outputs.is_trading_day == 'true'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml

  schedule-timing-summary:
    # schedule-timing-summary:v1
    name: 排程時間摘要
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Write schedule timing summary
        shell: bash
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EasonLiu0913/stock_data/main/scripts/write_workflow_schedule_summary.js | node

      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

          if (!finalized.summary_file || !fs.existsSync(finalized.summary_file)) throw new Error('Round-two research summary missing');
          const payload = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(generated.output_file, 'utf8'));
          const summary = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(finalized.summary_file, 'utf8'));
          if (payload.research_id !== 'round_2_volume_margin_factor_event_study_v1') throw new Error('Unexpected research_id');

            'margin_crowding_risk_v1',

            if (!summary.summaries?.[factor]) throw new Error(`Compact summary missing: ${factor}`);
            for (const split of ['train', 'validation', 'test']) {
              if (payload.summaries[factor][split]?.event_count === undefined) {
                throw new Error(`Research split missing: ${factor}/${split}`);
              }
            }
          }
          const unknownEvent = payload.events.find(event => !factorIds.includes(event.factor_id));

          if (summary.events !== undefined) throw new Error('Compact summary must not contain event rows');

        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'

          git add data_research/strategy-factors/round-2
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo 'No round-two research changes'
            exit 0
          fi

        env:
          START_MONTH: ${{ inputs.start_month }}
          END_MONTH: ${{ inputs.end_month }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node scripts/enrich_mops_revenue_monthly_signal_long_horizons.js \
            --start-month "$START_MONTH" \
            --end-month "$END_MONTH"

      - name: Validate long-horizon coverage
        env:
          START_MONTH: ${{ inputs.start_month }}
          END_MONTH: ${{ inputs.end_month }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node - <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const path = require('node:path');
          const start = process.env.START_MONTH;
          const end = process.env.END_MONTH;
          const next = value => { let y=Number(value.slice(0,4)),m=Number(value.slice(4,6))+1;if(m===13){y++;m=1;}return `${y}${String(m).padStart(2,'0')}`; };
          let d40Complete=0,d60Complete=0,d40Pending=0,d60Pending=0;
          for(let month=start;;month=next(month)){
            const file=path.join('data_prediction_analysis','monthly-revenue','monthly-signals',`${month}.json`);
            const payload=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'));
            if(!payload.long_horizon_enrichment) throw new Error(`missing long_horizon_enrichment: ${month}`);
            for(const event of payload.events||[]){
              const a=event.returns?.d40?.status,b=event.returns?.d60?.status;
              if(a==='complete')d40Complete++; if(a==='pending_market_data')d40Pending++;
              if(b==='complete')d60Complete++; if(b==='pending_market_data')d60Pending++;
            }
            if(month===end)break;
          }
          if(d40Complete===0) throw new Error('zero mature D40 coverage');
          if(d60Complete===0) throw new Error('zero mature D60 coverage');
          console.log(JSON.stringify({d40_complete:d40Complete,d40_pending:d40Pending,d60_complete:d60Complete,d60_pending:d60Pending},null,2));

          const fs=require('node:fs');
          const f='data_prediction_analysis/quarterly-financial-quality/two-stage-fundamental-quality-long-horizon-summary.json';
          const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'));
          if(!Array.isArray(p.focus_d40_d60)||p.focus_d40_d60.length!==16) throw new Error('expected 16 D40/D60 factor rows');
          if(!(p.coverage?.d40?.complete_events>0)||!(p.coverage?.d60?.complete_events>0)) throw new Error('D40/D60 mature coverage missing');
          console.log(JSON.stringify({coverage:p.coverage,top_d40:p.focus_d40_d60.find(x=>x.horizon==='d40'),top_d60:p.focus_d40_d60.find(x=>x.horizon==='d60')},null,2));
          NODE

      - name: Commit long-horizon research outputs
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add data_prediction_analysis/monthly-revenue/monthly-signals \
                  data_prediction_analysis/quarterly-financial-quality/two-stage-fundamental-quality-long-horizon-summary.json

            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m "analysis: rebuild D40 D60 fundamental quality study"
          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            if git pull --rebase origin main && git push origin HEAD:main; then exit 0; fi
            git rebase --abort 2>/dev/null || true
            sleep $((attempt * 5))
          done
          exit 1

      - name: Summary
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo '## 基本面雙確認 D40 / D60 延伸回測' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo '- 沿用既有月營收事件 base_trading_date，不改 D1-D20' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo '- D40/D60：同一股票價格 provider + TAIEX benchmark' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo '- 未成熟月份：pending_market_data，不納入回測' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo '- 主要觀察：月營收 >=9 + 財報品質 >=10 是否從 D20 延續到 D40/D60' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

  schedule-timing-summary:
    # schedule-timing-summary:v1
    name: 排程時間摘要
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Write schedule timing summary
        shell: bash
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EasonLiu0913/stock_data/main/scripts/write_workflow_schedule_summary.js | node
