permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: two-stage-fundamental-quality-robustness
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  robustness:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Checkout main
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Sync latest main
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git fetch origin main
          git reset --hard origin/main

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - name: Validate scripts
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node --check scripts/summarize_two_stage_fundamental_quality_robustness.js
          node --check scripts/summarize_two_stage_fundamental_quality_long_horizons.js
          node --check scripts/summarize_mops_revenue_market_regime_breakdown.js

      - name: Validate existing D20 D40 D60 coverage
        env:
          START_MONTH: ${{ inputs.start_month }}
          END_MONTH: ${{ inputs.end_month }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node - <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const path = require('node:path');
          const start = process.env.START_MONTH;
          const end = process.env.END_MONTH;
          const root = path.join('data_prediction_analysis','monthly-revenue','monthly-signals');
          const months = fs.readdirSync(root)
            .filter(n => /^20\d{4}\.json$/.test(n))
            .map(n => n.slice(0,6))
            .filter(m => m >= start && m <= end)
            .sort();
          const coverage = { d20: 0, d40: 0, d60: 0 };
          for (const month of months) {
            const payload = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, `${month}.json`), 'utf8'));
            for (const event of payload.events || []) {
              for (const h of Object.keys(coverage)) {
                if (event.returns?.[h]?.status === 'complete') coverage[h]++;
              }
            }
          }
          for (const h of Object.keys(coverage)) {
            if (!(coverage[h] > 0)) throw new Error(`zero mature ${h} coverage; run the D40-D60 extension study first`);
          }
          console.log(JSON.stringify({ months: months.length, coverage }, null, 2));
          NODE

      - name: Build robustness breakdown
        env:
          START_MONTH: ${{ inputs.start_month }}
          END_MONTH: ${{ inputs.end_month }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node scripts/summarize_two_stage_fundamental_quality_robustness.js \
            --start-month "$START_MONTH" \
            --end-month "$END_MONTH"

      - name: Validate robustness output
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node - <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const file = 'data_prediction_analysis/quarterly-financial-quality/two-stage-fundamental-quality-robustness.json';
          const p = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'));
          for (const h of ['d20','d40','d60']) {
            if (!(p.coverage?.[h]?.complete_events > 0)) throw new Error(`zero mature ${h} coverage`);
          }
          if (!Array.isArray(p.overall) || p.overall.length !== 6) throw new Error('expected 6 overall rows');
          if (!Array.isArray(p.yearly) || p.yearly.length === 0) throw new Error('yearly breakdown missing');
          if (!Array.isArray(p.industry) || p.industry.length === 0) throw new Error('industry breakdown missing');
          if (!Array.isArray(p.market_regime) || p.market_regime.length === 0) throw new Error('market-regime breakdown missing');
          if (!Array.isArray(p.exclusions) || p.exclusions.length !== 18) throw new Error('expected 18 exclusion rows');
          const key = id => p.exclusions.filter(x => x.test_id === id && x.horizon === 'd60').map(x => ({factor_id:x.factor_id,samples:x.samples,win_uplift:x.relative_win_rate_uplift_pp,excess_uplift:x.avg_excess_uplift_pct,median_excess:x.median_excess_return_pct}));
          console.log(JSON.stringify({
            coverage: p.coverage,
            d60_exclude_2026: key('exclude_2026'),
            d60_exclude_electronics: key('exclude_electronics'),
            d60_exclude_both: key('exclude_2026_and_electronics'),
          }, null, 2));
          NODE

      - name: Commit robustness research output
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add data_prediction_analysis/quarterly-financial-quality/two-stage-fundamental-quality-robustness.json
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo 'No robustness research changes'
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m "analysis: rebuild fundamental quality robustness study"
          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            if git pull --rebase origin main && git push origin HEAD:main; then exit 0; fi
            git rebase --abort 2>/dev/null || true
            sleep $((attempt * 5))
          done
          exit 1

      - name: Summary
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo '## 基本面雙確認－年份／產業／市場環境穩健性分析' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo '- 純分析：不重寫 monthly-signals、不重新抓 FinMind' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo '- 比較：月營收 >=8 + 財報品質 >=10；月營收 >=9 + 財報品質 >=10' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo '- Horizon：D20 / D40 / D60' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo '- 年份：逐年檢查，並額外做排除 2026 測試' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo '- 產業：以同產業成熟事件為 baseline；另做排除電子股測試' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo '- 市場環境：TAIEX 前 20 交易日 strong / sideways / weak 描述性分類，不作策略 gate' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo '- 額外壓力測試：同時排除 2026 與電子股' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

  schedule-timing-summary:
    # schedule-timing-summary:v1
    name: 排程時間摘要
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Write schedule timing summary
        shell: bash

        run: |

on:

    # GitHub cron 使用 UTC；對應台灣時間週二至週六 05:10、07:10、07:40。
    - cron: '10 21 * * 1-5'
    - cron: '10 23 * * 1-5'
    - cron: '40 23 * * 1-5'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      target_date:
        description: '預測交易日 YYYYMMDD；留空使用最新預測市場快照日期'
        required: false
        type: string
      phase:
        description: 'realtime_close 保存 05:00 最後即時快照；official_final 保存官方盤後日報'
        required: true
        type: choice
        default: official_final
        options:
          - realtime_close
          - official_final
      force:
        description: '即使已有資料仍重新抓取官方來源'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: official-market-constraints-and-night-finalization
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  update:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 25
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - name: Resolve target prediction date and finalization phase
        id: target
        shell: bash
        env:
          INPUT_DATE: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.target_date || '' }}
          INPUT_PHASE: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.phase || '' }}
          EVENT_SCHEDULE: ${{ github.event.schedule || '' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -n "${INPUT_DATE:-}" ]; then
            target_date="${INPUT_DATE//[^0-9]/}"
          else
            target_date=$(node -e "const dates=require('./scripts/finalize_prediction_market_context').predictionDates();process.stdout.write(dates.at(-1)||'')")
          fi

          if [[ ! "$target_date" =~ ^20[0-9]{6}$ ]] || [ ! -s "data_prediction_context/$target_date/latest.json" ]; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "reason=no_prediction_market_context" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0
          fi

          if [ -n "${INPUT_PHASE:-}" ]; then
            phase="$INPUT_PHASE"
          elif [ "${EVENT_SCHEDULE:-}" = "10 21 * * 1-5" ]; then
            phase="realtime_close"
          else
            phase="official_final"
          fi

          echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "reason=eligible" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "date=$target_date" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "phase=$phase" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "TARGET_DATE=$target_date" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "FINALIZATION_PHASE=$phase" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Validate night finalization scripts
        if: steps.target.outputs.run == 'true'
        run: |
          node --check scripts/taifex_realtime_night_futures.js
          node --check scripts/fetch_official_market_constraints.js
          node --check scripts/finalize_prediction_market_context.js
          node --test tests/prediction_market_context.test.js

      - name: Capture TX realtime close snapshot
        if: steps.target.outputs.run == 'true' && steps.target.outputs.phase == 'realtime_close'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node scripts/taifex_realtime_night_futures.js \
            --forecast-date "$TARGET_DATE" \
            --session-status closed_realtime \
            --output /tmp/night-futures-realtime-close.json
          node scripts/finalize_prediction_market_context.js \
            --forecast-date "$TARGET_DATE" \
            --night-kind realtime_close \
            --night-file /tmp/night-futures-realtime-close.json

      - name: Fetch official disposition and TX night daily report
        if: steps.target.outputs.run == 'true' && steps.target.outputs.phase == 'official_final'
        shell: bash
        env:
          FORCE: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.force || false }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          args=(--date "$TARGET_DATE" --allow-partial)
          if [ "${GITHUB_EVENT_NAME}" = "schedule" ] || [ "$FORCE" = "true" ]; then
            args+=(--force)
          fi
          node scripts/fetch_official_market_constraints.js "${args[@]}"

      - name: Commit final context without rewriting prediction snapshot
        if: steps.target.outputs.run == 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add data_market_constraints data_prediction_context
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No final night market context changes"
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m "data: finalize $TARGET_DATE night market context ($FINALIZATION_PHASE)"
          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            if git pull --rebase origin main && git push origin HEAD:main; then exit 0; fi
            git rebase --abort 2>/dev/null || true
            sleep $((attempt * 5))
          done
          exit 1

      - name: Write workflow summary
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo "## 正式處置股與台指期夜盤定稿" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- 是否執行：${{ steps.target.outputs.run || 'false' }}" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- 原因：${{ steps.target.outputs.reason || 'unknown' }}" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- 預測交易日：${{ steps.target.outputs.date || 'N/A' }}" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- 定稿階段：${{ steps.target.outputs.phase || 'N/A' }}" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- 原始預測市場快照：保持不可變，不覆寫" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

  schedule-timing-summary:
    # schedule-timing-summary:v1
    name: 排程時間摘要
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Write schedule timing summary

name: "[07 維護更新] Update TWSE Industry Lists"

on:
  schedule:
    # 10:52 Taipei Time (02:52 UTC)
    - cron: '52 2 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
  # Temporary incident-recovery trigger. Remove after the 2026-08-20 repair run.
  push:

  actions: read

concurrency:
  group: update-twse-industry
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  update-twse-industry:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json

      - name: Cache Playwright browsers
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/ms-playwright
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-playwright-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-playwright-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          npm ci
          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium

      - name: Update TWSE industry lists
        run: node scripts/extract_twse_industry.js

      - name: Validate repaired consolidated list
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          count=$(( $(wc -l < data_twse/twse_industry.csv) - 1 ))
          echo "Repaired consolidated list count: ${count}"
          test "$count" -ge 1000
          for code in 1101 2317 2330 2882; do
            grep -q "^${code}," data_twse/twse_industry.csv || {
              echo "Missing sentinel stock ${code}"
              exit 1
            }
          done

      - name: Audit workflows that consumed the truncated list
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cutoff='2026-08-20T03:36:24Z'
          report='data_twse/twse_industry_incident_20260820.json'
          tmp_items="$(mktemp)"
          tmp_pending="$(mktemp)"
          : > "$tmp_items"
          : > "$tmp_pending"

          gh run list --limit 200 \
            --json databaseId,workflowName,createdAt,status,conclusion,event,url \
            > /tmp/twse-incident-runs.json

          jq -c --arg cutoff "$cutoff" --arg current "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" '
            .[]
            | select(.createdAt >= $cutoff)
            | select((.databaseId | tostring) != $current)
          ' /tmp/twse-incident-runs.json | while IFS= read -r run; do
            id="$(jq -r '.databaseId' <<<"$run")"
            workflow="$(jq -r '.workflowName' <<<"$run")"
            status="$(jq -r '.status' <<<"$run")"

            # The producer itself is not a downstream consumer.
            if [[ "$workflow" == '[07 維護更新] Update TWSE Industry Lists' ]]; then
              continue
            fi

            if [[ "$status" != 'completed' ]]; then
              echo "$run" >> "$tmp_pending"
              continue
            fi

            log_file="/tmp/run-${id}.log"
            if ! gh run view "$id" --log > "$log_file" 2>/dev/null; then
              continue
            fi

            if grep -qE 'data_twse/twse_industry\.csv|twse_industry\.csv|股票清單.*twse_industry' "$log_file"; then
              stock_count="$(grep -oE '共[[:space:]]*[0-9,]+[[:space:]]*個股票代碼|共[[:space:]]*[0-9,]+[[:space:]]*檔' "$log_file" | tail -1 | grep -oE '[0-9,]+' | tr -d ',' || true)"
              confirmed_137=false
              if grep -qE '共[[:space:]]*137[[:space:]]*個股票代碼|共[[:space:]]*137[[:space:]]*檔' "$log_file"; then
                confirmed_137=true
              fi

              jq -n \
                --argjson meta "$run" \
                --arg stock_count "$stock_count" \
                --argjson confirmed_137 "$confirmed_137" \
                '{run_id:$meta.databaseId, workflow:$meta.workflowName, created_at:$meta.createdAt, status:$meta.status, conclusion:$meta.conclusion, event:$meta.event, url:$meta.url, observed_stock_count:(if $stock_count == "" then null else ($stock_count|tonumber) end), confirmed_137:$confirmed_137}' \
                >> "$tmp_items"
            fi
          done

          if [[ -s "$tmp_items" ]]; then
            jq -s '.' "$tmp_items" > /tmp/affected.json
          else
            echo '[]' > /tmp/affected.json
          fi
          if [[ -s "$tmp_pending" ]]; then
            jq -s '.' "$tmp_pending" > /tmp/pending.json
          else
            echo '[]' > /tmp/pending.json
          fi

          jq -n \
            --arg incident_started_at "$cutoff" \
            --arg generated_at "$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')" \
            --slurpfile affected /tmp/affected.json \
            --slurpfile pending /tmp/pending.json \
            '{incident_started_at:$incident_started_at, generated_at:$generated_at, evidence:"GitHub Actions logs containing twse_industry.csv", consumers:$affected[0], confirmed_137_count:([$affected[0][] | select(.confirmed_137 == true)] | length), consumer_count:($affected[0] | length), incomplete_runs_after_cutoff:$pending[0]}' \
            > "$report"

          echo '### TWSE industry incident audit' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo '' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- Consumer runs with direct log evidence: $(jq '.consumer_count' "$report")" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- Runs explicitly showing 137 stocks: $(jq '.confirmed_137_count' "$report")" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo '' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          jq -r '.consumers[] | "- \(.workflow) — run \(.run_id) — count=\(.observed_stock_count // "unknown") — confirmed137=\(.confirmed_137)"' "$report" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

          git add data_twse/

          if git diff --staged --quiet; then
            if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then

              git status --short

            git status --short
            exit 1

            if git pull --rebase origin main && git push origin HEAD:main; then
              exit 0
            fi
            git rebase --abort 2>/dev/null || true
            echo "Push failed, retry ${attempt}/5..."

          echo "Failed to push TWSE industry list changes after 5 attempts."

on:

    paths:

      - ".github/workflows/**"

permissions:
  contents: read

# Validation-only layer: it does not persist repository data, so a newer CI run
# may supersede an older validation run.
concurrency:
  group: public-page-registry-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  validate:
    name: Validate homepage registry and workflow deployment safety
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout public page sources and writer candidates
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            /public/
            /config/public-page-registry.json
            /scripts/
            /.github/workflows/

      - name: Validate canonical homepage source of truth
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node --check scripts/generate_public_index.js
          node --check scripts/validate_public_pages.js
          node --check scripts/validate_public_index_writers.js
          node scripts/generate_public_index.js --check
          node scripts/validate_public_pages.js
          node scripts/validate_public_index_writers.js

      - name: Audit all workflow concurrency layers
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node --check scripts/audit_workflow_deployment_races.js
          node scripts/audit_workflow_deployment_races.js --self-test
          node scripts/audit_workflow_deployment_races.js

      - name: Summarize validation
        shell: bash
        run: |
          {
            echo "## Public Page Registry / Workflow Layering Safety"
            echo
            echo "- index.html 與 registry 同步：✅"
            echo "- canonical / legacy / non-homepage HTML 分類：✅"
            echo "- 未分類 public root HTML：0"
            echo "- 非 canonical tools writer：0"
            echo "- Pages canonical concurrency group：github-pages"
            echo "- Pages publication cancel-in-progress：true"
            echo "- repository/data writer cancel-in-progress=true：禁止"
            echo "- validation-only workflow cancel-in-progress=true：允許"
            echo "- deployment chain workflow_run：禁止"
            echo "- Pages source：每次 checkout 最新 main"
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

  schedule-timing-summary:

    name: 排程時間摘要

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Write schedule timing summary
        shell: bash
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EasonLiu0913/stock_data/main/scripts/write_workflow_schedule_summary.js | node

name: "[01 台股資料] Warrant Data Scraper"

on:
  schedule:
    # 05:11 TPE (21:11 UTC)
    - cron: '11 21 * * *'
    # 07:23 TPE (23:23 UTC)
    - cron: '23 23 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: warrant-scraper
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  scrape-warrant:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json

      - name: Cache Playwright browsers
        id: playwright-cache
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/ms-playwright
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-playwright-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-playwright-

      - name: Install Node dependencies
        run: npm ci
        timeout-minutes: 5

      - name: Install Playwright Chromium on cache miss
        if: steps.playwright-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: npx playwright install chromium
        timeout-minutes: 5

      - name: Verify Chromium runtime
        id: chromium-smoke-test
        continue-on-error: true
        timeout-minutes: 2
        run: |
          node - <<'NODE'
          const { chromium } = require('playwright');
          (async () => {
            const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });
            await browser.close();
            console.log('Chromium runtime is ready.');
          })().catch((error) => {
            console.error(error);
            process.exit(1);
          });
          NODE

      - name: Install Playwright system dependencies only when needed
        if: steps.chromium-smoke-test.outcome == 'failure'
        run: npx playwright install-deps chromium
        timeout-minutes: 5

      - name: Verify Chromium runtime after dependency install
        if: steps.chromium-smoke-test.outcome == 'failure'
        timeout-minutes: 2
        run: |
          node - <<'NODE'
          const { chromium } = require('playwright');
          (async () => {
            const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });
            await browser.close();
            console.log('Chromium runtime is ready after installing system dependencies.');
          })().catch((error) => {
            console.error(error);
            process.exit(1);
          });
          NODE

      - name: Run TWSE warrant extractor
        run: |
          echo "🚀 開始執行 extract_warrant_data.js..."
          node scripts/extract_warrant_data.js
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Generate TWSE files.json only
        run: |
          echo "📑 正在產生檔案列表..."
          node scripts/generate_file_lists.js --only data_twse

      - name: Commit and push data
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git config --local user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git add data_twse/

          if git diff --staged --quiet; then
            if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
              echo "Unexpected uncommitted changes remain even though there are no warrant changes:"
              git status --short
              exit 1
            fi
            echo "No warrant changes"
            exit 0
          fi

          current_date=$(TZ='Asia/Taipei' date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
          git commit -m "chore: update warrant data ${current_date}"

          if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
            echo "Unexpected uncommitted changes remain before rebase:"

            exit 1
          fi

          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do

              exit 0
            fi
            git rebase --abort 2>/dev/null || true
            echo "Push failed, retry ${attempt}/5..."
            sleep 5
          done

          echo "Failed to push warrant data after 5 attempts."
          exit 1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  schedule-timing-summary:
    # schedule-timing-summary:v1
